Alternate is a privacy-focused Android app that tells you who is calling without adding them to your phone's contact list. Perfect for numbers you only need to recognise for a while, because nothing you save here shows up in WhatsApp, Telegram or any other app.
 Features: 
 Caller ID popup over incoming and outgoing calls
 Contacts stay private: never written to your phone's contacts or synced anywhere

 Several numbers per contact, with labels and country
 Groups, favorites and fast A-Z scrolling
 Search across names, numbers, notes and groups
 Import and export vCard (.vcf) files

izzyondroid:com.mardous.booming.name: Booming Music
izzyondroid:com.mardous.booming.summary: Clean, fast, and Material-driven music player with powerful features
izzyondroid:com.mardous.booming.description:
Booming Music is a modern and powerful local music player for Android, designed for a smooth, customizable, and visually appealing experience. Built with Material You design and powered by Media3, it combines simplicity with advanced playback features.
 Enjoy your favorite songs with word-by-word synced lyrics, translated lyric support (TTML/LRC), and a beautiful Now Playing interface featuring enhanced visuals, smooth transitions, and deep customization options.
 Fine-tune your listening with a built-in equalizer, ReplayGain, Audio Offload, and gapless playback for seamless transitions. Organize your music your way with smart playlists, customizable sorting, and a hierarchical folder view.
 Main features:
 Automatic lyric download and in-app lyric editor
 Word-by-word and translated lyrics (TTML, LRC)
 Media3-based playback engine with audio offload support
 ReplayGain for consistent volume across tracks
 Native ALAC decoding
 ListenBrainz scrobbling
 Adaptive mini player and gesture controls
 Custom covers and descriptions for playlists
 Tag editor with instant library updates
 Smart auto playlists (Recently Played, Most Played, History)
 Sleep timer, widgets, and Android Auto support
 Material You theming with dark and black modes
 Multi-language support
 Lightweight, open-source, and ad-free

izzyondroid:com.zaneschepke.wireguardaut.name: WG Tunnel
izzyondroid:com.zaneschepke.wireguardaut.summary: A WireGuard & AmneziaWG VPN client with auto-tunneling, lockdown & proxying.
izzyondroid:com.zaneschepke.wireguardaut.description:
WG Tunnel is a WireGuard VPN client that strikes the balance between simplicity and robustness, making it the ideal client for casual and power users alike. Whether you simply want to automate when you're connected to your VPN or you're a power user with advanced privacy use cases, WG Tunnel has you covered.
 Features:
 Auto-Tunneling: Automatically activate tunnels based on your device's active network details.
 Deferred Endpoint Bootstrapping: Safely resolves endpoints and updates peers after the tunnel is up for better reliability and leak protection on startup.
 Handshake Monitoring: Real-time handshake monitoring for instant tunnel health feedback.
 AmneziaWG Support: Full support for AmneziaWG 2.0 through 3.1, providing robust censorship protection.
 Split Tunneling: Flexible support for routing specific apps or traffic through the VPN.
 Split & Encrypted DNS: Resolve DNS through the tunnel using plain DNS, DoT, or DoH, and optionally split by domain suffix (tunnel or system).
 Local Proxy Mode: Expose WireGuard tunnels over a local SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy to browsers or firewall apps (like AdGuard).
 Lockdown Mode: Advanced in-app kill switch that blocks all traffic while the tunnel is down.
 Quick Controls: Quick Settings tile and home screen shortcuts for easy toggling.
 Remote Control Support: Intent-based automation for controlling tunnels and auto-tunneling from automation apps (like Tasker).
 Dynamic DNS Handling: Automatically detect and update endpoints on server IP changes without requiring a restart.
 IPv6 Endpoints: Automatically upgrade to IPv6 endpoints or fall back to IPv4 based on network conditions without requiring a restart.
 Android TV Support: Full support for nearly all features on Android TV.

Write ancient texts and browse all the avaible hieroglyphs on your tablet or phone.
This is a simple Android app for viewing, creating and exporting ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs. This app supports the professional writing of hieroglyphs using the Manuel de Codage. Hieroglyphs can be written in lines or columns, and both from left to right and from right to left.

fdroid:com.drexeldevelopment.openeatsjou.summary: Open Eats Journal is a free nutrition, calories and weight tracking app
fdroid:com.drexeldevelopment.openeatsjou.description:
Open Eats Journal is a free, data minimized and privacy friendly open source eats journal to track your food intake, nutritions, calories and weight.
You get:
- Full data sovereignty: The data remains on your device and is not shared with anyone, exporting and importing your data is also possible
- Easy recording of food consumption and thus calories and nutritional values consumed
- General easy use: copying of single journal entries, copying of journal entries of whole meals or days, multiple navigation possibilities

- Barcode scanner for scanning food barcodes to ease searching for foods

fdroid:com.orgzlyrevived.name: Orgzly Revived

Notebooks are saved in Org mode's file format.
“Org mode is for keeping notes, maintaining TODO lists, planning projects, and authoring documents with a fast and effective plain-text system.”
See orgmode.org for more information.
 Features: 
* Create, edit and delete notes and tasks
* Collapse and expand sub-notes
* Schedule tasks and set their deadlines
* Set priorities and tags for notes
* Fling notes left or right to open quick-menus
* Search notes by various properties
* Create and save searches for quick access

fdroid:com.vauth.salty.name: Salty
fdroid:com.vauth.salty.summary: A secure, offline-first message encryption tool for Android.
fdroid:com.vauth.salty.description:
Exchange sensitive information securely by encrypting messages with a shared "Salt" (Key). Built with a focus on privacy and modern design, it utilizes AES-256-GCM encryption and stores all history locally on your device.
Key Features:
- Secure Encryption: Industry-standard AES-256 with PBKDF2 (600,000 iterations).
- Modern Design: Sleek Material Design 3 interface with expressive dark mode.
- Offline Privacy: Zero analytics, zero cloud sync. Your data stays on your phone.
- Intuitive Workflow: Simple tabs for Encoding, Decoding, and History management.

fdroid:com.xnotes.name: xnotes
fdroid:com.xnotes.summary: Handwriting notes and sketching app with stylus support
fdroid:com.xnotes.description:
xnotes is a handwriting notebook for Android, built for the stylus. Take notes, sketch and annotate PDFs with ink that feels like a pen on paper.
* Ink that feels like a pen: pressure-sensitive and low latency, with pens and highlighters.
* Neon glow: make any pen glow.
* Disappearing ink: ink that fades away on its own, great for teaching and presenting.
* Tape: cover answers with tape and tap to peel it back, for testing yourself.
* Shape snapping: draw a rough shape, hold, and it snaps clean.
* Sharp at any zoom: ink and PDFs stay crisp however far you zoom in.
* Notebooks and an infinite canvas: pages when you want structure, endless space when you don't.
* Book layouts: single, double or cover pages, scrolling or page flips.
* PDF import: bring in any PDF and write all over it.
* Room for side notes: widen a PDF's margins on any edge and take notes on the side.
* Insert space: drag anywhere on a page to open up room there, even in the middle of a PDF.
* PDF text markups: highlight, underline and strike out text, add comments, search it.
* PDF colour filters: invert, sepia, contrast, brightness, multiply and screen.
* Images stay untouched: filter a PDF and its photos and images keep their true colours.
* Dark and OLED modes: easy on the eyes at night, true black on OLED screens.
* Real PDF export: sharp vector output with selectable text, links and bookmarks.
* Markdown: write in markdown and it formats as you type.
* Typed notes: tables, LaTeX equations and code highlighting, right on the page.
* Audio recording: record a lecture as you write, and your ink replays in sync with it.
* 20+ page templates: Cornell, planners, music staves, isometric and more.
* Endless themes: any accent colour, eight styles for each, dual tone and Material You.
* Make it yours: rearrange the toolbar, float it or dock it on any edge, and pick its size.
* Split view: two notes side by side.
* A real file explorer: grid, gallery, list, column and timeline views, with plenty to customise.
* Your notes, your folders: notes are saved as files in a folder you choose, not locked away in an app's database, so you stay in full control of them.
* Works with stylus pens: S Pen and many others.
* Always editable: nothing gets flattened, so every stroke can be moved, restyled or erased later.
* Private: open source, no account, no ads, no tracking, no internet access.

fdroid:dev.wceng.sufei.name: 素扉
fdroid:dev.wceng.sufei.summary: Minimalist and immersive Chinese traditional poetry reader
fdroid:dev.wceng.sufei.description:
SuFei (素扉) is a minimalist application dedicated to the immersive reading of traditional Chinese poetry. Designed with the philosophy of "Simple Elegance" (素) and "Opening the Door to Literature" (扉), it provides a digital space free from advertisements and social distractions.
Key Features:
 Immersive Reading : A refined layout optimized for classical texts, supporting built-in high-quality serif fonts (Noto Serif SC) and a traditional paper-like reading feel across all Android versions.
 Daily Encounters : Discover a curated piece of poetry every hour. Our smart algorithm extracts the most evocative and semantically complete lines, presented in a beautiful vertical layout.
 Comprehensive Library : Browse through a vast collection with a structured filtering system by dynasty, tune name (Ci-pai), and thematic tags.
 Personal Collection : Save your favorite pieces to your "Bedside" collection for quiet reflection at any time.
 Genre Awareness : Intelligent recognition of different styles (Shi, Ci, Qu), automatically tailoring the extraction and display logic to capture the soul of each genre.
 Modern Experience : Fully built with Jetpack Compose and Navigation 3, featuring fluid crossfade transitions and native support for Android 13+ predictive back gestures.
Experience the eternal beauty of classical Chinese literature in its purest form with SuFei.

fdroid:org.github.nynosy.adiresy_mobile.name: Adiresy
fdroid:org.github.nynosy.adiresy_mobile.summary: Find, share and navigate to Madagascar's community address codes
fdroid:org.github.nynosy.adiresy_mobile.description:
Adiresy is a native Android client for Adiresy, an unofficial addressing service for Madagascar.
Madagascar has no formal street-addressing system in most areas. Every building can still get a short, permanent code anchored to GPS coordinates (for example 101-6EAR-50418). This app lets people find, share, and navigate to those codes — working on low-end phones, and, progressively, fully offline.
Codes have no legal value. Adiresy is an unofficial, community-driven addressing layer, not a government service.
Features:
* Find the Adiresy code for a building and share it as a link or QR code.
* Resolve a shared code and see the building on a map.
* Search by code, place name, or administrative area (region, district, commune, fokontany).
* Download offline map data for all of Madagascar, at a regional-overview or city-level detail.
* Save favourite locations for quick access later.
* Offline routing and turn-by-turn navigation are planned for future releases.
Design goals:
* Offline-first — core tasks work with the radio off, once map data is downloaded.
* Built and tuned for budget hardware — 1-2 GB Android Go devices.
* Cheap on data and battery — no background location or wake-locks outside active navigation; downloads are Wi-Fi-only by default, resumable, and interruption-safe.
* Malagasy, French, and English are all first-class UI languages.
* Privacy-respecting — no account, no analytics by default. GPS coordinates are sent to the Adiresy API only for explicit, user-initiated lookups, never tracked, batched, or persisted server-side by the app.

fdroid:pl.nkg.geokrety.name: GeoKrety Logger
fdroid:pl.nkg.geokrety.summary: This program is used to record the movement of GeoKrety's.
fdroid:pl.nkg.geokrety.description:
GeoKrety is a non-commercial GeoCaching game. People move registered objects
(called GeoKrety) from cache to cache and register each move with the service.
For more information please visit the website. You'll need account on the
website to use the app.
How to log GeoKret's movement:
 Click the button "Log GeoKret" on the main screen.
 Select the type of the log. Make sure that in the "Identify GeoKret" is your login.
 If you had met or grabbed the GeoKret, fill in it's tracking code. If you drop the GeoKret, you can click "Inventory" and choose Tracking Code from the list of GeoKrets in your inventory.
 If you had dropped or met GeoKret, you have to fill in the Waypoint. If you had logged to the cache before, click the button "OC Log" and select waypoint from the list (the date and time will be pasted too).
 Set date and time, enter some comments and click "Go!".

apple-itunes:1422471180.name: Dazz Cam - Vintage Camera
apple-itunes:1422471180.description:
Dazz Camera, Pro Photographer in your Pocket.
We believe in keeping it simple, no need for post-editing. With just one tap, you can capture the most authentic vintage photos or videos, letting you enjoy the moment without distractions.
Dazz camera is inspired by classic film cameras from the 80s. We’ve sampled real film stock to recreate the colors and textures of vintage photography. Dazz camera supports shooting in various retro film formats like 135 film, 120 film, toy cameras, slide film, half-frame cameras, instant camera, 3D film photography, disposable camera, and more. 
Besides film photography, Dazz camera also offers modern digital camera color profiles, including compact camera, CCD camera, and we’re constantly adding more.
You can also capture videos with a retro vibe, using formats like 8mm film camera, 16mm film camera, VHS tape camera, DCR camera, movie camera, and slide projector.
We’re always rolling out new cameras, so keep an eye out!
When you’re capturing photos and videos, we’ve got some cool extra features and accessories for you:
- Save the negative and reprocess it to achieve different exposure and color temperature. (Available on select cameras)
- Double exposure effect by layering two photos.
- Timer for delayed shots.
- Flash.
- Import your existing photos for editing. (Available on select cameras)
- Adjust color temperature and tint.
- Switch between preset focal lengths or adjust freely.
- Tweak exposure compensation.
- Adjust ISO and shutter speed.
- Stabilization settings.
- Composition grids.
- Fisheye lens.
- Starburst lens.
- Color flash filters.

flathub:org.previewqt.PreviewQt.name: PreviewQt
flathub:org.previewqt.PreviewQt.description:
PreviewQt is a very simple application for previewing a wide range of files. Its main aim is on speed, striving to provide a preview as instantaneously as possible. It achieves this by being very lightweight and by its ability to sit in the system tray, ready to show whatever is thrown at it.
 Supported file formats include:
 Images: more than 140 formats, including photo spheres, panoramas, and motion photos
 Video/Audio: all common formats
 Documents: PDF and office documents, including page navigation
 Archives: All common compressed archives (zip, etc.) by loading any supported file contained within
 Comic Books, including page navigation
 E-Books (epub), including page navigation and remembering where you left off
 Text files, including syntax highlighting and prettifying output for certain formats
 Windows DLL/EXE: Information about these files, including any embedded version information
 PhotoQt: Information about PhotoQt's backup and extension files
 MuseScore: Rendering score sheets including page navigation
 ICC color profiles: display information about color profiles including gammut plots
 Packages: Display information about DEB and RPM packages including AppImage files
 SQLite database files: Show structure and meta information about sqlite database files
 URL: Support for loading Websites (both local and remote), including pre-processing with yt-dlp for directly streaming contained media
 Any file you encounter that is not yet supported by PreviewQt, please don't hesitate to get in touch. PreviewQt strives to one day support as many file types as possible.
 If you are using KDE's Dolphin file manager, PreviewQt can be invoked by shortcut to load whichever file is currently highlighted to allow for previewing any file easily without having to set PreviewQt as default application. You can also pass files to PreviewQt by simply dropping them onto the application window, or by means of a remote application (small square) wth any file dropped on it passed on to PreviewQt. If you are running KDE Plasma 6, there is also a plasmoid that integrates nicely with your desktop.
 If you like the overall concept of PreviewQt but would like to have more features, check out the fully featured image viewer PhotoQt, a sibling application to PreviewQt.

firefox-addons:3037494.name: Insty: Privacy for Instagram
firefox-addons:3037494.summary: Control Instagram read and story-view receipts, and find accounts you follow that do not follow you back. All processing stays in your browser.
firefox-addons:3037494.description:
Insty adds privacy controls and follower-checking tools to Instagram. It can prevent selected direct messages from being marked as read, prevent stories from
 being marked as viewed, and find accounts you follow that do not follow you back.
Open the extension popup to enable or disable each privacy control. The follower check runs only after you click “Check subscriptions” while Instagram is open.
Insty processes Instagram information locally in Firefox. It does not send account information, browsing activity, follower lists, settings, or analytics to the
 developer or any developer-controlled server.
Features:
 Control direct-message read receipts
 Control story-view receipts
 Find accounts that do not follow you back
 Store settings and results locally
 Optional support section with donation addresses and a GitHub link
Insty is an independent extension and is not affiliated with, authorized by, or endorsed by Instagram or Meta.

firefox-addons:3066769.name: ScriptGuard — Privacy Shield
firefox-addons:3066769.summary: Heuristic learning lets ScriptGuard detect and block suspicious scripts based on behavior, not just lists giving you adaptive, real‑time protection while you browse.
firefox-addons:3066769.description:
ScriptGuard is an open‑source privacy and security extension designed to stop dangerous scripts before they execute. It blocks ads, trackers, fingerprinting attempts, dynamic script injections, and third‑party surveillance at the network layer. ScriptGuard includes WebRTC and Blob leak protection, fingerprint request deletion, heuristic tracking detection, and a multi‑mode privacy system (OFF, BASIC, PRO, MAXIMUM).
No telemetry, no data collection, no background analytics all processing happens locally in your browser.
Users can whitelist sites, export/import rules, and generate manual privacy reports. ScriptGuard is built for transparency, security, and full user control.

firefox-addons:2870391.name: Privacy Score Analyzer
firefox-addons:2870391.summary: Analyze and score the privacy level of websites you visit.
firefox-addons:2870391.description:
Privacy Score Analyzer helps users assess the privacy level of any website they visit by analyzing factors such as the presence of cookies, trackers, and other privacy-related elements. With just a click, the extension provides a privacy score (out of 100) based on various privacy criteria, allowing users to better understand how much their data may be at risk.
Features:
Analyze privacy score for the current website.
Detects cookies, trackers, and other privacy-related elements.
Provides a score out of 100 to indicate the website’s privacy level.
Simple one-click interface for fast results.
How to Use:
Click on the extension icon to open the popup.
Press the "Analyze Privacy Score" button.
The extension will evaluate the current webpage and display the privacy score in a popup.

firefox-addons:961619.name: Download by Internet Download Manager
firefox-addons:961619.summary: Optionally use Internet Download Manager instead of the built-in download manager to get large files
firefox-addons:961619.description:
This extension provides a reliable integration to "Internet Download Manager" from your browser. The extension offers two modes of operation:
1. Context menu items over a link, audio, video and image element
2. Interrupt the built-in download manager and grab the downloadable job to send to the external download manager.
This extension is very lightweight on resource usage. Basically, it does not use anything when the network observer is disabled. 
A user can define the following conditions to call the external download manager automatically when the extension is enabled from the toolbar area:
1. Only call when file-size is larger than a defined value
2. Only call when the file-type is not in the defined list of mime-types
3. Only call when the download server supports multi-threading
Note: for this extension to operate you will need to install a native-client. For this project, I am using an open-source NodeJS based native-client. You will be notified on the first usage about the installation guide. This native-client is only available on Windows, Linux and Mac OS. 
--- Legal
"Internet Download Manager" is a trademark of Tonec Inc., registered in the U.S. and other countries. This extension is an independent project and has no relationship to "Internet Download Manager" team or Tonec Inc. It is only built in a hope to be a lightweight and useful integrator.

firefox-addons:2917403.name: Checkbox Tools
firefox-addons:2917403.description:
Checkbox Tools is a powerful and precise tool designed for managing checkbox inputs on any webpage efficiently and effectively. This extension allows users to manipulate the state of multiple checkboxes simultaneously, offering comprehensive control over bulk checkbox selections without the need for repetitive manual clicking.
Key Features
 ✅ Toggle All Checkboxes: Instantly enable or disable every checkbox element on the current webpage with a single click.
 🔢 Targeted Control: Enable or disable the first N checkboxes, where N is a user-defined numeric value.
 🔚 End-Range Control: Enable or disable the last N checkboxes, providing flexible batch operations from the end of the list.
 🎯 Streamlined Workflow: Designed to accelerate tasks involving forms, surveys, testing, or any scenario requiring bulk checkbox manipulation.
 🛠️ Clean and Intuitive Interface: Minimalistic design ensures ease of use without sacrificing functionality.
 ⚡ Smooth Animations and Responsive UI: Visual feedback enhances user experience without distraction.
Use Cases
Checkbox Tools is ideal for professionals and power users including:
 Quality assurance engineers performing web form testing.
 Data entry personnel working with large-scale form inputs.
 Developers and testers automating repetitive UI tasks.
 Any user seeking to improve efficiency by batch toggling checkbox inputs.
Why Choose Checkbox Tools?
Managing numerous checkbox inputs manually can be time-consuming and error-prone. Checkbox Controller eliminates these inefficiencies by providing precise, batch control, thereby reducing user effort and enhancing productivity.
Checkbox Tools is a reliable and efficient solution for advanced checkbox management in modern web environments. Download now to streamline your workflow and regain control over checkbox selections.

firefox-addons:961971.name: Zenfox — Solarized Dynamic Light/Dark Theme
firefox-addons:961971.summary:
Theme Firefox to suit you, day or night, solarized.
Firefox has never looked this good.
firefox-addons:961971.description:
As we spend more and more of our lives computing, and more and more of our computing is done on the browser, our browser being the awesome Firefox — it must be themed appropriately for its heavy duty.
Zen Fox uses the stunning Solarized Theme , ported to Firefox using its latest APIs. That means browser menus like the hamburger , download and overflow are themed to suit the rest of your browser. 
 Modes: 
Choose from 4 different methods to switch between Solarized Dark & Light Themes:
 Manual — toolbar button to switch themes upon press
 System — automatically changes theme based on OS dark/light theme
 Time — change themes automatically at times of your choice
 Weather — update theme based on current cloudiness at your locale
Also, you can choose the accent color, that is used for your tab line, tab loading, and icon attention colors.
 Notes: 
For the weather method, an account is needed on OpenWeatherMaps to get the API Key (it'll take just a minute). 
 Permissions: 
 Theme — to… theme 
 Alarm — to set internal timers that check for weather/time updates
 Storage — to store your settings 
No unnecessary permissions are required by Zen Fox, and all the code is open source on GitHub; see link on the left.

bluejetty:00044675:ios.description:
The Texas Children’s® Anywhere Care app allows Texas Children’s Health Plan members to consult with a live doctor through online video chat about non-emergent conditions. Our physicians and advanced practice providers can conveniently diagnose and write prescriptions for a variety of routine medical conditions. Please note certain conditions may require an in-person visit; for example, strep throat or injuries needing an X-ray. For more information about what is appropriate for a video visit, please visit texaschildrensanywherecare.org. Download the Texas Children’s Anywhere Care app today to access care night or day, right where you are.
La aplicación Texas Children’s® Anywhere Care les permite a los miembros de Texas Children’s Health Plan consultar a un médico por medio de una video llamada en vivo sobre condiciones que no son emergencias. Nuestros médicos y proveedores de prácticas avanzadas pueden diagnosticar y expedir recetas de forma conveniente para una variedad de condiciones médicas de rutina. Por favor toma en cuenta que algunas condiciones pueden necesitar una consulta en persona, como por ejemplo la amigdalitis estreptocócica (strep throat) o lesiones que necesiten radiografías. Para aprender más sobre las condiciones tratadas usando video llamada, por favor visita texaschildrensanywherecare.org. Descarga la aplicación Texas Children’s Anywhere Care hoy mismo para acceder a atención médica ya sea durante el día o la noche, estés donde estés.
Please note that telehealth is not for emergencies. If you’re having a medical emergency, call 911.
Ten en cuenta que la telesalud no es para emergencias. Si tiene una emergencia médica, llame al 911.
If you are an Apple Health user you will have the option to share important health information with your provider during your video visit. Sharing Apple Health data is optional but allows the provider to see heart rate, weight, and other health information to help them make a more accurate diagnosis.

bluejetty:00161120:ios.description:
Accurate clothing measurements – and faster listings.
Smartsizer helps clothing resellers capture consistent, resale-ready measurements and turn inventory into live listings faster. Using just your phone, you can measure garments accurately, scan labels for key details, and auto-generate clean listing descriptions – all in one streamlined workflow. No tape measure. No manual typing. No switching between apps. Just faster, more professional listings.
What you can do with Smartsizer:
• Capture accurate clothing measurements – consistently and tape-free
• Automatically detect garment category (shirts, dresses, pants, jackets, coats, and more)
• Display clean measurement overlays directly on your images
• Scan clothing labels to extract brand, size, materials, and care details
• Auto-generate ready-to-post listing descriptions
• Remove backgrounds and create square, marketplace-ready photos
• Export measurement images and listing assets in bulk
Smartsizer is built for thrift sellers and clothing resellers who want reliable measurements and a faster, more scalable listing workflow.
We’re actively improving Smartsizer. Have feedback or feature ideas? Reach us anytime at support@smartsizer.io

bluejetty:00165340:ios.description:
Protect Your Privacy with "Lock: Photo Vault" – the Ultimate App for Securing Medias & Private Browsing
"Lock: Photo Vault" is designed to provide peace of mind by securely storing your private photos, videos, and sensitive memories. With multiple security layers and an easy-to-navigate interface, this app is the ultimate solution for organizing and protecting your media.
Top Features of Photo Vault:
Secure Your Content with Biometric Locking: Use Face ID or Touch ID for quick, secure access to the app and album-specific locks to add an extra layer of security.
Private Browsing & Easy Media Saving: Browse the internet without leaving any history and save images directly from the browser to Photo Vault.
Organized Albums with Individual Locks: Lock each album separately with custom passwords, perfect for organizing family photos, personal projects, and more.
Automatic Deletion After Import: Optionally delete photos and videos from your gallery once imported to Photo Vault, ensuring they stay private.
Live Photos and Video Support: Import, view, and organize Apple’s Live Photos and videos seamlessly within the app.
Quick Share Extension: Save photos and videos from any other app with the Share extension, keeping your media safe with just a few taps.
Why Choose Photo Vault?
Privacy-Focused: Your data stays on your device with no server storage or data sharing; Keepsafe your medias.
Easy, Fast, and Secure: From fast access using biometrics to an intuitive, ad-supported interface (removable with subscription), the app offers a seamless experience.
Fully Free Features: Enjoy complete functionality without mandatory subscriptions, making Photo Vault accessible to everyone.
Upgrade Your Privacy Game Today
Download Photo Vault now and safeguard your photos and videos effortlessly. From travel photos to cherished memories, Photo Vault is here to keep them safe. Try it today and take control of your digital privacy.
The app offers premium features as subscription plans and in app purchases. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, at the rate of your selected plan. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase. During the free trial period, you can enjoy full access to all the app's features. If you decide to subscribe during the trial, any unused portion of the free trial period will be forfeited. For more information, please read terms of use:
https://alpinebytes.ucraft.site/photo-vault

bluejetty:00041199:ios.description:
Alchemiya is an online TV streaming service dedicated to bringing you the best Movies, Drama and Documentaries about the Muslim world.
From the Ottoman Empire to Mipsterz in Brooklyn, Persian carpets to the Paris Mosque, Hijazi script to Hijabi fashion, a video library that celebrates the rich culture and heritage of the Muslim world, past and present.
Alchemiya is a movement to provide positive, celebratory, beautiful, video content and challenges the distorted negative ‘tropes’ about Islam and Muslims. Alchemiya has established itself as the ‘home’ of feel-good entertainment for anyone who wants to hear and see the everyday beauty present in Muslim communities everywhere. 
We seek out and work with the most creative talent, both established and emerging, from the Global Muslim community. Content is selected for its appeal to universal audiences and we support an open minded, inclusive attitude, avoiding sectarian, political or narrow interpretations.
Download and start your 7 day free trial now.
To access all features and content you can subscribe to Alchemiya on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
* All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
Terms of Service: https://watch.alchemiya.com/tos
Privacy Policy: https://watch.alchemiya.com/privacy

bluejetty:00069388:ios.description:
Avec l'application RTL, 1ère radio privée de France, plongez dans l’univers de votre station de radio préférée : le direct, les replays, les podcasts et les playlists de nos programmes phares !
LE MEILLEUR DE RTL
• Accédez en un clic au direct audio ou vidéo, et revenez au début de l’émission si vous avez manqué le début.
• Retrouvez facilement le replay audio ou vidéo de toutes les émissions de l'antenne : Les Grosses Têtes, L'œil de Philippe Caverivière, Héros, L'Heure du Crime, RTL Matin...
• Suivez en temps réel toutes les infos RTL de la Rédaction (actualités, sport, culture, économie, santé…) et abonnez-vous aux notifications pour ne rien manquer.
PERSONNALISEZ VOTRE APPLICATION
Créez-vous un compte pour profiter de fonctionnalités personnalisées !
• Suivez vos émissions et podcasts favoris.
• Téléchargez des épisodes via votre compte utilisateur RTL, pour les écouter où et quand vous le voulez.
• Reprenez la lecture de vos podcasts là où vous l'avez laissée.
• Choisissez les notifications et newsletters que vous souhaitez recevoir pour rester informé des actualités et nouveautés.
• Programmez votre alarme personnalisée pour commencer la journée avec RTL ou l’une de nos radios digitales.
PROFITEZ A 100% DE NOS CONTENUS EXCLUSIFS
• Découvrez nos radios digitales RTL : 100% Grosses Têtes, RTL 100% France, RTL 100% Hits, RTL 100% 80…
• Laissez-vous tenter par nos podcasts originaux, entièrement crées par nos équipes : Une lettre d'Amérique, Les Voix du Crime, Lis-moi une histoire, Symptômes...
RTL PARTOUT AVEC VOUS
• Embarquez-nous dans vos trajets du quotidien ! En voiture, écoutez RTL partout grâce à la compatibilité CarPlay.
UNE REMARQUE, UNE SUGGESTION, UNE QUESTION ?
Contactez-nous à l’adresse mail suivante : mobile.radio@m6.fr
Retrouvez également votre radio RTL sur les réseaux sociaux : Facebook, Youtube, Instagram, X, BlueSky et TikTok !

🚀 Easy, Simple, Fast & Free:

✔ Cast your videos, music, and photos directly from your mobile device to your Roku TV. Share cherished moments and stream your content on the big screen effortlessly. 
🎹 Large Remote Styles 
✔ Choose from various remote styles, including Dark mode, Light mode, and Large Keys, catering to all users, including those who prefer a tactile and accessible experience.

✔ Immerse yourself in your favorite shows and movies without disturbing others. 
✔ Enjoy Private Listening with headphones, ensuring an uninterrupted and personalized viewing experience.

✔ Say goodbye to frustrating searches, as our advanced technology ensures seamless Roku connection every time.

✔ Our Roku remote app proves that great things come in small packages. At just around 10 megabytes, it won't take up valuable space on your device, yet it delivers powerful control and convenience. 
🪫🔋 Lifesaver for Lost or Dead Remotes 
✔ Never worry about losing your physical remote or dealing with dead batteries again! 
✔ Our app comes to the rescue when your physical remote is nowhere to be found or simply out of juice. 
📱 Voice or Text Input 
✔ Search for entertainment effortlessly with voice or keyboard input from your smartphone, ensuring you find your favorite content quickly.

✔ Compatible with all Roku models including Roku Express, Roku Streaming Stick, Roku Premiere, Roku Premiere Plus, Roku Ultra.
✔ Works seamlessly with Smart TVs including popular brands like Hisense, TCL, Sharp, Insignia, RCA, Hitachi, Philips, Haier & Element.
📡 Auto Connection 
✔ Connect with a few finger taps and you’ll stay connected!
🔊 Volume Control
✔ Adjust your Roku TV/device volume using your phone's volume buttons, making it easier than ever to find the perfect audio level.
📳 Feedback Options
✔ Customize your experience with sound or vibration feedback, enhancing your overall control and accessibility.

👍 🥺Your Feedback Matters Help us improve the app by sharing your thoughts and suggestions.
Disclaimer/Trademarks:

Podimo – Podcasts & audiobooks
Unlimited Listening
Make the most of your time – listening to the best stories with Podimo
Are you looking for a new and exciting audio journey? Dive into an intriguing world of content with Podimo and immerse yourself in gripping true crime shows, love & romance, personal stories, the latest gossip and much more.
Become a member of our community and get:
- Unlimited listening.
- Access to hundreds of exclusive podcasts & more than 10.000 audiobooks.
- Up close and personal with our creators.
- Podcast episodes in full video
Start your free trial now. No commitment – cancel anytime.
A brand-new way of discovering podcasts: Video Trailers
At Podimo we take you along an innovative and one-of-a-kind discovery experience not only through audio but also sweeping visual content. Thanks to short video trailers, created by and with our dedicated creators, you get the unique chance to:
find out what our exclusive shows are all about before diving in.
get personal with your favorite creators and see them behind the scenes. 
be the first to glimpse at the podcasts that everyone will be talking about tomorrow.
The right content for your every mood
Whether you are craving a thrilling crime show, looking for some light entertainment or need a little pick-me-up after a rough day – Podimo is always there for you. Grab your earphones and listen to our podcasts and audiobooks while cooking, cleaning or just relaxing. Thanks to personal recommendations you will easily find your new favorite show and dive into addictive and inspiring stories.
Quality content – handpicked for you
At Podimo we are all about creating the best possible audio experience for you. We have made it our mission to be the home of the best podcasts, audiobooks and short fiction formats. We offer you an exciting mixture of high class true crime formats, up close talk shows, personal stories and intimate encounters. Podimo’s wide selection of top formats guarantee to entertain, distract and capture you!
Therefore we work with popular and well-known hosts that have interesting stories to tell and exciting guests. Our vast and ever growing selection of exclusive podcasts and international audiobooks includes top creators and authors from all over the world. Discover your next addiction among our many categories and experience the power of listening.
The best content for your kids too 
With Podimo your little ones can listen to our handpicked audiobooks and podcasts for kids from 3-12 years old. Let your kids take a break from the screen and listen to stories with popular and beloved characters. 
With the Podimo app you get:
- Video trailers: your next binge-worthy show is just a swipe away. 
- Personalized recommendations: based on your interests and listening habits.
- Hand-picked content: podcasts, audiobooks and radio plays for every mood and time, chosen by our editorial team.
- A true “home”: one tab for all the podcasts you follow, episodes you're listening to and new releases from your number one shows.
- Offline listening: save your data plan by downloading podcasts and audiobooks to listen on the go.
- Sleep Timer: drift away to the voices of your favorite storytellers.
- Sharing: share video trailers and episodes you've enjoyed with friends and family.
- Updates: get notified when the podcasts you follow release a new episode and when exciting content from your favorite genres is available.
Tune the world out, turn the volume up, and enjoy!

Solitaire - Classic Solitaire Card Games by LinkDesks is an addictive and challenging classic card game for card lovers! A brand new solitaire classic card game experience with the original solitaire card games!
One of our good memories: Classic Solitaire Games.
Wait no more! Have fun in the Classic Solitaire offline game! Relax your mind and train your brain for free! Awaken the memory of joy playing classic card games!
GAME FEATURES
• Classic solitaire game
• 100% free solitaire game
• Customizable card themes
• Customizable backgrounds
• Fun daily challenges
• Unlimited free undo
• Unlimited free tips
• Left-handed mode
• Crisp and easy-to-read cards

• 1 card or 3 cards flip mode

HOW TO PLAY?
To win Solitaire you must move all the cards to the four goals. Each foundation can only hold one suit and you must put the cards sequencing from Ace to King: Ace, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, Jack, Queen and King. You have to complete all suits to win the game: clubs, diamonds, hearts and spades.
Solitaire is one of the most played and funniest free games for both kids and adults. 
Don't worry if you haven't played or have already forgotten how to play Solitaire. No problem! Solitaire is one of the simplest games to play, and most importantly, Solitaire never bores you. Follow our simple guide in game and you will know how to play perfectly!
It’s the perfect time killing game for a short period of refreshing brain training on the bus, in the toilet or in the office. Easy to play retro card game for all ages. bluejetty:00078862:ios.description:
Dehancer is a film emulation app for photo and video editing built on 10 years of color science to bring real analog film looks to your iPhone and iPad.
Choose from 86 film presets based on iconic stocks: Kodak, Fuji, Cinestill and more. Each preset is crafted from real film stocks. Refine any look in the Lab with realistic Grain, Bloom, and Halation.
Powerful color grading tools give you precise control over every image. Work in Projects to save and revisit your edits anytime. Batch editing lets you apply your grade across multiple photos or videos in one step. RAW support (currently in beta) gives you access to the full range of image data for more accurate, detailed results.
Essential video editing tools are built right in. Trim, cut, and arrange your clips before applying your grade, so you can go from raw footage to a finished, cinematic look without leaving the app.
Whether you shoot on an iPhone or import footage from a camera, Dehancer brings cinematic color grading to photographers, filmmakers, and creators at every level.
Trusted by 1 million+ creators for authentic film emulation, cinematic color grading, and results that look genuinely analog.

bluejetty:00120441:ios.description:
CREATE YOUR SAVANNAH… AND SET OFF ON SAFARI!
Draw the watering holes, plant the baobab trees, place the lodges and trace the paths: you imagine your very own piece of wilderness. Zebras, elephants, giraffes, lions… place the animals wherever you like and watch them roam through the world you’ve created.
Then hop in the 4x4 with Pango and friends: observe, photograph, explore! Cool off under the waterfalls, slide over the rocks, bounce on the hidden trampoline beneath the giant trees, and enjoy the campfire when night falls. Every discovery becomes an adventure, every action transforms the savannah.
Pango Build Safari is an open-ended building game that develops creativity, observation, imagination and fine motor skills. An open, immersive and intuitive experience designed for children aged 3 and up.
A PANGO CREATION
With over 15 years of experience and more than 15 million children reached, Pango has become a trusted reference for parents seeking calm, educational and kind-hearted games.
Pango Build Safari carries on this philosophy: an exploration and construction game inviting children to discover nature, understand how it works and create a living world full of animals.
WHY PARENTS LOVE PANGO BUILD SAFARI
- Stimulates creativity and imagination
- Develops observation, logic and understanding of nature
- Encourages independent exploration in a safe, caring environment
- 100% free building: children create, modify and reinvent their own savannah
- Interactive animals, lively scenery and many secrets to discover
- Simple, smooth interface, perfectly adapted to small hands
- Several pre-built Safaris to support younger children
A 100% SAFE GAME FOR CHILDREN
• No in-app purchases 
• No ads 
• No external links 
• Built-in parental controls 
• Compliant with children’s data protection standards
PANGO VALUES: NATURE, CREATIVITY, AUTONOMY
At Pango, we design experiences from a child’s perspective: simple, soothing and enriching. Our games encourage curiosity, care for nature, exploration and the joy of growing through play.
Need help? Questions? pango@studio-pango.com
More info: www.studio-pango.com
DOWNLOAD PANGO BUILD SAFARI and let your child imagine, build and explore their own savannah: A LAND TO SHAPE, ANIMALS TO MEET!

bluejetty:00066439:ios.description:
Google Photos is the home for all your photos and videos. Easily store, edit, organize, and search your memories with the help of Google AI.
• 15 GB OF CLOUD STORAGE: Every Google account gets up to 15 GB of storage*, 3X more than many other cloud storage services. So you can back up and keep your memories safe automatically on all of your devices.
• AI-POWERED EDITING TOOLS: Make complex edits in just a few taps. Remove unwanted distractions with Magic Eraser. Improve out-of-focus blurry photos with Unblur. Enhance lighting and brightness with Portrait Light.
• SEARCH MADE SIMPLE: Your photos are easily searchable in a natural, descriptive way, like “Alice and me laughing,” “Kayaking on a lake surrounded by mountains” or “Emma painting in the backyard.”
• EASY ORGANIZATION: Google Photos helps declutter your gallery by automatically organizing duplicates and similar photos into photo stacks. It also offers smart, intuitive folders for screenshots, documents, custom albums and daily camera roll organization, making your gallery feel orderly and personalized. You can even save sensitive photos and videos to a locked folder protected by your device screen lock.
• RELIVE AND SHARE YOUR FAVORITE MEMORIES: Stroll down memory lane right in Google Photos. Share photos, videos, and albums with any of your contacts — even if they don't use Google Photos.
• YOUR MEMORIES ARE SAFE: Your photos and videos are safe and secure from the instant you store them, protected by our advanced security infrastructure while in storage or when you share them.
• ALL YOUR MEMORIES IN ONE PLACE: With backup on, you can easily transfer your photos from other apps, galleries and devices, so all of your content is in one place.
• FREE UP SPACE: Never worry about running out of space on your phone again. Photos that are backed up in Google Photos can be removed from your device’s storage in just a tap.
• PRINT YOUR FAVORITE MOMENTS:
From your phone, to your home. Turn your favorite memories into photo books, photo prints, canvas wall art and more. Price varies by product. Printing services available in the US, EU, UK, and CA only.
• GOOGLE LENS: Search what you see. This preview enables you to identify text and objects in your photos to learn more and take action.
Google Privacy Policy: https://google.com/intl/en_US/policies/privacy
* Google Account storage is shared across Google Photos, Gmail, and Google Drive. In some countries, every account gets 5 GB of storage with the option to unlock an additional 10 GB by adding a phone number.

bluejetty:00081481:ios.name: Word Tour - word puzzle
bluejetty:00081481:ios.summary: Embark on a relaxing and brain-boosting adventure with Word Tour, the ultimate word puzzle game that takes you around the world while challenging your vocabulary and sharpening your mind.Whether you’re a longtime fan of crossword puzzles, w
bluejetty:00081481:ios.description:
Embark on a relaxing and brain-boosting adventure with Word Tour, the ultimate word puzzle game that takes you around the world while challenging your vocabulary and sharpening your mind.Whether you’re a longtime fan of crossword puzzles, word search games, or simply love connecting letters to uncover hidden words, Word Tour brings together the best of word games into one beautifully designed experience. The gameplay is simple—just swipe to connect letters and form words—but don’t let that fool you. Each level offers increasingly clever puzzles that will keep you engaged, thinking, and entertained. With more than 5,000 handcrafted levels, Word Tour ensures endless hours of meaningful play, all while helping you expand your vocabulary, improve spelling, and keep your mind active.
As you progress through the game, you’ll unlock a series of stunning locations, each more breathtaking than the last. From tropical beaches to snow-covered mountains and iconic landmarks, Word Tour offers a travel-themed word journey that’s as visually captivating as it is mentally stimulating. The immersive background music and carefully selected imagery provide a relaxing atmosphere, making Word Tour the perfect escape whether you’re at home, commuting, or simply winding down after a long day. What makes Word Tour even more special is that it’s designed for everyone—kids, adults, and seniors alike can enjoy the game at their own pace with no time limits, no pressure, and unlimited attempts. It’s a stress-free word game experience that adapts to your style of play.
In addition to its core gameplay, Word Tour offers daily challenges, special word quests, and exciting seasonal events that keep the game fresh and rewarding every time you open it. You’ll earn daily bonuses, unlock achievements, and even compete in friendly competitions with other players from around the world. Whether you're playing solo or sharing the experience with friends and family, Word Tour makes every session a satisfying one. The game also includes optional in-app purchases for hints and extra features, but it’s fully playable for free with no mandatory spending required. You can even enjoy it offline, making it the perfect travel companion when you're on the go.
If you’re looking for a word game that combines the fun of classic puzzles with a soothing, travel-inspired setting, Word Tour is your perfect match. It’s more than just a word puzzle game—it’s a way to train your brain, relax your mind, and explore the world one word at a time. With its rich variety of puzzles, beautiful design, and user-friendly experience, Word Tour stands out as a must-have game for anyone who loves to learn, play, and unwind. Download Word Tour today and discover how far your words can take you!

bluejetty:00137050:ios.name: Barcode Scanner: Bar Code Read
bluejetty:00137050:ios.summary: Barcode Scanner is a fast, free barcode reader for iPhone. Simple and easy to use: open the app, point your camera at a product barcode and it reads instantly, with no buttons to press and no photos to take. After a scan, you can look the p
bluejetty:00137050:ios.description:
Barcode Scanner is a fast, free barcode reader for iPhone. Simple and easy to use: open the app, point your camera at a product barcode and it reads instantly, with no buttons to press and no photos to take. After a scan, you can look the product up and compare prices with one tap. Scan barcodes one after another, share your whole scan list at once, and read QR codes too.
■ Scan barcodes in seconds
The camera starts as soon as you open the app. Aim it at a barcode and it is detected automatically, so you can check a product the moment you pick it up. There is nothing to set up and nothing to type.
■ Look up products and compare prices
After scanning a product barcode, search buttons appear for Google, Amazon and other shopping sites. Tap a button to search for the scanned product on that site and compare the prices you find. bluejetty:00073705:ios.summary:

Recommended by the Sleep Foundation and tru
bluejetty:00073705:ios.description:
Join over 10 million users! Become a better sleeper and morning person thanks to 100 years of sleep science with RISE, the only sleep tracker that also measures your sleep debt and energy levels.
Recommended by the Sleep Foundation and trusted by teams in the NFL, MLB, and NBA, and top Fortune 500 companies, RISE makes it easy to improve your sleep and energy.
But RISE is more than a sleep and energy tracker. Users can access widgets, calendar integration, sleeping sounds, meditation guides, smart alarm clocks, habit reminders, and a sleep knowledge library.
FROM THE RISE COMMUNITY
***
Chase M.
"RISE helped me understand how vital sleep truly is. In only a few weeks, I found myself more focused, energetic, and productive at work."
***
Becky G.
"I could see where sleep debt was causing issues, like temper short, not comprehending things, moving slowly.  I had an epiphany... I'm getting 45min more sleep on average than I was before RISE."
UNLOCK BETTER SLEEP
Tired of the age-old "eight hours of shut-eye" advice? Go beyond buying a new mattress or pillow and discover the life-changing concept of Sleep Debt.
Scientifically proven to be a vital factor in your well-being, a low Sleep Debt can improve your life quality and even your longevity—while high Sleep Debt can cause fatigue and harm your health.
RISE calculates your Sleep Debt, helps you understand its impact on your energy, and guides you on how to lower it by improving sleeping habits. Learn about your melatonin window, when to prioritize sleep, and understand the real cost of those late nights—and how you can benefit from naps.
PERSONALIZED SLEEP TRACKER
Do you find your mind racing when your head hits the pillow? Can’t stop doom-scrolling on your phone? Feeling fatigued all day?
Based on your sleep data, circadian rhythm and research, we’ll make recommendations that fit your needs and guide you toward healthier habits.
RISE will get you in bed on time, guide you when you can’t sleep, reduce the times you wake up at night, and make you feel less groggy in the morning.
DISCOVER YOUR CIRCADIAN RHYTHM
We all have an internal brain clock, our circadian rhythm, it signals to our body when to be alert or go into recovery mode. Everyone is unique, from when we perform our best to when we should sleep and wake up. We use advanced algorithms to find your optimal sleep windows.
You’ll gain insight into your circadian rhythm and energy levels, helping you plan for a productive day.
Sleeping refuels energy, and 83% of RISE users feel more energy in a week or less.
AUTOMATICALLY TRACK SLEEP
Through our integration with Apple Health, Apple Watch, Fitbit, Oura, and data from other sleep trackers on your phone, like Sleep Cycle and ShutEye, RISE can determine the hours of sleep you get every night, sleep debt, the number of steps you take each day, as well as data from other activities that affect your sleep pattern.
WHY WE STARTED RISE
We want to help get ahead of the Insufficient Sleep Epidemic (CDC, 2014) we're experiencing, which has been increasing since 1985. This Epidemic has led to elevated mortality rates (Cappuccio, 2010) as well as underperformance in most aspects of life (RAND, 2016).
Today, we look at sleep as a luxury. RISE strives to create a world where healthy sleep is a necessity.
Subscription pricing & terms
RISE offers auto-renewing yearly subscriptions to provide unlimited access to all premium features. There’s also a limited-time free trial of 7 days to explore the premium features for free. A Paid Subscription (or free trial) is required to access the content of the app.
Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your App Store account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Go to your Profile or App Store settings to manage your subscription.
Terms of Service available at: bit.ly/rise-sleep-app-tos

bluejetty:00164086:ios.description:
Dating app for singles — search for a partner today! Sign up now for free and find your perfect partner with Snoggle.
Snoggle — a new, original and innovative dating app. Snoggle gives you more than a few swipes, a match and dull conversation. Snoggle offers you an exciting platform to search for a partner. Detailed profiles help you to find exactly what you’re looking for. Intriguing conversations, tantalising flirtations and plenty of singles are waiting for you!
It’s free to sign up to Snoggle and will continue to be so in the future. Join our loving community!
You know the story. Swipe right to show your interest in a potential partner and swipe left if you want to see a different profile. If you both like each other, it’s a match. The matching game is the best way to find deeper conversations and more. The best thing about a match? The first message is always free! That’s the key to making a good impression on your potential partner. Use it!
It’s free to download and register on the Snoggle app.
Daily fun and games guaranteed. Our wheel of fortune gives you the opportunity to win exclusive daily prizes for free! You’ll also be in with a chance of winning an extra bonus. Use the Snoggle app for seven days in a row and choose from one of our major prizes. Prizes vary every week. Daily games make searching for a partner even more fun and thrilling.
What are you waiting for? Sign up to Snoggle for free now and write your own love story today. We can’t wait to see you there!
Community is a top priority for us. Every day new singles sign up to our app to find love. Developing deeper connections and relationships with others is what makes life worth living. Our detailed profiles give you the opportunity to search and find men and/or women with the same interests as you. We bring together people who belong together.
Are you still Snoggling or are you already dating?
Create your own friends list, highlight your favourite chat partners, and send gifts to that special someone who deserves it. Use the poke button to show your interest and break the ice. Poking is the cornerstone of captivating conversations — as long as your partner responds!
We developed Snoggle Premium for those who want to take their happiness into their own hands. Looking for thrilling conversations and tantalising flirtations? Then use our exclusive functions:
- Fully anonymous! Use our private mode for discrete browsing on the go.
- 200% chance of winning on our wheel of fortune — new draw every day.
- Exclusive promo codes for even more fun.
- Additional filters help you to find the perfect partner.
- Five pokes, three super likes and one boost — every month
- Get unlimited swipes now with our Swipe Flat feature!
- Take back swipes — revisit your last decision in the matching game.
- Unlimited matches! See your matches at any time.
- Upload up to 50 images for your friends and chat partners with our bigger galleries.
- Unlimited favourites! Highlight your favourite chat partners.
- Visible profiles — find out who is interested in you straight away!
- Enjoy Snoggle entirely ad-free.
Can’t wait? Then join our loving community now for free and write your own love story.
And have fun with Snoggle. We’re so glad you chose Snoggle.

bluejetty:00083491:ios.name: Thetan Immortal
bluejetty:00083491:ios.summary:
Thetan Immortal – Fast-Paced 1v1 and 2v2 Archery Combat in a Real-Time PvP Arena.
Thetan Immortal is a skill-based game that brings together precision, tactics, and speed in a thrilling real-time PvP world. Engage in fast-paced 1v1 archery
bluejetty:00083491:ios.description:
Thetan Immortal – Fast-Paced 1v1 and 2v2 Archery Combat in a Real-Time PvP Arena.
Thetan Immortal is a skill-based game that brings together precision, tactics, and speed in a thrilling real-time PvP world. Engage in fast-paced 1v1 archery combat where every movement matters, and your ability to outplay opponents defines victory. Whether you're a fan of Thetan Arena or a former Archer of Gods warrior, this is the PvP archery combat experience you've been waiting for.
Key Features:
- Real-time PvP duels lasting 1–2 minutes – perfect for short session PvP
- Choose from 9 archery heroes inspired by the Thetan universe
- Over 20 unique skills with cooldowns, allowing endless combo possibilities
- Tactical mechanic: Shoot only while standing still – master your mobility and timing
- Compete in solo PvP or dominate Knockout battles with team-based strategy
- Unlock Battle Chests, claim Daily Gifts, and progress with the Season Pass
- Climb the ranking system and become a legend in the arena
- Social features: chat with players and join real-time tournaments
How to Play: Before each match, select 5 powerful abilities to define your playstyle. Once in the arena, you’ll need to balance movement and attacks - your hero can only shoot while standing still. That creates a tight shoot and dodge rhythm where quick reflexes and smart ability usage are key. With each skill on a cooldown, you’ll need to plan your strategy, time your super skills, and execute perfect combos to win each real-time duel. If you’ve ever played an archer game that rewards precision and timing, you’ll feel right at home.
Why Real-Time PvP Fans Will Love Thetan Immortal
- Fast-paced PvP action made for quick sessions and intense fights
- A true skill-based challenge – no pay-to-win, only precision and timing
- Inspired by classic archer games, but redefined for modern mobile play
- A mobile arena experience praised by fans of Archer of Gods and similar archer games
- Join a growing community of real-time warriors in this polished, stylish experience
- Deep yet simple combat – ideal for competitive and casual players alike
- Built for mobile: smooth controls, quick matchmaking, and addictive action PvP fun
Ready to Become an Immortal Archer?
Join the battlefield, test your skills in real-time PvP, and rise through the rank to become a legend. Whether you're into hero shooters, mobile arena games, or simply love a good 1v1 archery duel, Thetan Immortal offers a fresh and fierce way to compete.
Download now and step into the most exciting real-time PvP archer duels on mobile.
From the creators of Heroes Strike, Thetan Arena, and Thetan Rivals.

bluejetty:00024237:ios.description:
Welcome to Modern City! Your new favorite home design game set against a stunning NYC background.
Take this chance to work side by side with star interior designer Chloe Williams and her business partner Liam Gold. From successful career women to newlywed couples to families, clients are on their way to meet Chloe and Liam right now!
Help them design trendy kitchens, cozy living rooms, relaxing bedrooms and more to live the life of their dreams! Solve fun match-3 puzzles to collect coins and use them to select furniture, decor items and more! These lucky clients have very different personalities, needs and ideas but they have one thing in common: They all have high expectations for you to design an amazing home! Can you help them create spaces to relax, enjoy and spend quality time? Because after all a house without character is just a house. Help your clients to turn these houses into sweet designer homes.
It's not going to be easy. You'll have to work and play your way up from the bottom, makeover different rooms and places to become a real designer and put a smile on your clients' faces. Do you have what it takes to remodel, decorate and furbish dream homes and become a household name in the home design game world?
Here's how to do it:
Meet interior designer Chloe and Liam. Couples, singles and families, all kinds of clients are waiting for you!
Design, renovate, remodel kitchens, living rooms, bedrooms and more in Modern City! Choose furniture and decor according to your style and preferences. Simply tap to decorate and create trendy places in the city.
Exciting and addictive Match-3 puzzle games! Play puzzles to collect coins and use them to create your perfect home design!
Enjoy witty and fun conversations among interior designers and clients!
Express yourself and nurture your interior design skills! Plus, find inspiration for your own home makeover!
Play for free and offline!
New episodes and match-3 puzzle levels coming out soon!
Are you into the city life? Guam, Hawaii and the Caribbean won't do the trick for you? Come to NYC and play Modern City! Find inspiration, collect high-quality furniture, and decorate with enchanting colors and patterns. Build and design homes and make dreams come true in this match-3 puzzle and home design game! Create a home you'll never want to leave! 
*Please note that [ Modern City ] saves your progress on your device. Data will be reset if you delete the app or change your device.*
------------------------------------------------

Join us on Facebook for fun stuff and news about your favorite games!

bluejetty:00188144:ios.name: Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji
bluejetty:00188144:ios.summary: Guru Granth Sahib is the religious scripture of Sikhism, regarded by Sikhs as the final, sovereign, and eternal living Guru following the lineage of the ten human Gurus of the Sikh religion. Adi Granth, the first rendition, was compiled by
bluejetty:00188144:ios.description:
Guru Granth Sahib is the religious scripture of Sikhism, regarded by Sikhs as the final, sovereign, and eternal living Guru following the lineage of the ten human Gurus of the Sikh religion. Adi Granth, the first rendition, was compiled by the fifth Sikh Guru, Guru Arjan. Guru Gobind Singh, the tenth Sikh Guru, added one salok, dohra mahala 9 ang, 1429 and all 115 hymns of Guru Tegh Bahadur. This second rendition came to be known as Sri Guru Granth Sahib.
The text consists of 1430 angs (pages) and 6,000 shabads (line compositions), which are poetically rendered and set to a rhythmic ancient north Indian classical form of music. The bulk of the scripture is divided into thirty-one ragas, with each Granth raga subdivided according to length and author. The hymns in the scripture are arranged primarily by the ragas in which they are read. The Guru Granth Sahib is written in the Gurmukhi script, in various languages, including Lahnda (Western Punjabi), Braj Bhasha, Khariboli, Sanskrit, Sindhi, and Persian. Copies in these languages often have the generic title of Sant Bhasha.
Guru Granth Sahib was composed by seven Sikh Gurus: Guru Nanak Dev, Guru Angad Dev, Guru Amar Das, Guru Ram Das, Guru Arjan Dev, Guru Hargobind and Guru Tegh Bahadur. Guru Gobind Singh added 1 sloakh in mahala 9 Ang 1429. It also contains the traditions and teachings of Indian sants (saints), such as Ravidas, Ramananda, Kabir and Namdev among others, and two Muslim Sufi saints Bhagat Bhikan and Sheikh Farid.
The vision in the Guru Granth Sahib is of a society based on divine justice without oppression of any kind.

bluejetty:00015891:ios.name: Wyzant - Find a tutor
bluejetty:00015891:ios.summary:
BETTER GRADES ARE A TAP AWAY
The Wyzant App makes it easy for parents and students to instantly connect with expert tutors for in-person and online lessons.
- Find your ideal tutor: We have more tutors covering more subjects than anywhere
bluejetty:00015891:ios.description:
BETTER GRADES ARE A TAP AWAY
The Wyzant App makes it easy for parents and students to instantly connect with expert tutors for in-person and online lessons.
- Find your ideal tutor: We have more tutors covering more subjects than anywhere else. Easily compare tutors and their ratings, student reviews, backgrounds, and fees.
- Enjoy easy booking: Find tutors available today, tomorrow, this week or at times that work for you.
- Instantly connect: Chat in real time. Ask tutors questions and get answers right away.
- Track progress: See all lesson summaries and messages in one place. 
- Get helpful reminders: See upcoming lessons and other important notifications right on your phone.
- Give feedback: Add a review to your tutor’s profile after your first lesson.
EXPERT HELP IN MATH, TEST PREP, LEVEL-UP CAREER SKILLS AND MUCH MORE
We have thousands of professional tutors with more certified and retired teachers than anywhere else. Whether you want your elementary school child to learn core skills or need help with college level or higher classes, we can help you find your ideal tutor. 
- Tutors for K-5: Help your elementary school child be more confident both in and out of the classroom. Build core skills in reading, writing, math, and studying. From help with multiplication to explaining new Common Core teaching methods, we make it easy to find the right tutor for your child.
- Middle school and high school tutors: From chemistry to calculus to history, we have experts ready to help your child succeed in math, science, and more. Help your child ace exams and stay on track for college. 
- College tutors: Get last-minute study help online or take ongoing lessons for tough subjects. From economics to trigonometry, we make it easy to master difficult subjects.
- Math help: Get expert help in algebra, trigonometry, calculus, statistics, and every advanced math class in between.
- Test prep tutors: We have professional tutors who specialize in helping students prep for tests, so you can be confident on your test day. Find expert tutors for PSAT, ACT, SAT, LSAT, MCAT, GRE and much more. 
- Language tutors: No matter which language you want to master, we can put you in touch with an expert private tutor—from English, to Spanish, to French, and beyond.
- Online tutoring: When you meet with a tutor online using Wyzant, you can video chat with a tutor and collaborate on an interactive whiteboard that includes several robust and easy-to-use features. 
EXPERT TUTORS RIGHT AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
We make it easy to quickly connect with tutors and stay in touch, while you’re on the go.
SEE TUTORS’ SCHEDULES AT A GLANCE
Set up regular lesson times easily to help you meet your goals. You can also see if your tutor is available for a last-minute lesson before a test or any time you want an extra study session.
MEET WITH YOUR TUTOR ONLINE OR IN PERSON
Tutor profiles on Wyzant will tell you if a tutor offers both in-person and online lessons. Meet with your tutor where and when it works best for you.
FIND AN EXPERT ANYTIME YOU NEED ONE
With the Wyzant App, you can quickly connect with new subject matter experts—from chemistry to Spanish tutors—at any time. Plus, get homework help, prep for an exam, or answers to your questions quickly and easily.
HOW IT WORKS
Start learning with your ideal tutor today. 
1. Answer a few simple questions, and we’ll introduce you to the experts.
2. Instantly connect with tutors who fit your needs and your schedule.
3. Easily add your payment information and book lessons on the go.
4. See grades and confidence improve or go get that promotion!
MORE ABOUT WYZANT
As the world’s leading tutoring network, we help more students in more places than anyone else. We’re dedicated to helping everyone achieve their personal and academic goals and provide a yearly college scholarship contest through our website.
See our privacy policy here: https://support.wyzant.com/hc/en-us/articles/360023028492

bluejetty:00187061:ios.description:
Week Plan is a Task Management app that makes entrepreneurs and teams more effective in their tasks and in achieving their goals. 
Rather than focusing on completing all the tasks and be productive, Week Plan lets you focus on essential tasks. This ensures that you put your best foot on tasks that are in line with your business objectives. 
Inspired by the book, 7 Habits of Highly Effective People by Stephen Covey and OKR (Objective, Key Results) framework, Week Plan is designed to make you and your team more efficient at work.
Trusted by over half a million users, Week Plan has everything you and your team need to plan and achieve your company’s objectives and goals effectively.
Tons of capabilities to make you and your team more effective at work
Objective Key Results
Plan your high impact tasks and objectives using the revolutionary OKR (Objective, Key Results) Framework.
Setup Objectives: Setup and add as many objectives you want to set for each workspace.
Track Key Results: Add and track key results on objectives and monitor you and your team’s progress on them. 
Setup OKR for each team: Add and track separate OKR’s for each team individually.
Task Management 
Add and manage high impact tasks, subtasks and recurring tasks for you and your team. 
High Impact Tasks: Week Plan helps you to integrate all your high impact tasks into your schedule easily.
Add Sub Tasks: Add as many subtasks as you want with their description, deadlines, priority and more. 
Set Repetitive Tasks: Add any recurring task like weekly meetings or reporting once and it will be automatically added to the schedule, whenever you want it to be.
Time Tracking
Setup and Track time took on each task, project, and goal of your entire team.
Track your and your Team’s Time on each Task: Week Plan helps you to get a complete view of each task and subtask of your team.
Track Time across High Impact Tasks & Goals: Tracking the time on high impact tasks and goals helps you to focus and evaluate your time on important tasks and goals.
Pomodoro Timer: Boost time productivity of your entire team by achieving more in short bursts of time using the Pomodoro timer.
Team Task Collaboration
Cultivate team collaboration and let the people do great things together.
Team Tasks and Goals: Create goals for your team and set a twelve-week plan for your projects that you can track weekly. 
Add as Many Team Members You Like: Add and manage all your team members even if you have 10 or 1000 employees in your team.
Easily Share Progress and Deliverables with the Team: Get a central place to share the team progress as well as any deliverables that comes along.
Subscription
Week Plan lets you choose between 2 different subscription plans. Each plan comes with a 7 days Free Trial which can be easily extended with 19 more days or 26 days in total by doing basic operations on the app.
Here are the details of the two subscription plans. For both plans there is a 20% discount if annual billing plan is opted.
1) Pro
Monthly: $10 / Month
Yearly: $ 104 / Year (billed on $8.67 / month X 12)
2) Ultimate
Monthly: $16.25 / Month
Yearly: $156 / Year (billed on $13 / month X 12)
The price is mentioned in US Dollar (USD)
The length of subscription is either monthly or yearly ( depending on the plan selected)
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase or when your trial period expires
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
 For more information, see our Terms Of Service and Privacy Policy.
https://weekplan.net/terms

bluejetty:00166044:ios.description:
Discover the Value of Your Coins & Banknotes with HeritCoin
HeritCoin is the ultimate app for identifying, authenticating, and valuing coins and banknotes. Powered by AI technology and professional appraisal services, HeritCoin makes it easier than ever to enhance your numismatic collection. Whether you’re a numismatist, collector, or hobbyist, HeritCoin offers accurate results to help you understand the true value of your items.
Key Features:
Effortless Identification
Simply take a photo of your coin or banknote, and HeritCoin uses advanced AI recognition to instantly provide details such as the name, year, material, weight, and more.
Expert Appraisal Services
Need a professional opinion? HeritCoin connects you with numismatic experts for precise authentication and valuation, ensuring your collection is accurately assessed.
Accurate Valuations Based on Market Data
HeritCoin offers price estimates based on real-time market trends, auction results, and historical data, giving you confidence in the value of your items.
Comprehensive Recognition
HeritCoin can identify a wide range of coins and banknotes, from modern U.S. currency to rare ancient relics, including error coins and more.
Organize Your Collection
Easily manage and track your collection with an intuitive app interface. Gain new insights and better organize your items as you scan them.
How It Works:
 1. Take a photo of both sides of a coin or banknote.
 2. Receive detailed information, including specifications, value, and historical context.
Why Choose HeritCoin?
 • AI & Expert-Powered Identification: Trust in AI technology and numismatic professionals for the most reliable results.
 • User-Friendly: Simple and quick identification steps make it easy for collectors of all experience levels.
 • Wide Range: From rare ancient coins to modern banknotes, HeritCoin identifies all types of currency.
 • Constantly Improving: Enjoy a regularly updated database and new features that enhance your experience.
Stay Tuned for New Features!
We’re continuously working on new features to improve your experience with HeritCoin. Stay tuned for exciting updates!

🐛Welcome to the world of “Eat to Evolve”!🐛
It is a mysterious level evolution world where you can gain new experiences by playing as a little worm. If you want to succeed and upgrade levels, focus on eating, evolution, upgrade, and survival, not others!
In this free simulator game, your goals are simple but challenging: to eat as much as you can to speed up your evolution; and, to beat your enemies to become the strongest monster in the mystery of lost land!
🐞HOW TO PLAY🐞
Eat to Evolve is an insect evolution survival game with a lot of actions in grasslands and tons of cute or scary creatures! Start with and take control of a tiny and always-hungry worm to attack and survive as long as possible by devouring everything and everyone in “your” way! But hey, watch out! You cannot let pesky enemies make dinner out of you!
🦖GAME FEATURES🦖
🪵Free and easy-to-play
🪵Hundreds of levels to upgrade
🪵Extremely satisfying and smooth in-game movement
🪵More than a dozen unique creature species and monsters are waiting for you to EAT!
🪵Over 50 types of wild insects and secret fruits to unlock
🪵Activate Gold Rush to grow faster and bigger!
🪵Special in-game events and limited prizes
If you like free casual games, Eat to Evolve is the right one for you! You can explore another new world, concentrate on eating and feeding yourself with non-toxic food to boost your predatory powers, and join countless battles to be the evolution legends.
🌵Many adventures are waiting for you! Why not start to play and upgrade your levels now? 🌵
