bluejetty:00183743:ios.description:
The PBA Mobile App is available for all Paychex Benefit Account subscribers. 
Available features will vary and are dependent upon your employer’s plan options.
Save time and hassles while making the most of your HSA, HRA, and FSA health benefit accounts by quickly checking your balances and details. Our secure app makes managing your health benefits easy through real-time access and intuitive navigation to all your important account information on the go! Powerful features of the app include:
Easy, Convenient & Secure
• Simply login to the intuitive app using your same Paychex login you use to view payroll information to now manage your Paychex Benefit Account
• No sensitive account information is ever stored on your mobile device
Connects You with the Details
• Quickly check available balances 24/7
• View charts summarizing account(s)
• View claims requiring receipts
• Click to call or email Customer Service
Provides Additional Time-Saving Options (if supported or applicable to your account(s))
• File a claim towards your medical FSA and HRA
• Use your camera or Cloud Storage options to upload receipts to submit for a new or existing claim
• View, contribute and distribute HSA transactions
• Pay bills from any account and add a payee
• Using the Dashboard, enter medical expense information and supporting documentation
• Retrieve your forgot username/password
• Report a debit card as lost or stolen

bluejetty:00013979:ios.description:
Find more than 175,000 cars, trucks, SUVs motorcycles, boats, classics, exotics and more with the Copart Mobile App. Using the Copart Mobile App, Basic and Premier Members can bid on and win vehicles quickly and easily from any mobile device. Copart features thousands of used car auctions with both salvage and clean title vehicles available every day. 
The Copart App allows Basic and Premier Members to participate in insurance auto auctions that feature used cars, repossessions and more. And best of all, Copart Basic and Premier Members can access these used car auctions from anywhere with an internet connection. Members will be able to find vehicles like “salvage cars for sale” by type, year, make, model and location as well as stay informed about vehicles on their Watchlist. • Voice Search to quickly find vehicles
• Welcome Tour for new users to explore the app’s top features
• Convenient access to online auctions, vehicle finder, and search history
• Manage Watchlist, saved searches and pre-bids
• Search over 175,000 vehicles in online auto auctions by location, date, and vehicle type
• View full-screen photos and details for any car or truck
• Quickly search global inventory for vehicles by make, model, year, location and more
• Receive notifications about counterbid offers, auctions won, auctions lost and Watchlist vehicles
• View AutoCheck vehicle history reports and Copart Condition Reports

bluejetty:00179031:ios.description:
A genuine mahjong layout and classic matching game mechanics are combined in Tile Dark to give you a completely new gameplay experience! Collect tiles in a row, get a triple match and solve logic puzzle level by level!
Match 3 same tiles in a field at the bottom of the screen to blast them. Merge all triple blocks and unlock tricky majong puzzles. It’s easy at the beginning and as you progress you'll find more challenging levels. Use logic and strategic skills to get through! This matching puzzle suits all ages.
How to play:
Tap and move any tile onto the board at the bottom. Merge 3 same tiles to get a match and blast it. Find triple matches as fast as possible to collect more stars! How to win? Just find all triple tile combinations and complete the level. If you have seven or more tiles on the board - try again and match them all!
Why Tile Dark is so addictive:
- Each tile board is different: challenge yourself with new majong layouts
- Lots of colorful blocks: trees, animals, tasty desserts, flowers, fruits and more!
- New challenging mechanics to train the brain!

bluejetty:00151660:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00151660:ios.description:
A mobile terminal designed for AI coding agents. Your coding agent runs on a server — you're not always at your desk. Moshi bridges that gap.
BUILT FOR AI AGENTS
Check on Claude Code from the couch. Nudge Codex from the coffee shop. Monitor Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, or Aider from anywhere. Your agent doesn't sleep, and now neither does your access to it.
TALK, DON'T TYPE
Voice-to-terminal with on-device AI. Command your agent hands-free using Whisper speech recognition. No cloud, no latency — everything runs locally on your device.
NEVER DROPS
Powered by the Mosh protocol that survives network switches, sleep mode, and subway tunnels. Your session stays alive no matter what.
GET NOTIFIED
Webhook alerts when tasks complete. Start a long-running job, pocket your phone, and live your life. Get a push notification when it's done.
FACE ID FOR SSH KEYS
Biometric unlock for your SSH keys. Private keys stored securely in iOS Keychain, protected by Face ID or Touch ID. Never stored in the app.
PROPER KEYBOARD
A terminal keyboard built for real work. Ctrl, Esc, Tab, arrows, and Tmux shortcuts. Not an afterthought — designed for terminal power users.
SESSION RESUME
Sessions persist across app switches. Come back anytime and pick up where you left off. Your terminal state is always waiting.
PRIVACY FIRST
- SSH keys stored in iOS Keychain with biometric protection
- Voice dictation runs entirely on-device
- No passwords or keys transmitted to our servers
- All terminal data stays on your device
A terminal that picks up — and never hangs up.
Privacy Policy: https://getmoshi.app/privacy
Terms of Service: https://getmoshi.app/terms

bluejetty:00083884:ios.description:
Block Escape: Tap Away! Get Ready to Crush Blocks!
Immerse yourself in the exciting world of Block Escape, where you slide to clear blocks and conquer challenging as traffic jam puzzles. Your objective is simple: strategically move blocks to advance through levels. Whether you're a fan of classic sliding wooden puzzles or enjoy solving car jam puzzles, this game is tailor-made for you!
How to Play:
1. Tap Away Blocks: Just tap blocks to escape. Clear the board with limited moves to win!
2. Break Through Obstacles: Smash chains and roadblocks to release your blocks!
3. Mystery Awaits: Wisely use game mechanisms as tools. Try rotators, saws, bombs, etc to eliminate blocks. You won't get bored.
4. Stuck? Fun Props to Help: Rockets and Hammers are there to blast obstacles and guide you to victory.
Features:
- Relaxing Gameplay: Simple taps bring relaxing and enjoyable game experience.
- Engaging Levels: Over 1000 exciting levels await you to unlock.
- Strategic Taps: Train your brain with each tap as you navigate through challenging levels.
- Brain-Boosting: Clever tactics are needed to conquer challenging levels with limited moves.
- Puzzle Focus: Dive into puzzles without distractions through a clean interface.
- Play Anywhere: Relax and enjoy the game at your own pace, no rush!
Contact Us:
We keep updating this game! Please contact us if you have any questions or suggestions.
Email: grabjoystudio@outlook.com

Immerse yourself in the exciting world of Block Escape, where you slide to clear blocks and conquer challenging as traffic jam puzzles. Your objective is simple: strategically move blocks to advance through levels. Whether you're a fan of classic sliding wooden puzzles or enjoy solving car jam puzzles, this game is tailor-made for you!

How to Play:
1. Tap Away Blocks: Just tap blocks to escape. Clear the board with limited moves to win!
2. Break Through Obstacles: Smash chains and roadblocks to release your blocks!
3. Mystery Awaits: Wisely use game mechanisms as tools. Try rotators, saws, bombs, etc to eliminate blocks. You won't get bored.
4. Stuck? Fun Props to Help: Rockets and Hammers are there to blast obstacles and guide you to victory.

Features:
- Relaxing Gameplay: Simple taps bring relaxing and enjoyable game experience.
- Engaging Levels: Over 1000 exciting levels await you to unlock.
- Strategic Taps: Train your brain with each tap as you navigate through challenging levels.
- Brain-Boosting: Clever tactics are needed to conquer challenging levels with limited moves.
- Puzzle Focus: Dive into puzzles without distractions through a clean interface.
- Play Anywhere: Relax and enjoy the game at your own pace, no rush!

Contact Us:
We keep updating this game! Please contact us if you have any questions or suggestions.
Email: grabjoystudio@outlook.com

Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/eula-of-grabjoy-limited
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/grabjoy-limited

bluejetty:00018868:ios.description:
- Winner of “Excellence in Gameplay” Award in IMGA SEA 2017 -
"My surprise of the week." - Eli Hodapp, TouchArcade
"...it definitely stands out in the puzzle genre." - AppAddict.net
Alien Path combines RPG, Puzzle, Path-Planning and Strategy for an out-of-this-world gaming experience. Players must eliminate enemies by cleverly navigating the aliens on a path to destroy the invading robots. Every move counts, so set a path and pave your way to rescuing your planet and eventually the galaxy.
Travel from planet to planet as you face of the invading Robots who are hell-bent on destroying all living civilization. Hatch new ascended Aliens, discover legendary powers and set your self on a path of robot destruction - all life in the universe is counting on you!
Features:
• Unique Gameplay : A completely fresh, never before seen RPG Puzzle game
• Hatch New Aliens : 16 different Aliens to hatch and upgrade, each with unique strengths
• Power Cards : Collect over 100 Alien Power cards with thousands of skill combinations
• Card Evolution : Break the upgrade limit and further strengthen your cards with runes!
• Everchanging Levels : More than 300 levels with unique enemies, obstacles and power-ups to challenge your strategy!
• Mind Blowing Strategy: Limitless battle tactics to employ with hundreds of passive and active skills
• Character customization: Multiple ways to develop your Aliens and Power Cards
• Guild System : Join a guild to earn exclusive Bolts to upgrade cards, share decks and compete in weekly world rankings!
• Face fearsome Giant Boss Robots and against their numerous Robot Tech
• A Whole New Dimension: Unlock Parallel Planets take your battles to the next level
• Fresh Challenges: Participate in special daily events and unique planets with set rules and challenges
• Friends Spirit : Lend a helping hand to friends with Spirit to explore the whole galaxy
If you face any technical issues on your device, please contact us and we will try to address the issue as soon as possible.
Support Email : support@appxplore.com
For latest news, updates, and events, follow us on:

Youtube : http://www.youtube.com/user/appxplore
Instagram : http://www.instagram.com/appxplore

Download Dream Chaser now and dive into a world where tradition meets endless fun!

bluejetty:00141468:ios.description:
Chega de complexidade na hora de começar sua carreira na aviação civil!
Com o Super App da Agência Nacional de Aviação Civil (Anac), sua jornada profissional na aviação civil se torna mais simples, rápida e fácil.
Disponível inicialmente para aspirantes a piloto privado de avião, piloto privado de helicóptero e piloto de planejador, o aplicativo reúne tudo o que você precisa em um único lugar, na palma da sua mão.
Você pode fazer a gestão dos cursos que realizará, realizar o pagamento para emissão da Carteira de Habilitação Técnica (CHT), contabilizar suas horas de voo, consultar clínicas e médicos credenciados para seus exames médicos, e muito mais.
O app da Anac te leva para uma experiência única, fácil e completa, apresentando todas as etapas de sua formação na aviação civil e te guiando de forma simples pela sua evolução profissional.
A versão inicial do aplicativo oferece as seguintes funcionalidades:
· Iniciar jornada de obtenção de licença (piloto privado de avião, piloto privado de executivo e piloto de planejador)
· Consultar clínicas e médicos para obter seu Certificado Médico Aeronáutico (CMA)
· Consultar escolas de aviação para realização dos cursos e exames necessários durante sua jornada
· Consultar extrato de voos realizados
· Confirmar horas de voo pendentes
· Consultar o CMA
· Enviar o comprovante de escolaridade para cumprimento dos requisitos da jornada
· Visualizar os seus endossos recuperados (verificar, navegação de voo solo e voo solo).
· Solicitar e emitir a Taxa de Fiscalização da Aviação Civil (TFAC) e consultar o Certificado de Habilitação Técnica (CHT) Digital
[:mav: 3.0.0]

Count up from a
bluejetty:00185687:ios.description:
Countdown Star is the best way to countdown to — and count up from — all of your favorite events.
Countdown to birthdays, holidays, an upcoming vacation, a wedding, the New Year, parties, sporting events, concerts and more.
Count up from anniversaries, the day you were born, and other special events in the past.
* How many seconds until your next birthday?
* How many months since you were born?
* How many days until you graduate from college?
* How many hours until your anniversary?
* How much time is left until your vacation starts?
* How many days until Christmas?
* How many minutes until your party begins?
* How much time is left until your baby's due date?
Countdown Star is the countdown app that lets you choose which events to add, then keeps them in sync across all of your devices.
Features:
* iCloud Sync — events and wallpapers sync automatically across all your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch devices
* Celebration Animations — choose Confetti, Fireworks, Balloons, Stars, or Lasers when your countdown reaches zero
* Repeating Events — annual events automatically advance to the next year so you never have to update them
* Home Screen Widgets — Small, Medium, and Large widgets let you glance at your countdowns without opening the app
* Apple Watch — view your events right on your wrist
* Add Your Own Events — add as many events as you like
* Custom Wallpapers — choose from 15+ built-in wallpapers or use your own photos
* Time Zone Support — set each event in any time zone with localized city names
* Sort and Search — sort by date, title, or your own custom order; events are sectioned into Countdown and Count Up groups
* Favorites and Notifications — mark events as favorites to receive a notification when their countdown reaches zero
* Interactive Slider — instantly switch between seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, or years to see your countdown exactly how you want it
* Customizable Timer — choose timer position (Top, Middle, or Bottom), show or hide weeks, and toggle the leading zero
* Multiple App Icons — personalize the app icon on your Home Screen
Note: Countdown Star is available as a free version (with ads and an optional Remove Ads purchase) and as a paid ad-free version.

NutriSnap: Calorie Counter & Tracker
NutriSnap is a lightweight calorie counter app, built to keep nutrition tracking simple and out of your way.

4 ways to log your food:

Themes — Personalize NutriSnap with light, modern and dark themes to match your style

Whether your goal is weight loss, muscle gain, or simply eating better, NutriSnap removes the friction from food tracking, so you actually stick with it.
Join hundreds of thousands using NutriSnap to build a healthier lifestyle, one meal at a time.
Download NutriSnap today and make calorie counting effortless.

bluejetty:00115143:ios.name: Reverse Audio: Sound Challenge
bluejetty:00115143:ios.summary:
Ever wondered what your voice sounds like backward?
Reverse Audio turns everyday sounds into playful challenges. Record a phrase and reverse it instantly, copy what you hear, then reverse your attempt to see how close you got. You can also
bluejetty:00115143:ios.description:
Ever wondered what your voice sounds like backward?
Reverse Audio turns everyday sounds into playful challenges. Record a phrase and reverse it instantly, copy what you hear, then reverse your attempt to see how close you got. You can also import audio or video, try playful voice effects, and use songs from your device for a guess-the-song challenge with friends.
RECORD & REVERSE
Record your voice and play it forward or backward. Create secret messages, funny conversations, and creative voice clips in seconds.
TRY THE REVERSE-MIMIC CHALLENGE
Listen to a reversed phrase, imitate it as closely as you can, and process your recording to hear the result. Check your score and feedback, then try again to improve your timing, pronunciation, and accuracy.
IMPORT AUDIO & VIDEO
Import audio files or videos from your device and reverse them with a few taps. Videos from 1 to 60 seconds are supported, with output up to 1080p.
PLAY WITH YOUR OWN MUSIC
Add songs stored on your device, choose a clip, and turn it into a backward music challenge. Try mimicking the reversed clip yourself, or hand your phone to a friend and see if they can name the song.
Only import and process content you own or have permission to use.
EXPLORE VOICE EFFECTS
Give recordings a playful twist with robot, chipmunk, deep voice, echo, slow-motion, and other effects. Preview an effect before saving your creation. Some voice effects require a subscription to unlock. Free and premium availability is shown in the app.
KEEP EVERYTHING ORGANIZED
History keeps your recordings, reversed videos, mimic challenges, song challenges, and voice-effect creations together for easy playback and review.
GREAT FOR:
● Reverse-mimic and guess-the-song challenges with friends
● Funny voice messages and creative audio clips
● Playful voice effects
● Short reversed video clips
● Parties, challenges, and everyday creativity
SUBSCRIPTIONS
The app includes free features. Some voice effects and premium features can be unlocked with a subscription. Current benefits, pricing, and any available trial details are shown on the subscription screen in the app.
If you choose an auto-renewable subscription, payment will be charged to your Apple Account when the purchase is confirmed. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.
PRIVACY & TERMS
We care about your privacy. For details about how data and permissions are handled, please review:
Privacy Policy: https://audioreverse.mobiunityhk.com/legal/privacy
Terms of Use: https://audioreverse.mobiunityhk.com/legal/terms
Questions or suggestions? Use the in-app feedback option or email spinmaster616@gmail.com.
Download Reverse Audio, record your voice, play it backward, and discover more fun ways to explore sound with friends.

bluejetty:00089551:ios.description:
iPhone Storage Full? Lagging when taking photos? 100+ duplicate selfies cluttering your album?
Cleaner Plan — 100% Local iOS Device Storage Cleaner — fixes it all in 1 minute! Delete duplicates, organize screenshots, free up GBs of space. No data upload, zero privacy risk.
Core Features (Solve Your Pain Points)
●Duplicate Photo Remover
Tired of 10 similar selfies cluttering your album? Let our AI quickly find duplicate and similar photos. With one tap, you can remove hundreds or even thousands of them—potentially freeing up gigabytes of space.
● Screenshot Organizer 
Fed up with 100 old screenshots taking up space? We auto-sort screenshots by date (e.g., "Work Screenshots," "Shopping Screenshots") and let you delete outdated ones in bulk. Keep your album tidy for new memories.
● Video Duplicate Cleaner 
Wasting space on 3 copies of the same travel video? Scan and identify redundant clips quickly—Easily manage your storage and make room for what matters—like your new movies and family videos.
● Calendar Cleanup 
Annoyed by expired meeting reminders or duplicate events? We automatically detect and delete old/duplicate schedules—your calendar stays clear, so you can find upcoming plans in 10 seconds.
●Contact Manager & Local Backup 
Frustrated by 3 copies of the same contact (e.g., "Mom" vs. "Mom 2")? Merge duplicates, fix incomplete info (like missing phone numbers), and back up contacts locally on your iPhone. Never lose important numbers again.
Why You’ll Love Cleaner Plan
●Free Up Space for More Memories：Delete 1000+ duplicate files, store 500 new photos/videos from your next trip or birthday party.
● Faster iPhone Performance：Less storage burden = apps open 2x faster, no more lag when taking photos or opening social media.
●Tidy All Your Data：Albums, videos, calendar, contacts—all organized like new. Find what you need without endless scrolling.
●100% Local Privacy Protection：All cleaning (photos, contacts, videos) happens only on your iPhone. No data leaves your device, so you never have to worry about leaks.
Free Trial & Subscription 
●7-Day Free Trial：Unlock ALL Pro features during your trial—including batch video deletion, lifetime contact backup, and ad-free experience. Try everything before paying, no hidden fees.
●Subscription Options：Choose from Weekly or Annual plans to fit your needs. Annual subscribers save 60% compared to weekly plans.
●Flexible Cancellation：Auto-renewal activates 24 hours before your trial/subscription ends—but you can cancel anytime before then to avoid charges. Enjoy full access during your active period, no strings attached.
●How to Cancel：Open iPhone "Settings" → Tap your Apple ID → Select "Subscriptions" → Find "Cleaner Plan" → Tap "Cancel Subscription".

bluejetty:00166343:ios.description:
Welcome to Stronghold Dude: Build Your Medieval Empire.
Are you ready to start your epic journey and build your own city and empire? Dive into the immersive world of Stronghold Dude, a tycoon game that lets you shape your success story! Try to survive in this epic world full of battles, stories about knights and princesses, and legendary dragons.
Download Stronghold Dude: Battles and Conquest now and play for absolutely FREE, a game of survival, tactics, planning, battles, and magical adventures.
- Resources are the basis of prosperity 
Effective management of resources is the key to the success of any civilization. Create an optimal system of collection, storage, and distribution of resources.
- Expand your Kingdom
By building sawmills and weapons workshops, we contribute to the development of our civilization, transforming it from a peaceful settlement into a powerful military power. Gather resources, strengthen your army, build a powerful economy, and defend your borders.
- Grow your own Battle Dragon!
Your dragon will evolve from a hatchling to a fearsome adult.
Equip it with armor, sharpen its claws, and unleash it in epic battles.
- Fight the Robbers and Defeat the Formidable Bosses
Enjoy awesome raids and epic battles in Stronghold Dude: Fight & Survive. Improve your fighting skills and become a real knight capable of protecting your settlement. Destroy bosses in epic clashes and collect magical rewards. And the main goal is to save the princess from the hands of the evil king.
- Command your own army
Craft a variety of weapons in the armory, providing the army with a deadly tool for defense. Recruit new warriors and improve their skills in battles. Your army becomes your shield against invaders and a force to reckon with on the battlefield.
Choose your own strategy for the development of your kingdom. Will you be a benevolent ruler, a cunning strategist, or a ruthless conqueror? Tycoon games let you make this choice, choose correctly - the survival of your medieval empire lies in your hands!

bluejetty:00133469:ios.description:
Are you ready for a colorful 3D puzzle parking games that can keep you entertained for hours? Introducing Parking Fever 3D - Unblock Car, a perfect game for testing your IQ score and strategic thinking. Your mission is really simple, clear out all the cars in the parking lot and find a smooth exit. But do not be happy yet, since the higher levels you play, the more difficult and angry grannies you're gonna meet! 
The parking lot is now full of angry horns! Help out the citizens by navigating them to the right exit.The parking lot can be overwhelming at first, but don't worry - with a bit of strategy and quick thinking, you can handle this challenge! 
HOW TO PLAY PARKING FEVER 3D - UNBLOCK CAR:

bluejetty:00159435:ios.description:
EaseMe is an application designed to accompany you and help you develop good habits in managing your mental and physical health. We incorporate foundational theories such as cognitive behavioral therapy and aim to change your life through small, engaging activities. Our ultimate goal is to enable more people to lead happier and healthier lives through effective self-care.
What Problems Does EaseMe Help You Solve:
--- Effective Emotion Tracking and Management
Emotions are neither inherently good nor bad; what matters is accepting their variability and fluidity. We believe that establishing good emotional management skills is more important than suppressing emotions. This is our goal: to help our users cultivate the habit of recognizing, tracking, and managing their emotions until it becomes a natural part of their lifestyle, allowing them to lead healthy and fulfilling lives. Additionally, we provide regular emotional record reports to give you a clearer picture of your emotional state.
--- Effective Planning Management
Want to make a change but don’t know how to create a plan? Want to change but unsure how to stick with it?
Here, you can find solutions. We offer dozens of planning suggestions across various dimensions, and through engaging gamified design, we make your self-care process enjoyable rather than tedious.
--- Various Tools
We provide a range of tools related to self-care, such as breathing exercises, reflection exercises, mood tracking, soundscapes, and more, offering comprehensive support for your physical and mental well-being.
Privacy and Security
We value your personal data security and privacy. EaseMe APP only reads and writes data directly on your device, and all your personal data is stored locally.
Welcome to contact us and give us your valuable suggestions or comments!
support@seabn.com
Disclaimer of Health Advice
All information and suggestions provided by EaseMe should not be considered as medical advice or diagnosis, and should not replace professional diagnosis and treatment. If you experience significant emotional fluctuations that you cannot regulate, please seek help from a professional doctor promptly.

bluejetty:00066400:ios:0.description:
Join the millions of riders who trust Uber for their everyday travel needs. Whether you’re running an errand across town or exploring a city far from home, getting there should be easy.
FIND THE RIDE YOU WANT
Find the perfect ride right at your fingertips! Uber is here to make your journey stress-free and enjoyable.
Pick from a wide range of products that the Uber app has to offer including: 
- UberX: Affordable rides, all to yourself
- Electric: Eco-Friendly
- UberXL: Affordable rides for groups up to 6
- Comfort: Newer cars with extra legroom
- Comfort Electric: Premium zero-emission cars
- Uber Pet: Affordable rides for you and your pet
- Black: Luxury rides with professional drivers
- Taxi: You now have the option to request a cab or a taxi on demand using Uber in select cities
- 2-wheels: Find a scooter to start riding roday 
UPFRONT PRICING
With Uber, you no longer need to worry about hidden costs or unexpected surprises. As you enter your destination in the app, you get upfront pricing and the estimated time of arrival.
SAFETY TOGETHER
Safety is a top priority at Uber. We have established comprehensive safety features to help ensure every rider and driver feels secure and comfortable.
AFFORDABLE PRICING
We’re doing all we can to make our pricing as transparent as possible.
- UberX Share: UberX Share connects you to other riders headed in the same direction. 
- Group Rides: Share the journey with friends.
- Split Fare: Don’t worry about doing the math later—split the cost evenly while you’re still on the ride. 
JOIN UBER ONE FOR EXCLUSIVE PERKS
Benefit from $0 Delivery Fee and up to 10% off eligible delivery and pickup orders, 6% Uber Cash back on eligible rides and a $5 credit if our Latest Arrival Estimate on your order is off. Other fees & terms apply. For more details see uber.com/uberone.
RESERVE RIDES IN ADVANCE
Need a ride at a specific time? No problem! Uber allows you to reserve rides in advance, so you can plan your day with confidence. 
GO GREEN
Uber is committed to building a sustainable future for our cities. With a growing fleet of electric and hybrid vehicles, you can choose eco-friendly rides to reduce your carbon footprint.
RENT CARS 
Whether you need a car today or later, the online booking experience and vehicle selection will help you find the right vehicle for a family vacation, a weekend getaway, airport travel, errands and more.
MORE FEATURES
Delivery: Order food from your favorite restaurants through Uber Eats. Stock up on groceries, shop pharmacy, convenience and pet supplies and get them all delivered. 
Uber Connect: an easy, same-day, no-contact delivery solution that allows people to send items whether it’s a care package for a loved one or an item you sold online.
Transit: Say goodbye to complicated time schedules, hectic transfers, and unexpected waits while reducing your trip’s emissions.
Uber Charter: Book high-capacity group rides in vehicles seating 14-55 passengers, such as limo buses, luxury vans, and coach buses.
2-Wheels: Did you know you can also bike or ride a scooter with the Uber app?
Uber for Business: Manage and track business travel, meal programs, and more on one dashboard.
Uber Hourly: Keep a car and driver with you for hours. 
Uber Car Seat: Uber Car Seat provides one forward-facing car seat for a child who is at least 2 years old, 22 pounds, and 31 inches tall.
Get Started Now! Download the Uber app and create an account today. Uber is available in the following cities: Boston, DC, LA, New York, San Francisco, Vegas, Orlando, Chicago and more. Check if Uber is available in your city at https://www.uber.com/cities. Stay updated on the latest news, promotions, and offers by following us on Twitter at https://twitter.com/uber and liking us on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/uber.

bluejetty:00062430:ios.name: Mathematics with PocketCAS Pro
bluejetty:00062430:ios.summary: PocketCAS is a graphing calculator and computer algebra system for iPhone and iPad. It graphs your functions, gives exact answers and shows the steps behind derivatives and integrals. Everything runs on your device, so it works without inte
bluejetty:00062430:ios.description:
PocketCAS is a graphing calculator and computer algebra system for iPhone and iPad. It graphs your functions, gives exact answers and shows the steps behind derivatives and integrals. Everything runs on your device, so it works without internet or an account, and you buy it once instead of paying for a subscription.
Graphs
- 2D plots of functions, implicit equations, polar and parametric curves, run charts and vector fields. PocketCAS marks zeros, extrema and intersections. In full screen, tap a mark to read its coordinates.
- 3D surfaces and space curves with soft light and shading. Drag to turn them, pinch to zoom, add a floor grid or pick another color map.
- Animated plots: use the variable anim in any plot.
Suggestions and steps
- Under each function, suggestions show what to look at next: its derivative, zeros, extrema, integral or a plot. The answer is already in the suggestion. Tap it to add it to your document.
- Functions get a small plot right beside the result.
- Calculation steps show the rules behind a derivative, an integral, a differential equation or an extremum, one row per rule.
Exact answers
- Algebra: solve equations and systems, simplify, expand and factor expressions, divide polynomials.
- Calculus: limits, derivatives, integrals, Taylor series and sums.
- Linear algebra: matrices, determinants, inverses, eigenvalues and eigenvectors.
- Differential equations: ordinary differential equations, solved exactly.
- Units and constants: enter physical formulas with units and convert the results.
- Scripts: define your own functions with conditions, loops and recursion.
Reads like your textbook
- Results look the way they do in a textbook: fractions, roots, sums, integrals and matrices. Long results wrap to the width of your screen.
- A math keyboard with every function in reach. Your recent functions sit above it, and a hint shows what goes between the brackets.
Made for daily work
- Documents keep your calculations and plots together, so you can pick up where you left off.
- iCloud syncs your documents between iPhone, iPad and Mac. The Mac app is a separate purchase.
- Export: print or share plots, entries or whole documents as PDF.
- Import: reuse functions from other documents, or load data from CSV files.
- Help built in: the reference explains every function with examples, and tutorials get you started.
A free version of PocketCAS lets you try the interface and many features first.
What users say
"This program has an incredible amount of power for such a compact program. I teach high school math, and this program can work with all sorts of expressions, graphs, and help check my work. Definitely worth it!"
"One of three Apps I use when teaching A Level maths. Have recommended to numerous students. Excellent."
"This app is amazing and could help me with about 98% of the math that I had to do during my mechanical engineering degree all the way from my bachelor to my master."
Questions or ideas? Write to us at https://pocketcas.com/support.

Cast your line, reach the depths and catch as many fish as you can on your way up! Upgrade your gear to catch more fish and to dive deeper, make rare finds and discover new species!
Go Fish! features:
- Simple and addictive gameplay: Tap, cast down and catch as many fish as you can!
- Upgrade your net to grab more fish and to reach deeper depths!
- The old fisherman will continue to earn money for you when you’re away!
Can you discover the mysteries that lie in the ocean? Go Fish!
Subscription Terms:
Go Fish! VIP Membership access offers a weekly subscription, you have a 3 day FREE trial period, after which you will be charged $6.49 weekly. After buying this subscription, you will unlock an exclusive pirate skin for your fisherman, the revenue doubling Golden Hook and remove non-optional ads. This is an auto-renewable subscription. The payment is charged to your account after confirmation. The subscription is renewed unless you unsubscribe 24 hours before the period ends. Your account will also be charged for renewal.
The prices notes are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may change and actual charges may be converted to local currency.
End of trial and subscription renewal:
- The payment is charged to your iTunes account after a confirmation of purchase
- The subscription is renewed unless you unsubscribe 24 hours before the end of the current period
- The account will be charged for renewal 24 hours before the end of the current period at the standard cost of the weekly subscription
- The user may manage the subscription and auto-renewal by accessing the user's account settings after purchase in the store
- No cancellation of the current subscription is permitted during the active subscription period
- Any unused portion of the free trial period will be forfeited when the subscription is purchased
Cancelling a trial or subscription:
- In order to cancel a subscription during the free trial period you need to cancel it through your account in the Store. This must be done at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial period to avoid being charged.

bluejetty:00144822:ios.description:
Got something on your mind? Type it in, and in seconds you're chatting with real people who want to talk about the exact same thing — one-on-one or in a group.
No feeds. No waiting for likes. Just instant conversations about what matters to you right now.
HOW IT WORKS
- Ask a question or drop a topic — anything from "my situationship is confusing" to "who's watching the new season?"
- Superfy instantly matches you with people who want to talk about it
- Chat one-on-one, or start a group that others join as the conversation grows
- Jump into group chats already happening around your interests
TALK ABOUT WHAT'S REAL
- Relationships and breakups — honest advice from people who've been there
- Friendships, uni and college life, and everyday drama
- Gaming, music, art, fandoms and hobbies
- Whatever everyone's talking about right now
MAKE FRIENDS WHO GET YOU
Conversations on Superfy turn into friendships. Find your crowd, build your circle and keep the group chat going.
A FRIENDLY COMMUNITY — AND WE KEEP IT THAT WAY
Superfy is built on kindness. Be respectful, be supportive, and treat people the way you'd want to be treated.
- Zero tolerance for harassment, violence or racism
- Anyone who breaks the rules is removed from Superfy
- Report or block any user in a tap — our team reviews every report
- Real people only — no bots, no fake profiles
FREE TO USE — SUPERFY SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONAL
Superfy is 100% free. Want to stand out? The optional Superfy subscription unlocks:
- Exclusive avatars
- Profile customization to make your profile truly yours
- Chat themes and colors across the app
- 100 free Super Coins every month
- And many more features
Subscriptions are available monthly or annually. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00123278:ios.name: Unstoppable: Crypto Wallet
bluejetty:00123278:ios.summary:
Unstoppable Wallet is a non-custodial wallet purposely built for sovereign-minded people who do not accept anything less than self-custody and have high privacy standards.
It is engineered for privacy-conscious individuals who want to hold
bluejetty:00123278:ios.description:
Unstoppable Wallet is a non-custodial wallet purposely built for sovereign-minded people who do not accept anything less than self-custody and have high privacy standards.
It is engineered for privacy-conscious individuals who want to hold, move, and exchange crypto on their own terms. Without asking permission. Without exposing themselves. Without leaving a trail behind.
Unstoppable Wallet is built on three convictions:
1) Your Money Is Unconditionally Yours. A truly non-custodial wallet means nobody can freeze, seize, or "temporarily suspend" access to your capital. Not us. Not anyone.
2) Your Money Is Your Private Matter. Zero data collection. Zero data sharing. No user accounts keeping your records, no KYC checks that risk exposing your financials to the world, no analytics quietly reporting on you. A no KYC wallet in the most literal sense: the app has no means to know who you are by design.
3) Securing Your Money Should Be Easy. Most wallets defend against textbook threats. Real people face phishing, theft, and someone forcing them to open their phone. Unstoppable targets real-world problems with pioneering features like Duress Mode, phishing protection, and Secure Send.
If the above rhymes with you, then Unstoppable is your self-custody wallet. Built by industry veterans, fully open source, and recommended by some of the most respected people in the space.
If you're looking for a custodial app with a support line that can reset your password, this one isn't it. There is no back door here. Not even for us.
WALLET FEATURES:
Self-Custody Made Easy >> Non-custodial doesn't have to mean complicated. Create and manage any number of wallets. This wallet is like your own bank where you are the only client and the only one in charge.
Passkey Wallets >> Pioneering passkey technology lets you create and restore non-custodial wallets tied to your own biometrics. Self-custody without the seed phrase anxiety. Your face and fingerprint become the vault only you can open.
Bitcoin (BTC) Wallet >> The easiest, safest, and most private wallet for your Bitcoin. Built by industry veterans who've been securing BTC since long before it was fashionable. Recommended by bitcoin.org.
Privacy Coin Wallet >> One of the very few tools in the entire ecosystem offering full, unrestricted access to all major privacy coins including Monero, Zcash and Zano, with the ability to move between them discreetly.
Monero (XMR) Wallet >> Full support for all Monero features and an unmatched XMR experience. No compromises, no stripped-down implementation.
Zcash (ZEC) Wallet >> One of the very first wallets to support Zcash, with full shielded transaction support. Recommended by Zcash founding members.
Built In Aggregator >> A rate aggregator engine that lets you compare crypto swap rates across major liquidity providers. No accounts, no gatekeepers.
Security That Works >> Unstoppable goes well beyond standard security measures and provides practical defenses for actual threats in the real world. Duress Mode provides the ability to hide critical wallets when under pressure. Phishing protection protects you from some of the most popular phishing attacks in crypto. Secure Send verifies you're paying who you think you're paying.
Fully Open Source >> The most transparent wallet application built to date. 100% of the code is openly accessible for anyone to evaluate. Verified and audited by third parties.
Be Unstoppable!
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://unstoppable.money/privacy-policy

VideoAi is an all-in-one AI video generator that turns your photos into smooth, share-ready videos in seconds. Animate old pictures, create viral short clips, and transform everyday images into moving moments, no editing skills needed.
Whether you want to make pictures move, add subtle facial motion to vintage family photos, or generate a brand-new scene from text, VideoAi helps you create content made for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

* 📸 Animate Old Photos: Add natural motion like blinking, smiling, and gentle expressions to classic photos
* 🖼️ Photo to Video: Turn any single image into a dynamic short video for reels, stories, and posts
* ✍️ Text to Video: Type an idea or short script and generate a video scene instantly
* 🌟 AI Styles & Effects: Apply creative looks, cinematic vibes, and viral filters to your animations
* 🎬 Remix Mode: Recreate and enhance clips with fresh AI styles and upgraded visuals
* 📤 Share-Ready Exports: Save videos optimized for social platforms and quick sharing

* Nostalgia: Bring family memories and meaningful moments to life
* Viral Social Content: Stop-scrolling photo animations designed for short-form platforms
* Personal Stories: Add motion to portraits, avatars, and everyday photos

* Simple & fast: Create animated videos in seconds
* No learning curve: Start generating immediately, no editing experience required
* Flexible creation: Photo-to-video and text-to-video in one app
* Built for sharing: Content that looks great on reels, shorts, and stories

bluejetty:00016525:ios.description:
Pandora's Box has been opened - It's up to you to save the world in Heroes Legend – an incredible mix of best RPGs and MOBAs with action games elements! Dozens of heroes with unique abilities and personalities are on your side. It will take a real master of tactics to assemble a team that would overcome all obstacles, defeat powerful bosses and reach the grand finale to shape the destiny of this world!
With meticulously designed hero and monster characters, along with humorous fighting skills and actions, Heroes Legend is an RPG packed with amazing design content that will both entertain and delight you. Heroes Legend is more than just a fighting and strategy game, it’s a game fit for a champion! 
GAME FEATURES:
-- Evolving Strategy --
More than 60 Heroes in different factions with specific skills. Summon your Warriors, TRAIN them to become powerful heroes, or convert them into Spirit material for EVOLVING. Forge magical gears, and outfit your warriors for victory!
Each hero comes with a set of unique stats & skills that greatly affects how your plan & plan!
-- TONS of Content --
With battlegrounds galore and dungeons aplenty, heroic quests, mysterious towers, arena, much fun to enjoy!
-- Interactive team play! --
Say no to single play. Fight beside other players while facing BOSS.
-- Worldwide Arena --
Put forth your best heroes, war in the ARENA, battle head-to-head against other players in PVP duels! Climb the Leader board for the best rewards!
AND ... Dozens of beauties waiting to be unlocked !
PLEASE NOTE! Heroes Legend is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money. If you don't want to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings. 
A network connection is required to play Heroes Legend.
Contact us:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/heroeslegend.rpg
About Subscriptions and Apple Website Subscriptions
1. Pricing & Billing Cycle
Enable “Subscription (Weekly)” within the game for $0.99 a week, which will be billed weekly (every 7 days). (Price may vary depending on your location.)
Enable “Subscription (Monthly)” within the game for $2.99 a month, which will be billed every natural month (every 30 days). (Price may vary depending on your location.)
Enable “Subscription (Quarterly)” within the game for $8.99, which will be billed every 3 month (every 90 days). (Price may vary depending on your location.)
2. Subscription Content
Subscribers will be eligible for certain perks during the subscription period, including:
- Use boost in campaign no need to watch ad
- Try hero no need to watch ad
- Can view all hidden heroes
- Don't need to wait when use Summoner Gold.
- Free reset time Arena/Super Arena daily: +%d
- Use Midas Touch increase: +10%
- Use Gold upgrade skill level decrease: +10%
- Treasure Gold increase: +10%
3. Automatic Subscription Renewal
The App Store subscription is auto-renewed with payment confirmed via your iTunes Account. Users can manage the auto-renew manually through the iTunes/Apple ID Settings Manager. The subscription will auto-renew for the assigned billing period if the auto-renew feature is not turned off 24 hours before the current subscription expires.
4. User Agreement and Privacy Policy
User Agreement https://sites.google.com/view/mgif-studio/
Privacy Statement https://sites.google.com/view/mgif-studio/
5. Subscription Cancellation
If you would like to cancel your subscription, go to ‘Settings’ on your iOS device --> ‘iTunes & App Store’ --> tap ‘Apple ID’ and then ‘View Apple ID’. Enter ‘Account Settings’, tap ‘Subscriptions’ --> ‘Manage’ and select the subscription for ‘Heroes Legend: Idle Battle War’ to cancel it.

■ Find Anything, A
bluejetty:00014700:ios.description:
Never lose track of your past or future. Seamless Calendar integrates iCloud Calendar and Reminders into one elegant interface, bridging the gap between your future plans and past records with lightning-fast performance.
■ Find Anything, Anytime 
• Powerful Search: Instantly find any event, whether it was 10 years ago or years into the future. 
• Undo Deleted Events: Recover deleted events from your last 100 entries. Never worry about accidental taps again. 
• CSV Export: Easily export your event data to CSV for business reports or personal backups.
■ Fully Customizable to Your Lifestyle 
• Flexible Views: Switch seamlessly between Year, Month, and List views. 
• Adjustable Month View: Customize your display to show between 2 to 6 weeks—perfect for focusing on what matters. 
• Visual Personalization: Change background colors for specific calendars to highlight holidays, anniversaries, or work periods. 
• Dark Mode Ready: A beautiful, eye-friendly design that looks great in any light.
■ Effortless Integration & UX 
• Full iCloud Sync: Syncs perfectly with your default iOS calendar with zero setup required. 
• Reminders Support: Manage your schedule and tasks in one unified view. 
• Rich Widgets: Keep your upcoming events at a glance right from your Home Screen. 
• Template Support: Create events in seconds using customizable templates. 
• Intuitive Transitions: Experience a fluid, high-quality UI designed for the ultimate user experience.
[Important: Sync Settings for Past Events] By default, iOS limits calendar sync to 1 month. To view and search events older than 30 days, please update your settings:
1. Open the iPhone Settings app.
2. Tap Calendar.
3. Tap Sync and select "All Events". This ensures every single record is accessible within Seamless Calendar.

bluejetty:00126043:ios.description:
VRoid Mobile is an avatar camera app that allows you to create 3D characters, change clothes, and take photos.
■ Create your own 3D avatar!
Not only can you freely combine face, hair and body parts,
Parts can be adjusted freely just by moving the slider!
The size of the head, the length of the limbs, the color of the eyes and the color of the hair can also be changed to your liking.
Create your own original 3D avatar!
■ Choose avatar “clothes” and enjoy fashion!
VRoid Mobile offers a lot of “avatar wear” designed for 3D avatars.
Coordinate clothes that suit your avatar and enjoy fashion!
Fashionable avatar wear by cutting-edge creators of “virtual fashion” will also appear one after another!
■ In the real world & virtual space! You can shoot "Avatar Photo"!

VRoid Mobile is equipped with a full-featured “Avatar Camera” function that enables “emo” filters and stylish photo processing!
"AR camera" that can call 3D avatar in the real world and take pictures,
VRoid is a “virtual camera” that lets you take photos in the virtual space inside your mobile
You can enjoy two shooting modes.
Take a photo of your avatar and share it on SNS!
In addition, virtual cameras can be played simultaneously by up to four people!
Avatars in the studio can have a text chat.
Let's gather together and enjoy group photo shooting!
* "AR Camera" can only be used with ARKit compatible models.
* Supported environments and devices may change in future updates.
* This information is current as of July 26, 2019.

Connect to your community through our local news app. We're celebrating what makes our community great, giving you context to understand local issues and sharing solutions to help you solve problems.

• Stay up to date with hourly and daily weather forecasts.
• View interactive weather radar to help you track rain, snow and storms.
• Get weather conditions and forecasts for your location.
We're committed to continually improving your experience in our app. Please let us know how we're doing by leaving a review in the App Store.

bluejetty:00128214:ios.name: Audio / Spectrum Analyzer
bluejetty:00128214:ios.summary:
This RTA app supports simultaneous display of "Audio Waveform", as well as the FFT-based "Amplitude Spectrum" (frequency magnitude) and "Spectrogram" (frequency distribution over time), for audio signals input from a microphone.
(FFT: Fast
bluejetty:00128214:ios.description:
This RTA app supports simultaneous display of "Audio Waveform", as well as the FFT-based "Amplitude Spectrum" (frequency magnitude) and "Spectrogram" (frequency distribution over time), for audio signals input from a microphone.
(FFT: Fast Fourier Transform, RTA: Real Time Analyzer)
[Features]
- Supports simultaneous display of Waveform / Spectrum / Spectrogram
- Supports orientation both portrait and landscape
- FFT size
- Window function
- Spectrum average
- Spectrum Tilt
- Frequency weighting (Flat, dBA, dBC)
- The type of expressing the frequency of Spectrum / Spectrogram (Linear, Log)
- Displays the peak level and its frequency of the spectrum
- Peak Hold (displays the results of holding past peak values of the spectrum)
- Octave Analysis (displays the spectrum divided into octave bands)
- Generates the audio signal (Sine, Triangle, Squire, Saw)
- Generates the noise signal (white noise, pink noise)
- Pitch meter display
The Pro version offers Ad-Free Viewing and High-Resolution Analysis (FFT size: 16384, 32768, Spectrum Average: 4, 8).
[Setting items]
1. Screen structure :
Select the display screen configuration.
View Num : 1, 2
View Type :
- 1 screen : Wave (Waveform) / 1D (Spectrum) / 2D (Spectrogram)
- 2 screens : W+1D / W+2D / 1D+2D
Layout : Vertical / Horizon
2. Frequency Axis Scale Type :
Selectable the type of expressing the X direction (frequency) of Spectrum / Spectrogram.
- Linear: Distributed at equal intervals
- Log: The intervals increase logarithmically
3-1. FFT size :
1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384, 32768
(* 16384, 32768 is available in the Pro version.)
3-2. Window function :
Hanning, Hamming, Blackman, No window
4. Spectrum Average
Number of spectrum average for a display of spectrum.
1, 2, 4, 8 (init value: 1)
(* 4 and 8 are available in the Pro version.)
Higher value will make the spectrum less noisy and more smooth, at the cost of lower time resolution.
5. Spectrum Tilt :
Compensates the visual slope of the spectrum around a 1 kHz pivot.
-6.0 to +6.0 dB/oct in 0.5 dB/oct steps (0 means no tilt).
6. Frequency Weighting :
Selectable frequency weighting.
- Flat: No frequency weighting is applied.
- dB(A): Frequency response that takes into account human hearing.
- dB(C): Relatively flat response.
7. Peak Hold :
Displays the results of holding the past maximum values (peak values) of the spectrum.
8. Octave Analysis :
Displays the results of classifying the spectrum into octave bands.
Division method:
- FFT: Spectral display
- 1/24, 1/12, 1/6, 1/3, 1 octave: Display divided into octave bands
Calc method:
- Max: Displays the maximum spectrum value in each band
- Average: Displays the average spectrum value in each band
9. Generates the audio signal :
Set the audio signal to be generated.
- There are 4 types of waveform. (Sine, Triangle, Squire, Saw)
- It can set the value of the frequency in 20Hz - 20000Hz.
10. Generates the noise signal :
Set the noise signal to be generated.
- There are 2 types of noise. (White noise, pink noise)
[Other]
- Background color: Black, White
- WaveForm: Line Color (Green, Yellow, Invert), Line Width (1.0 ~ 6.0 px)
- Spectrum: Bar color (Green, Yellow, Color patterns)
- Spectrogram: Colormap, Display range (-150 ~ -60 dB), Display time (4 ~ 60 sec), Apply Spectrum Tilt
- Bluetooth connection policy selection (disabled, HFP, A2DP).
- Scaling of Waveform / Spectrum display in the Y direction (magnification: 0.5 - 2.0).
- Scaling of Spectrum / Spectrogram display in the X direction (magnification: 1.0 - 16.0).

bluejetty:00156244:ios.description:
Looking for a great job in Texas? Find jobs which align with your skill sets or training using the WorkInTexas app.
Instantly view any job posted to the web directly on your iPhone or iPad. 
Select the latest job openings in your area from more than 20,000 websites. WorkInTexas has access to: 
•National and local job boards 
•Federal, state and local government job boards 
•National recruiters and all major employers 
•Military branches 
•Major hospitals nonprofits and newspapers 
•Green job boards 
•Volunteer sites 
•Chambers of commerce 
Search by keyword and location (state/city/zip code). See the results in both a list format and as pins on a map. Focus on specific industries you’re interested in.
Save and share your favorite jobs via email, Facebook or Twitter. 
With WorkInTexas unique “Jobs Nearby” function you can easily map all the latest jobs near your current location. Search for jobs around your neighborhood or a different location. Simply tap color-coordinated pins to see more information or to apply for a job. 
WorkInTexas lets you instantly return to previous searches, recently viewed jobs and your favorite jobs. 
Visit WorkInTexas at https://www.workintexas.com/

bluejetty:00175257:ios.description:
Looking for fresh alien games? Now aliens are traveling through history to replace all people with their own kind. Find the impostors and kill them to save the Age. We introduce part II of the game with fully new story. Welcome to Find the Alien 2!
Follow the aliens and travel through the history. Start a rescue operation from the Stone Age. Keep traveling between worlds and killing aliens. Look around and feel the vibe of the era. Agree that this is more breathtaking than reading about history in books.
In this game you will see lots of interesting characters from different times of history. Meet dinosaurs, ancient people, famous historical figures such as Cleopatra and King Arthur. But remember, you are here to find the aliens and stop the invasion!
When you get to a new place, first scan everything you see. Aliens can replace people, animals and even things. Remember where you saw the alien when you used the UFO scanner. Then use the blaster to kill the aliens. It becomes more difficult when the number of aliens increases and they start to move. Don't kill real people or animals. In this case, you will fail.
MAIN HIGHLIGHTS
• Historical places
Travel through the Stone Age, Ancient Egypt, the Middle Ages, the era of piracy, the Wild West, the present and the future.
• Famous characters
Complete the levels and save cave people, dinosaurs, ancient Egyptians, Cleopatra, medieval peasants, knights in armor, King Arthur, Lady of the Lake, pirates, cowboys, sheriffs, bandits and some cyber punk cyborgs.
• Thoughtful plot
This game has 3D graphics and storyline with funny moments and characters. All these features will completely immerse you in the plot of the game. And you will forget what time it is. Are you ready to fight the Alien King?
Download Find the Alien 2 and save the earth in the past, present and future. Be the first to uncover the mysteries of the history and stop the alien invasion.

bluejetty:00127895:ios.name: Helix Tuner
bluejetty:00127895:ios.summary: Helix Tuner is a completely new way to tune your instrument. Unlike all other tuning apps, it does not detect your pitch at all. Instead, it combines the sound coming into the microphone with the desired tuning pitch to create a beautiful i
bluejetty:00127895:ios.description:
Helix Tuner is a completely new way to tune your instrument. Unlike all other tuning apps, it does not detect your pitch at all. Instead, it combines the sound coming into the microphone with the desired tuning pitch to create a beautiful interference pattern on the screen. The interaction between your sound and the reference pitch creates an optical illusion of motion when your note is sharp or flat, and it appears stable when you're in tune. 
If you are tired of digital tuners that jump around erratically, have slow or delayed response to changes in your tuning, or in general just don't give you good tuning information, then Helix Tuner is the one you are looking for. 
When you manually select the tuning note, as opposed to letting the app detect it automatically, Helix Tuner is extremely resistant to background noise and higher string harmonics that confuse other tuners, causing them to jump around to higher notes and give wrong tuning information. Because the visualization system naturally responds more clearly to sounds near the selected tuning pitch, it is useful even when other musicians are playing nearby.

Instead, it combines the sound coming into the microphone with the desired tuning pitch to create a beautiful interference pattern on the screen. The interaction between your sound and the reference pitch creates an optical illusion of motion when your note is sharp or flat, and it appears stable when you're in tune.  

If you are tired of digital tuners that jump around erratically, have slow or delayed response to changes in your tuning, or in general just don't give you good tuning information, then Helix Tuner is the one you are looking for. 

When you manually select the tuning note, as opposed to letting the app detect it automatically, Helix Tuner is extremely resistant to background noise and higher string harmonics that confuse other tuners, causing them to jump around to higher notes and give wrong tuning information. Because the visualization system naturally responds more clearly to sounds near the selected tuning pitch, it is useful even when other musicians are playing nearby.

bluejetty:00098868:ios.description:
“Drift Racing:3v3” boasting partnerships with numerous world - class car manufacturers, allows you to race authentic cars from renowned brands. Pull off jaw - dropping drifts, compete in intense 3v3 battles across diverse and vivid tracks, and team up with players globally. Unleash your racing skills, enjoy the thrill of victory, and indulge in non - stop fun in this ultimate racing game!
Game Features:
【Hundreds Of Offical Vehicles】
Collect iconic models like the Porsche 911, GT-R, and Bugatti, along with hundreds of top-tier luxury cars to choose from! Each vehicle is officially licensed by the manufacturers, allowing you to build your dream collection.
【Race with Friends】
Invite friends to team up and choose your ideal role: Attacker, Support, or Strategist. Experience the unique 3v3 racing and teamwork mode, and enjoy the thrill of competitive play with your friends! Modify your car with exclusive customizations, including paint jobs, decals, tires, neon lights, spoilers, and more! Become the most eye-catching racer on the track!
【Numorous World Map With Stunning Landscapes】
Select from meticulously designed race tracks! Speed through Los Angeles, Paris, Antarctica, and Bali, marveling at breathtaking sceneries like snow-capped mountains, deserts, and the ocean floor. Enjoy the exhilarating thrill of racing across different times and spaces.
【Fast-Paced and Easy to Play】
Each match lasts just three minute, making it perfect for quick and exciting gameplay. Even beginners can master it effortlessly! Drift, skid, and activate ultimate abilities—each car comes with unique skills like Blink Dash, Auto Cruise, and Wild Charge. Activate your ultimate move and smash through all obstacles to cross the finish line in style!

Brewfather is made from the ground up to give you the best recipe de
bluejetty:00131602:ios.description:
Powerful and easy to use tool for your brewing needs. Easily create and manage your recipes. Keep track of all the details in your batches and your ingredients inventory.
Brewfather is made from the ground up to give you the best recipe design and brewing experience on both desktop and mobile devices. With a modern design that is easy to use. Get your recipes done in no time! With automatic synchronization between all your devices and offline support. 
Combining a powerful recipe designer with intuitive batch tracking and inventory management to make your brew-day easier. Integrated with many popular devices to aid your brewing. Explore the recipe library with hundreds of quality recipes.
Features:
* Powerful, intuitive and easy to use interface with dark mode support
* Multi-device support - one app everywhere - always!
* Offline support, auto-saving, and automatic synchronization
* Fully-featured and easy to use recipe designer
* Complete batch tracking - log every step of your brew
* Fermentation chart
* Recipe library with hundreds of quality recipes available for you
* Brew timer with alarms and notifications for your brew day!
* Profiles for your equipment, mash schedule, fermentation steps, and water
* Highly customizable equipment profile to suit any brewing system
* Large customizable ingredients database with thousands of ingredients
* Inventory stock & cost tracking
* Multiple style guidelines (BJCP, Brewers Association, Norbrygg, SHBF, DØDL)
* Supports custom style guidelines
* Print your recipe or batch to PDF
* Import and export BeerXML
* Metric and US/Imperial units
* Scale recipes up/down
* Easily share recipes
* Estimate your Final Gravity based on many variables
* Calculate every important detail of your recipes and batches
* Easy to use yeast amount and yeast starter calculator
* Integrated water adjustment calculator with mash pH
* Strike temperature calculation
* Proper calculation of hop-stand bitterness
And many more tools and features to help your brewing.
Integrations:
* Remote logging from Tilt, RAPT Cloud, iSpindel, Brewpiless, MyBrewbot, Plaato Airlock, Plaato Keg, Floaty, Brewbrain and Custom Stream
* Webhook support
* Brewtools Cloud integration
* Recipe sending to Brewtools brewers
* Full SmartPID two-way integration, for brew-day and fermentation control
* Programmable API for custom integrations
Happy brewing!
---
Brewfather is free to use, with an optional Premium subscription to unlock premium features and unlimited recipes/batches.
New accounts get 30 days of free Premium access.
Brewfather Premium:
* Unlimited number of recipes
* Unlimited number of batches
* Import and export features
* Integrate with devices
* Create your public profile and add recipes to the recipe library
* Ingredient cost tracking
* Custom style guidelines
* Ability to restore deleted recipes and batches
* Add manual readings for the fermentation chart
Your payment will be charged to your iTunes Account once you confirm your purchase.
Your iTunes account will be charged again when your subscription automatically renews at the end of your current subscription period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours prior to end of the current period. Any unused portion of a trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
You can manage or turn off auto-renew in your Apple ID account settings any time after purchase.
---
Privacy Policy: https://docs.brewfather.app/legal/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://docs.brewfather.app/legal/tos
Got any questions? Get in touch at hello@brewfather.app

bluejetty:00153350:ios.description:
Your Essential Blood Pressure & Heart Rate Companion
Take control of your heart health with an intuitive and powerful blood pressure and pulse tracking app. Easily measure, log, track, and analyze your blood pressure and heart rate — all in one place.
Whether you’re monitoring trends, managing hypertension, or simply staying proactive about your well-being, this app provides the essential tools to stay on top of your heart health.
Key Features:
 --- Log Blood Pressure & Pulse
Record your systolic and diastolic pressure along with heart rate. Track trends over time and gain insights into your cardiovascular health.
--- Visual Trends & Analysis
Understand how your blood pressure and heart rate change over time with clean charts and easy-to-read summaries.
--- Stay in Control
Monitor your heart with confidence — know when your readings fall within healthy ranges and track progress over days, weeks, or months.
--- Pulse Checker
Quickly check and record your pulse using supported devices or manual input.
--- Heart Health Dashboard
Get an overview of your heart health with organized logs, trends, and data summaries.
--- Read & Learn
Access helpful articles and health tips to better understand your cardiovascular condition and how to manage it.
--- Sync & Secure
Connect with Apple Health to sync and store your data across devices.
Whether you’re keeping your doctor informed or just staying in tune with your body, this app is your smart partner for everyday heart wellness.
Note: This app does not directly measure blood pressure. A separate BP monitor is required for readings.
Questions or comments? We’re happy to help — reach out to us at davidkub42902@icloud.com.
For more details, please review our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

bluejetty:00095234:ios.description:
Boost your brain with BRAIN101: Brain Training Games – a simple way to keep your mind engaged through fun, thoughtful exercises. Whether you're looking to improve focus, sharpen memory, or just enjoy a mental break, BRAIN101 offers a variety of mini games and challenges designed to stimulate different parts of your brain.
It’s commonly known that our brains can continue to adapt and grow with the right kind of mental activity. Regular training may help support memory, attention, logical thinking, and overall mental clarity. BRAIN101 encourages this kind of everyday practice with short, easy-to-access brain games.
New! Meet Your Dino Companion
 Now you can grow your own Dino, a playful spirit animal that reflects your learning journey and energy:
- Play brain games and quizzes daily to keep your Dino happy and growing fast.
- Give your Dino a personal touch by naming it and customizing outfits.
You’ll find activities that touch on:
- Focus and concentration
- Memory and recall
- Logical reasoning and problem-solving
- Mental math and number sense
- Creative and critical thinking
If you enjoy games like puzzles, memory matching, or number logic, BRAIN101 might be a good fit to add to your daily routine. Each game is made to be engaging without being overwhelming, and suitable for various skill levels and ages.
In a busy world, it can be easy to feel distracted or mentally tired. BRAIN101 offers small, consistent challenges that may help you feel a bit more alert, focused, or just entertained. Some users even find it helpful as part of their self-care or productivity habits. With your Dino by your side, every step of progress feels more fun and rewarding!
Why try BRAIN101?
- Explore a variety of brain-focused mini games
- Create a habit of light mental training
- Raise and customize your Dino companion
- Track your progress over time
- Designed with simplicity and clarity in mind
- No pressure - play at your own pace
Try BRAIN101 and see how brain games – together with your Dino – can become part of your everyday rhythm. Whether you're relaxing at home, taking a break at work, or just curious about brain training, BRAIN101 offers a calm and useful mental activity space.

bluejetty:00019121:ios.description:
A utility application for scoring your Hand and Foot card games. The scoring options are configurable. 
The default configuration is:
 - Going out is 100 points.
 - Red threes that are played are worth 100 points. A canasta of red threes has a bonus of 1000 points (for a total of 1700+ points)
 - Unplayed red threes are -500, and accounted for during card count.
 - A canasta of wild cards counts for 1500 points.
 - A canasta of sevens counts for 1000 points.
 - A "Natural" canasta (a canasta without wildcards) counts for 500 points.
 - A "Mixed" canasta (a canasta with wildcards) counts for 300 points.
 - Cardcount: cards are counted and the value is entered as a number in the cardcount row.
There are 5 rounds:
 - Round 1: 50 points is needed to meld
 - Round 2: 90 points is needed to meld
 - Round 3: 120 points is needed to meld
 - Round 4: 150 points is needed to meld
 - Round 5: A canasta is needed to meld
Game can be played by 2, 3, 4 (teams of 2) or 6 (teams of 2) players.
 - The value for going out can be configured.
 - If red threes are playable, what their value is, and if a bounus for a canasta of red threes is applicable.
 - If a canasta of wild cards is "special", what is it's value.
 - If a canasta of sevens is "special", what is it's value.
 - The value of a natural canasta.
 - The value of a mixed canasta.
 - Include the 5th (canasta meld) round, or only 4 rounds.

bluejetty:00061351:ios.description:
Kisi is a cloud-based door access control and security solution. 
UNLOCK DOORS WITH YOUR PHONE
With the Kisi app, you can use your iPhone to quickly and securely unlock any door equipped with Kisi. 
- See the list of the doors you have access to and unlock them from the app 
- Tap-to-unlock*: open a door by holding your iPhone up to a Kisi Reader
- MotionSense*: wave your hand in front of the reader to unlock the door without taking your phone out of the bag (only supported by the MotionSense-enabled doors) 
- One single key for any door in any building
* require bluetooth permissions. Some doors might require access to your location to be unlocked.
MANAGE ACCESS TO ANYONE WITH ONE TOUCH 
As a Kisi admin, you can use the Kisi app to quickly and securely manage access to your facilities. 
- Grant or revoke access to anyone with one touch
- Send access links to temporary staff and visitors 
- See user activity at a given place for a given date 
- Set scheduled unlocks 
- Receive relevant security-related notifications

bluejetty:00091345:ios.description:
Say hello to the Alfred Home App, this app is designed specifically for the line of Alfred smart touchscreen motorized deadbolts that are as satisfying to operate as they are to look at. The Alfred Home App uses Bluetooth technology to provide you with multiple methods of operating your new Alfred Smart Door Lock with your smartphone.
With your new Alfred Smart Door lock installed you can now take advantage of all the integrated features and settings right from your iPhone using the Alfred Home App.
Here are just a few great features that are right at your fingertips while using the Alfred Home App:
-Lock and Unlock your device with your phone at short range with Bluetooth connection or via WIFI if an Alfred Connect Wifi Integration system is also installed in your home.
-Send digital Bluetooth credentials to friends and family to allow them access to your lock and get a notification every time they use it.
-Change or update all of your lock setting from within the App, including Away mode and Auto Relock.
-Add or Delete Pin Codes including single use, recurring or time sensitive codes.
-Initiate One Touch unlock, allowing you to simply touch the keypad when your phone is nearby to open the lock.
-Check on the battery life of your locks to make sure you never come home to dead batteries.
-Feel safe and secure with AES128 Bit encryption which protects your locks credentials.

bluejetty:00178359:ios.description:
Clone My Phone provides a fast and easy way to transfer data and files to and from iPhone, iPad and Mac computers.
It supports transferring photos, videos, contacts, calendar items, reminders, personal files and music from one device to another, enabling data synchronization or phone cloning.
Simply download the app on both devices and it will guide you through the process of copying your data in a few easy steps.
You can migrate your content between devices securely & quickly. Transfer files without losing the quality of content.
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
Please note that data transfer between two devices does not require the same Apple account.
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
Features:
- Support to transfer photos, videos, contacts information, calendar items, reminders, files and music between two devices
- Not through any third-party equipment
- In the absence of WiFi network, use Bluetooth for short-distance transmission, data migration is more convenient.
- It is recommended to connect to a WiFi network for high-speed transmission. Make sure that both devices are connected to the same WiFi network and that the network is not configured to block device communication. Most home networks allow connected devices to communicate, but some corporate and public networks can be configured to prevent this .
- Built-in system tools to detect network conditions, including cleaning duplicate contact information, network speed test, checking network link devices, memory status information
* * * * * * * * *

bluejetty:00165419:ios.description:
Wether you are no added sugar, or no sugars or trying to reduce your daily intake with one small step at a time, we can help you on your journey to be sugar free.
Many adults eat much more sugar than necessary, so reducing added sugar intake is a healthful idea for most people. Some people may wish to take it a step further and cut sugar out of their diet entirely. Sober tracking and sobriety monitoring helps keep yourself aware of the positive affecting with a sugar-free diet. 
Mounting evidence continues to show a number of positive health outcomes from cutting back on added sugars, including a reduction in the risk for obesity, type 2 diabetes, coronary heart disease, metabolic syndrome, and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease
Sugarfree is completely free too use
Milestone sober tracker
Track and celebrate your milestones from 1 day, to 1 week, to 1 month and beyond.
Daily motivation 
Receive advice and inspiration messages to help keep you motivated and focused on removing any need to eat sugary food ever again.
Monitor Symptoms
Day by day analysis of difficulties and positives while you progress on your sugar-free journey. 
Ai Meal scanner
Easily scan any meal and our Ai will determine the foods in your meal giving you information on the nutrients and sugars. Easily add each food to your daily tracker to keep track what you have been eating.
Sober Tracker
Monitor each sober passing day. Reset if you break a streak or skip a cheat day! 
Food and Calorie Tracker
Setting aside the common taste for sugar, there is sugar hiding in many foods (some of them quite unexpected). Distinguishing added sugars from natural sugars can be difficult. Track how many calories and sugars foods you eat have. Scan, Search or create your own
Weight Tracker
Log changes in your weight to visually see the changes week over week.
Water Tracker
Keep track of water you drink each day, drinking 8 cups of water will help your body become healthier and sustain more energy.
Resources to help you on your journey
Read useful tips & tricks to help you achieve the best outcome when starting to become sugar free
Diet AI chatbot assistant
Ask our AI chatbot any sugarfree questions or get help with a diet plan.
Sugarfree is available as a monthly subscription or a one-time purchase. Your iTunes account will be charged at confirmation of purchase. The subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the billing period. You can goto your iTunes Account Settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. To restore all you previous purchases use the "Restore Purchases" button at the button of the premium purchase screen.

Remove backgrounds instantly and with precision using our advanced bg eraser tool.

MAGIC ERASER
Easily erase unwanted objects or particles from photos.
Background Changer

Choose any photo from your gallery or take a new picture with your camera.
