bluejetty:00149281:ios.description:
Welcome to Perfect Teacher Simulator Game, a fun and satisfying school adventure where you step into the role of a smart teacher and take control of the classroom. Grade papers, review student answers, decide pass fail results, and manage daily school challenges in one of the most entertaining school games for players who love casual simulator gameplay.
In this exciting teacher simulator, every day brings a new test. Check homework, mark exams, handle classroom behavior, and see whether each teacher or student makes the right choice. From funny school moments to tricky decision-based tasks, this game gives you the feeling to truly be a teacher in a lively and colorful school world.
If you enjoy games with paper checking and judging tasks, this experience brings that satisfying papers please and paper grade please style into a classroom setting. Review answers carefully, spot mistakes, and choose who deserves a class pass and who should fail. Your decisions matter, and every level keeps the challenge fresh and fun.
Perfect Teacher Simulator Game mixes the charm of education games with the fun of casual school-based decision gameplay. Whether you enjoy a light high school simulator, funny classroom moments, or games where you must think fast and act smart, this teacher life adventure is made for you. Enter a world of hyper school fun, surprising student behavior, and entertaining teaching challenges.
Fans of school-themed adventures, girls games, and clever simulator games will enjoy the mix of humor, simple controls, and rewarding tasks. If you are a fan of puzzlers, word games, trivia games, quiz games, or brain teasers, you will love the decision-making and problem-solving style of this game. Every level gives you new ways to test your attention, judge student performance, and keep the classroom under control.
From grading sheets to handling funny school drama, Perfect Teacher Simulator Game delivers a playful school experience full of engaging tasks. It has the fun energy of classroom chaos, teacher choices, and school puzzle moments, with a style inspired by the best casual simulator experiences. If you like school adventures, scary teacher style classroom themes, or perfect lie games with clever choices and funny outcomes, this game offers a fresh and enjoyable twist.
Download Perfect Teacher Simulator Game now and enjoy a fun teacher life full of grading, judging, passing, failing, and managing the ultimate classroom adventure.

bluejetty:00187040:ios.description:
The Workday app provides secure, mobile access to your Workday applications on-the-go.
As an employee, our simple interface allows you to
• Review your pay, view or request time off, check in and out for work, submit your timesheet, and submit expenses quickly. 
• Get push notifications alerts and reminders for time tracking, important updates, and approvals. Immediately take action right from the app.
• Browse your company directory, securely view coworker profiles, leave feedback, and take learning courses on-the-go.
As a manager, you can take action wherever you are
• Approve your employee requests easily.
• View your team or individual profiles and immediately take actions relevant to your role, such as perform a job change, make a compensation change, or provide performance feedback. 
• Stay connected to your business by gaining quick insight into what's important through interactive reports and dashboards.
And if your mobile device is ever lost or stolen, you can be confident that your data is secure. With support for Touch ID and Face ID, only you can access your information. 
Note: Your organization must authorize access to the Workday mobile app. You will only have access to mobile features your organization has enabled, based on your role (not all mobile features may be available to you). 
Not all Workday features are available on mobile.

bluejetty:00024065:ios.description:
Not just another chord dictionary, Coach Chords is a complete guitar chord method that teaches you to build, understand and play every chord with automatic RECOGNITION & DETECTION guitar Chords !!
Whether you’re learning guitar for the first time, Coach Chords will help you find all guitar chords with essentials informations :
- Fingering position with 5 colors
- Fret number
- Strings to play
- Chords variations
- Audio chords with real guitar sounds
- For acoustic, electric and classic guitars
Strumming chords is one of the most popular ways to play the guitar when you are reading a guitar songbook or tablatures and, although there are hundreds of guitar chords you can learn.
Coach Chords will show you everything you need to get started on your own. It is aimed at beginners of all ages with easy step by step colors instructions to help you play right away. All chords shapes are in your pocket.
Now, with the help of The Coach Chords Bible, musicians will be able to pick up any songbook and instantly have access to even the most complex and advanced chords.
Neuroscience has learned a lot about the way that the brain processes visual information. Conventional wisdom tells us that we have five sensory systems: Vision, hearing, tactile (touch), olfaction (smell), and taste. Furthermore, researchers have begun to realize that some senses consist of a combination of two sensory systems that get fused together by our experience. 
Coach Chords will focus with 2 sensory system : 
1. Vision with colors
2. Hearing with audio sounds
For most guitarists there is nothing more tedious than sitting down to learn a bunch of chords from a dry chord book, only to find that after hours of going through them, very few of them actually stick. The best way is to find guitar chords when you need them. Coach Chords will show you the chords shapes in only 2 clicks.
Fingering colors shapes for each chord are clearly indicated on a fretboard, and tips on technique are given together with relevant chord sequences.
With Coach Chords, you’ll be strumming in no time!

#네이버 지식iN
누구나 묻고 답할 수 있는 공간에서 나의 지식과 경험을 공유해 보세요.

- 지식iN 홈 
지식인 홈은 질문 그 이상의 공간으로, 지식인 성지, 아하 그렇구나 등 다양한 관심 콘텐츠를 탐색하고 소비할 수 있도록 매일 재미있고 유익한 Q&A를 발견할 수 있습니다.

- 답변하기 
관심있는 분야에서 나의 지식과 경험을 나눠주세요. 
지식iN은 지식 나눔과 기부로 함께 성장합니다. 열심답변자와 신등급까지 도전!

- 질문하기 
요즘 우리가 궁금한 질문부터 다양한 분야의 믿을 수 있는 전문가까지, 다양한 상황에서 제일 먼저 질문해볼 수 있는 공간입니다!
궁금한게 있다면 바로 지식iN에서 질문해 보세요.

질문자는 답변자에게 추가질문을 남겨 궁금한 점을 해결하고, 채택을 통해 감사의 마음을 표현해 보세요. 
답변자는 추가답변을 등록해서 답변의 완성도를 높여보세요!
이용자는 추천하고 싶은 답변에 UP을 달고, 댓글을 통해 질문자/답변자와 소통할 수 있어요.

나의 활동 소식과 1:1 질문 & 관심 질문을 한눈에 볼 수 있어요.

하는 일, 프로필 키워드, 자격 등으로 나만의 프로필을 완성 하고, 내 답변의 신뢰도를 높여보세요!

bluejetty:00114472:ios.name: Where Winds Meet
bluejetty:00114472:ios.summary: Step into an open-world action-adventure RPG set in ancient China. Uncover the secrets of your own identity as you rise from a humble village wanderer to the sword master of the imperial capital. Learn martial arts and build your reputation
bluejetty:00114472:ios.description:
Step into an open-world action-adventure RPG set in ancient China. Uncover the secrets of your own identity as you rise from a humble village wanderer to the sword master of the imperial capital. Learn martial arts and build your reputation as a hero or a bringer of chaos in this free wuxia world.
Jianghu knows no bounds. Play free across PS5, PC, and mobile with full cross-play and cross-progression. No pay-to-win.
Gameplay content is entirely free, with monetization limited to cosmetic items.
In Where Winds Meet, Chinese martial arts meet a seamless open world. Roam vast landscapes, uncover hidden ruins, and descend into layered underground catacombs. Steal techniques from martial sects, wield an arsenal of classic wuxia weaponry, and master over 30 mystic arts – from the flowing balance of Tai Chi to the force of Lion's Roar.
Craft, architecture, astronomy, folk games and performance, medicine and healing – 16 systems come together to form an immersive ancient society.
Adventure Alone or Forge Your Community
Embark on a narrative-driven adventure filled with rich solo gameplay, or team up with up to four friends for seamless co-op experiences.
Join or create a Guild to access group activities: intense guild wars, multiplayer dungeons, and epic raids. Show your skill in competitive duels, or enter a shared, evolving world with thousands of fellow wanderers.
Master Your Way of Wuxia Combat
Tailor your combat – melee, ranged, or stealth. Build a loadout that suits your playstyle. Engage in combat with classic wuxia weapons – sword, spear, dual blades, rope dart, bow, fan, and umbrella. Switch weapons and employ martial arts and mystic skills like Tai Chi to outmaneuver enemies.
Customize Your Jianghu Identity
Customize your character, choose your role, align with factions, and explore unique professions to shape your identity.
Here, freedom is yours, but every action has its weight. Cause chaos, defy the law, and face bounties, pursuit, even time behind bars. Or walk a nobler path: befriend villagers, forge alliances, and grow your reputation as a hero of the Wuxia world. In a world torn by chaos, become the spark that ignites change and forge your legacy!

bluejetty:00029270:ios.description:
Just Hatched – Baby Tracker for Feeding, Sleep & Diapers
Track every feed, sleep, diaper change, milestone and growth measurement in one simple baby tracker designed for new parents.
Whether you’re breastfeeding, bottle feeding, tracking naps, monitoring growth, or sharing baby care with your partner, Just Hatched helps you stay organized while enjoying precious moments with your little one.
FEATURES
Feeding Tracker
• Track breastfeeding, bottle feeding and pumping
• Monitor feeding duration and intervals
• Record solid foods as your baby grows
• Perfect for feeding on demand or scheduled feeds
Sleep Tracker
• Log naps and nighttime sleep
• Identify sleep patterns and routines
• Build healthy sleeping habits
Diaper Tracker
• Track wet and dirty diapers
• Monitor diaper changes throughout the day
• Support for potty training as your child grows
Growth Tracker
• Track weight, height and head circumference
• WHO growth charts included
• Monitor your baby’s development over time
Daily Activity Timeline
• View your baby’s entire day at a glance
• Feeding, sleep, diapers, growth and milestones in one timeline
Insights & Statistics
• Visual charts and trends
• Spot feeding and sleep patterns
• Understand your baby’s routines
Smart Reminders
• Create feeding schedules
• Set sleep reminders
• Stay on track throughout the day
Milestones
• Record important firsts
• Celebrate developmental achievements
• Create a digital baby book
Share With Your Partner
• Sync baby tracking across caregivers
• Keep everyone updated
• Share your subscription with family members
Home Screen Widgets
• View recent feeds, sleep sessions and diaper changes directly from your Home Screen
Just Hatched is designed to be simple, beautiful and easy to use, helping parents focus less on remembering and more on enjoying life with their baby.

bluejetty:00121424:ios.description:
Ready for a completely new hexagon puzzle adventure with 5 game modes? Go with Hexa 1010, an addicting brain teaser with simple yet challenging hexa puzzles designed to train your brain. Pick a game mode, use the 3 different shapes and place them on the hexagon jigsaw puzzle. Can you manage to dominate the leaderboards in all 5 game modes? - all new hexa 1010 challenge

- sleek polished design and typography
- intuitive UI & gameplay
- 5 game modes
- Global ranking system
------------------------------------
See why we are one of the best hexa block puzzle games of the year.

bluejetty:00088596:ios.summary:

SafeDose provides mixing instructions, dosing, and drug administration inf
bluejetty:00088596:ios.description:
SafeDose® is an electronic medication reference tool. It contains acute medications provided for pre-hospital and hospital workers by SafeDose as a public service.
SafeDose provides mixing instructions, dosing, and drug administration information on a single, actionable page. Choose the patient’s weight and clinical need, and instantly see the dose in mg, volume in mL, dilution, delivery information, and dangers.
The content is tailored to remove irrelevant information and to eliminate the need for math or memorization by the caregiver. This improves medication safety, reduces the cost of care, and improves clinical outcomes.
iMedicalApps’ review describes SafeDose as "useful and well designed... Undoubtedly, the potential for medication errors would be reduced if practitioners were to rely on the information provided by this app".
A university research study published in the Journal of Pediatric Pharmacology and Therapeutics found that after less than 10 minutes of training, the use of the SafeDose system increased the accuracy of medication doses prepared during simulated pediatric emergencies by nearly 25 percent, and completely eliminated clinically significant errors.
The research also showed that use of the hospital version of SafeDose, as compared to traditional processes, reduced the time required to prepare medication during an emergency.
Used by hundreds of hospitals and many thousands of practitioners, all SafeDose medical content is medically reviewed for accuracy.

bluejetty:00087679:ios.description:
Bmove is your wallet for entering e-services, especially parking.
Bmove is a free, fast and user-friendly application that allows you to pay for parking with no additional charges or costs of SMS. With Bmove you can pay for hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly and privileged (residential) on-street parking tickets, penalty charge notices (daily parking tickets), parking in public garages and gated parking facilities.
Payments are possible with bank cards (credit and debit cards) with the option to store them for faster and simpler payments. You can also use a prepaid account that you can top up with bank cards, money transfers or Bmove vouchers (available at TISAK newsstands). On the Bmove webshop, you can add other users to your account, such as family members or friends.
If you open an account as a legal entity, allow parking payments to your employees, customers, and visitors. The Bmove service will significantly facilitate cost tracking and provide simple and detailed information needed for booking in accounting.
At any moment, you have direct cost control and a clear and simple overview of your purchases. Bmove will always timely notify you about the parking ticket expiration. It also allows you to pay in advance so that you can focus on your daily activities.
For frequent parking payments in the same city, zone and the same vehicle, Bmove enables you to add those purchases to your favourites. The favourites will be always at your fingertips making your purchases easier and faster!
Bmove is currently available in the following Croatian cities: Bale, Baška, Baška Voda, Biograd na Moru, Bjelovar, Buje, Buzet, Cavtat, Cres, Crikvenica, Čakovec, Daruvar, Donji Miholjac, Dubrovnik, Đakovo, Đurđevac, Fažana, Gradac, Grožnjan, Hvar, Jastrebarsko, Karlovac, Kaštela, Koprivnica, Korčula, Kostrena, Krapinske Toplice, Križevci, Krk, Ludbreg, Makarska, Mali Lošinj, Marija Bistrica, Motovun, Murter, Nova Gradiška, Novi Vinodolski, Novigrad, Ogulin, Okrug Gornji, Omiš, Omišalj/Njivice, Opatija, Orebić, Osijek, Pag, Pakoštane, Pazin, Podstrana, Poreč, Posedarje, Požega, Preko, Primošten, Privlaka, Pula, Rab, Ražanac, Rijeka, Rogoznica, Rovinj, Samobor, Sisak, Slano, Slavonski Brod, Solin, Split, Starigrad, Ston, Supetar, Sveti Filip i Jakov, Šibenik, Tisno, Tkon, Tribunj, Trogir, Trpanj, Tučepi, Umag, Varaždin, Vela Luka, Velika Gorica, Vinkovci, Virovitica, Vodice, Vodnjan, Vrbnik, Vrsi, Vukovar, Zadar, Zagreb, Zaprešić.

bluejetty:00019324:ios.name: Pinball HD Collection
bluejetty:00019324:ios.summary: This unique table features pinball bumpers and targets, plus a color monitor where you can take on a variety of old-school digital minigame challenges - an endless space scroller, plus car racing, missile defense, a block breaker, and more
bluejetty:00019324:ios.description:
This unique table features pinball bumpers and targets, plus a color monitor where you can take on a variety of old-school digital minigame challenges - an endless space scroller, plus car racing, missile defense, a block breaker, and more at incrementing skill levels.
--- 
- Listed by Apple in "Best 10 iPad Apps in 2010"
- Apple Design Awards 2010 winner
- 1st place in US top paid apps during the first sales day
"I really can't see pinball on the iPad getting much better than this."
-- David Winograd, TUAW.com
"The experience of holding a pinball table in your hand is great, and with three amazing tables included, you'll have hours of entertainment lined up."
-- Tim Rattray, SlideToPlay.com
"With three tables, reliable physics and controls, and gorgeous graphics, it is a pleasure to recommend."
-- Levi Buchanan, IGN.com
ABOUT THE GAME
Pinball HD Collection - This game will change your idea of Pinball on the iPad. Each table - Wild West, The Deep, Jungle Style, AC/DC, Slayer, Snow, Da Vinci, Missing In Action, Navy Seals and Platoon - are masterpieces. You'll be stunned with the level of realism. This is a REAL Pinball simulator with stunning 3D graphics both with or without 3D glasses.
IMPORTANT
• Landscape mode - "full table" view
• Portrait mode - "flying-table" view
• In portrait mode slide up or down your both thumbs to toggle camera view from "flying-table" to "full table".
FEATURES
• 10 pinball tables with unique graphics, instructions, missions system, locations and characters
• Landscape mode shows a full table view. The games can be played in either landscape orientation with the button to the left or right of the screen.
• Portrait mode gives you a flying-table view with the camera panning and zooming over the action. This can only be played when holding the iPad with the button on the bottom. If you activate the screen orientation switch, the game only plays in portrait mode.
• A wonderful 3D engine that does true justice to the graphic capabilities of the iPad.
• Realistic physics.
• Built in help for each table. Tap the circled "I" at the bottom right of each table to get a display detailing instructions and descriptions of the features of each table. Make sure to swipe left and right when viewing since the instructions don't fit on one screen.
• Local and global high scores. Swiping right brings up a table of local high scores and further tapping brings up high scores from copies sold throughout
the world. At the end of each game you are prompted to enter your name and have your score included.
• Unique soundtrack with atmospheric music, sound effects and voices.
• Camera tilt brings dimensionality to the games offering a simulated 3D effect where the image changes depending upon how you tilt the iPad. Camera tilt only works in landscape mode.
• Stereoscopic imaging option (requires anaglyph eyeglasses). You can choose between red-cyan, green-magenta or yellow-blue lenses.
HOW TO PLAY
Tapping on a game's fly-over screen shows/hides main menu. Tap on Play button to start game on current table.
Controls in game:
• Tap ANYWHERE on the left side of screen to control the left flipper and ANYWHERE on the right side to control the right flipper.
• Shake your iPad to realistically nudge the pinball table, but not too much or you'll tilt.
• Tap on the "electronic caption" at the top of the screen to pause or resume your game.

bluejetty:00122947:ios.description:
The most comprehensive military pay calculator for all six U.S. Armed Forces branches. Whether you're exploring military careers, planning a PCS move, preparing for promotion, or mentoring junior service members — know exactly what you'll earn.
PAYCHECK ESTIMATE
- Enter your W-4 info to see a per-paycheck breakdown: gross pay, estimated federal income tax, Social Security, Medicare, and net pay. Includes Combat Zone Tax Exclusion (CZTE) support for deployed members.
BASE PAY
- Active duty and Reserve/Guard (Army, Navy, Marine Corps, Air Force, Space Force, Coast Guard)
- Reservists: estimated yearly pay based on drill weekends and AT/ADT/ADSW days
- Drill weekend pay breakdown (4 UTAs) with tax withholding
INCENTIVE & SPECIAL PAYS
- Hostile Fire / Imminent Danger Pay (61 designated areas)
- Aviation Incentive Pay (AVIP)
- Critical Skill Incentive Pay
- Hazardous Duty Incentive Pay — Flight & Non-Flight
- Hazardous Duty Pay — Location Based
- Diving Incentive Pay
- Career Sea Pay & Career Sea Pay Premium
- Submarine Duty Incentive Pay
- Special Duty Assignment Pay
ALLOWANCES
- Basic Allowance for Housing (BAH) — including grandfathered rates back to 2015; unaccompanied tour support (BAH calculated at the with-dependents rate for your dependents' U.S. ZIP code)
- Basic Allowance for Subsistence (BAS)
- Family Separation Allowance (FSA)
- Cash Clothing Replacement Allowance
- Personal Money Allowance
- CONUS COLA
- OCONUS COLA — with unaccompanied tour rate support
- Overseas Housing Allowance — Rental, Utility, and Move-In (MI applied automatically
HEALTH PROFESSIONAL OFFICER PAYS
- All pays per DoD Financial Management Regulation — Medical, Dental, Nurse, and Health Professions Officer specialties. 
---Great for:
- Evaluating a military career or career change
- Comparing pay before and after a promotion or PCS
- Understanding your take-home pay with realistic tax estimates
- Mentoring junior service members on their total compensation
- Reserve and Guard members planning annual training
- Service members on OCONUS unaccompanied orders (geo-bach) planning their full allowance picture 
---BAH is calculated at the full-time residential rate based on zip code, not the RC/T non-locality rate applicable for active duty periods under 30 days. On unaccompanied tours, BAH is calculated at the with-dependents . ZIP code per 37 U.S.C. § 403(b)(3).
OCONUS COLA and OHA location data are typically updated with each app release; exact OCONUS COLA varies slightly by month based on days paid.
Not officially endorsed or sponsored by the U.S. Department of itlements, consult your finance office.

Whether you’re a clinician picking up your next per
bluejetty:00136162:ios.description:
Nursa is the healthcare staffing marketplace that connects nursing professionals looking for flexible work with facilities that need qualified help—directly, without agencies or middlemen.
Whether you’re a clinician picking up your next per diem shift or a facility manager filling a last-minute call-out, Nursa gets it done faster and at lower cost than traditional nurse staffing.
For clinicians
Pick up CNA, LPN, RN, and allied health shifts at hospitals, skilled nursing facilities, and healthcare organizations across 31+ states. Set your own schedule and work on your terms.
Browse nursing shifts near you: Filter by distance, pay, specialty, and schedule to find the PRN jobs that fit your life.
No minimums, no commitments: Work one shift a month or five a week. You decide how much you take on.
Unlock instant payment: Receive eligible payments instantly through Nursa Direct. No waiting for payday.
Manage your credentials in one place: Upload and store your licenses, certifications, and documents.
Rate and review facilities: See how other clinicians rated a facility before you accept a shift. Contribute your own reviews after working.
For facilities
Post open nursing shifts and connect with 400K+ verified, local clinicians. Fill staffing gaps in real time without agency markups or hidden fees.
Post shifts for free: Only pay for completed shifts. Set your own rates and approve pricing before every post. No start-up costs and no surprise fees.
Qualified, pre-verified clinicians: Every professional on the platform undergoes license verification, credential screening, and a robust background check process. Add your own facility-specific screening requirements to get the right clinician fit.
Direct communication: Message clinicians directly to relay instructions or answer questions. No intermediary required.
Try before you hire: Use per diem shifts as working interviews. Evaluate clinicians across multiple shifts before extending a full-time offer, reducing turnover and hiring costs.
Set favorites and turn on Auto-Schedule: Instantly fill your open shifts with screening lists or your reliable bench of favorite clinicians.
Scalable workforce management: From a single facility to a health system, Nursa scales with you. A public API integrates with your existing workforce management tools.
Trusted by 3,100+ facilities and 400,000+ clinicians across 31+ states. Nursa is a technology marketplace built to improve patient care by making nurse staffing faster, more transparent, and more affordable for everyone involved. Download the app and get started today.

bluejetty:00015899:ios.description:
Play Zoombinis and guide the little blue creatures through fun and increasingly challenging puzzles on their way to a new home.
Zoombinis is a re-creation of the classic, award-winning 1990’s puzzle game Logical Journey of the Zoombinis. The small blue creatures, each with distinct personalities and appearances, are escaping imprisonment by the evil Bloats who have taken over the Zoombinis’ home. Players take on the role of guide and help the Zoombinis reach the safety of Zoombiniville.
Use logic, analyze data, spot patterns and hone problem solving skills. Players face a series of increasingly difficult challenges that stand between the Zoombinis and freedom. Twelve perilous puzzles each with 4 levels of increasing difficulty, a great story, and many fun and memorable characters make for an engaging and challenging experience.
We challenge you to get all the Zoombinis to safety!
The Challenges
 • Allergic Cliffs
 • Stone Cold Caves
 • Pizza Pass
 • Captain Cajun’s Ferryboat
 • Titanic Tattooed Toads
 • Stone Rise
 • Fleens
 • Hotel Dimensia
 • Mudball Wall
 • Lion’s Lair
 • BubbleWonder Abyss
 • Mirror Machine
Featuring
 • Beautiful digitally painted backgrounds
 • The original voices for the Narrator, Stone Guards, Pizza Trolls, Captain Cajun, and the Innkeeper
 • Restored music from version 1.0 of the original game
 • Improved celebrations and achievements

bluejetty:00044313:ios.name: Detox Me
bluejetty:00044313:ios.summary: Detox Me is the most reliable healthy lifestyle guide that empowers you to eliminate toxic chemicals from your daily life with simple, research-based tips on reducing your exposures. Many chemicals in consumer product are linked with healt
bluejetty:00044313:ios.description:
Detox Me is the most reliable healthy lifestyle guide that empowers you to eliminate toxic chemicals from your daily life with simple, research-based tips on reducing your exposures. Many chemicals in consumer product are linked with health effects including cancer, asthma, thyroid disease, and developmental problems. Whether you are looking for advice on a better dish soap, a new sofa, or alternative cleaning products, Detox Me arms you with knowledge about the dangers of certain chemicals commonly found in everyday products, such as hormone disruptors, and guides you to make safer choices. Our guide goes beyond just what you buy; it also shows you how making small changes in your daily routine can put you on a path to better health. 
Created by leading scientific experts at Silent Spring Institute, we believe knowledge is not just power, but a prescription for prevention. 
• Over 270 tips in 6 categories: Home, Food and Drink, Clothing, Personal Care, Cleaning, and Children, with Smart Guides for the Top 10 tips in each category. Learn about chemicals in your products and explore ways to avoid them. 
• DIY recipes to replace commercial products that contain endocrine disruptors and other toxics with simple, non-toxic ingredients
• Search for products or scan product barcodes at stores or in your home to see relevant tips 
• Track your progress by marking which tips you are doing and which ones you are working on and earn badges by taking action
• Get reminders about tips 
• Share tips with your family and friends 
"A clever way to avoid toxic chemicals in everyday products." - The Huffington Post
We welcome your feedback, comments and suggestions- email us at detoxme@silentspring.org to get in touch! 
About Silent Spring Institute: 
Silent Spring Institute, located in Newton, Mass., is the leading scientific research organization dedicated to uncovering the link between chemicals in our everyday environments and women's health, with a focus on breast cancer prevention. Founded in 1994, the institute is developing innovative tools to accelerate the transition to safer chemicals, while translating its science into policies that protect health. Visit us at www.silentspring.org and follow us on Twitter @SilentSpringIns

bluejetty:00082318:ios.summary: Invoice Maker Simple Generator is a user-friendly mobile application designed to assist individuals and businesses in creating professional invoices quickly and efficiently. With its intuitive interface and streamlined features, this app is
bluejetty:00082318:ios.description:
Invoice Maker Simple Generator is a user-friendly mobile application designed to assist individuals and businesses in creating professional invoices quickly and efficiently. With its intuitive interface and streamlined features, this app is an essential tool for anyone who needs to generate invoices on the go.
The app offers a straightforward and hassle-free invoice creation process. Users can input essential information such as their company name, logo, address, and contact details, which can be saved for future use to save time. 
To create an invoice, users can effortlessly add products or services, along with their respective quantities and prices. The app performs automatic calculations, ensuring accurate totals and subtotals for each item and the overall invoice.
Once the invoice is finalized, users have the option to preview and review the document before sharing it with clients or customers. The app supports various sharing options, including email, messaging apps, or even direct printing, ensuring efficient delivery of invoices.
Key Features of Invoice Maker Simple Generator:
- User-friendly interface for easy invoice creation.
- Automatic calculations for accurate totals and subtotals.
- Ability to save and reuse company information for future invoices.
- Inclusion of additional notes or terms and conditions.
- Preview and review invoices before sharing.
- Seamless sharing options via email, messaging apps, or printing.

bluejetty:00074324:ios.name: Flight Buddy: Calm Flying
bluejetty:00074324:ios.summary: Experience a strong sense of fear and panic when you fly, or anticipate flying? Does a tiny thought of getting onboard make your hands cold and shaking? Bad news is that you probably have an aerophobia. GOOD NEWS is that you can be cured on
bluejetty:00074324:ios.description:
Experience a strong sense of fear and panic when you fly, or anticipate flying? Does a tiny thought of getting onboard make your hands cold and shaking? Bad news is that you probably have an aerophobia. GOOD NEWS is that you can be cured once and forever! Flight Buddy app is what you need when it’s high time to say NO to your fear of flying. 
We know that crowded space, turbulence, taking off and landing can certainly be unpleasant. That’s why Flight Buddy app is developed by professional pilots and mental health professionals to help you manage alarm symptoms before and during a flight.
HOW THE APP WORKS:
Flight Buddy can become your personal assistant, a real friend, who is always there when you need him. It's like sitting next to a pilot with access to complete flight data! Flight Buddy is an expert. He knows everything about flight stages, aircraft details, turbulence, as well as the root of your fear and the ways to overcome it! 
Flight Buddy gives you more than you can expect:
- FULL ASSESSMENT TEST. 
Take the first step towards knowing yourself and your triggers with the help of a detailed professional test with 30+ questions. Be honest and remember that phobias affect many people, so you are not alone. Find out more about yourself and the reasons of your aerophobia. Remember, that a journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step. 
- ANSWERS TO “WHAT IF” QUESTIONS.
Step onto the airplane with knowledge. Turbulence, panic attack, something will go wrong, malfunction and other common “what if’s” will be explained to you in details. Tune into audio guide or start reading while you are onboard. Knowledge is a power when it comes to conquering your fear of flying. Thus, eventually all you will get is confidence, calm and a great deal of knowledge. 
- FLIGHT INFORMATION.
Make sure, that everything goes according to plan. Flight stages, turbulence tracker, weather conditions, aircraft details, aviation facts, flight speed and altitude, departure and arrival … all this information will help you challenge any irrational fears. 
- FEAR OF FLYING VIDEO COURSE. 
Take a real action towards conquering your fear of flying. Flight Buddy video course offers an easy-to-understand video explanations of how planes stay in the air, what causes turbulence, and what’s behind those scary sounds during takeoff and landing. Understanding how a plane can continue to fly even if an engine fails can help you feel less concerned about aircraft malfunctioning. Learning about safety regulations and pilot training can also present you with facts that challenge irrational fears. 
Aerophobia is nothing to be embarrassed about, but it is something to be honest about. Flying is essential to the modern lifestyle. Do not deprive yourself of the joy of traveling, meeting friends and family, discovering new places and career building. Download the Flight Buddy and let big changes come to your life right away! 
IN-APP PURCHASES:
You can be a premium user through an auto-renewing subscription:
1 Year: $34.99 without trial period. Access to Audio, Exercise,Turbulence Forecast
1 Year: $95.00 without trial period. Full Access to All features
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during an active subscription period.

Privacy Policy: https://phobia.aero/privacy/

bluejetty:00099888:ios.summary:

If you love fun and relaxing puzzle games, Hexa Shift is sure to become your favorite! The rules may be simple but as you progress through the levels, you’ll soon find your logic and sorting s
bluejetty:00099888:ios.description:
► HEXA-MAZING FUN 
If you love fun and relaxing puzzle games, Hexa Shift is sure to become your favorite! The rules may be simple but as you progress through the levels, you’ll soon find your logic and sorting skills improving as you work out which pieces to move in which order. Gamers of all ages and abilities will love the simple graphics, bright colors, and easy to understand rules, so get to puzzling with this hexa-tional game!
► THE MOST RELAXING LOGIC GAME
Each level consists of a playing field that has colorful hexagonal tiles that have small arrows on them. To clear the field, you’ll need to flip the hexagons off, but only after you’ve cleared any that are in the way! Progress through levels and watch the difficulty grow, but also make the most of fun boosters and new features to keep things exciting. Before you know it you’ll be sorting pieces like a pro – not only that, but you might start to see real world applications for you new-found sorting skills.
► Look forward to:
◾Relaxing play: While you’ll need to keep your brain on for this puzzle game, thanks to the simple design and straightforward play, each level will leave you more relaxed than before. As you sort through the pieces and remove them one by one, you’ll be able to truly enjoy the moment.
◾Brain teaser fun: As relaxing as it is to play, don’t let your brain totally turn off! This is a logic puzzle after all, so get ready to analyze the playing field and find the most efficient way of flipping the hexagons off.
◾Great graphics: The only way you’ll be able to achieve both zen-like peace and brain training at the same time is if the game graphics are on point – and ours are. Simple yet bright colors and shapes make it easy to focus on the game, and mean that even young gamers can pick out which hexagons need to move where and sort them with ease.
◾Inclusive gaming: While the levels do become more difficult and challenging, this game is also good fun for beginner gamers of all ages. Everyone can have fun figuring out which piece to remove in which order, and if you don’t pass a level at first, you can just keep trying until you crack the code. Hexational!
► PUT A HEX-AGON ON BOREDOM
Life’s too short to be bored – download Hexa Shift today to fight back! A fun sorting puzzle game that is easy in theory but will still get those cogs turning, you can sit back and enjoy the colorful hexagons, great UI, and so much more as you fly through levels on your way to relaxation. So what are you waiting for, try it today for the ultimate hexagon puzzle.

Gamers of all ages and abilities will love the simple graphics, bright colors, and easy to understand rules, so get to puzzling with this hexa-tional game!
 
► THE MOST RELAXING LOGIC GAME

Each level consists of a playing field that has colorful hexagonal tiles that have small arrows on them. To clear the field, you’ll need to flip the hexagons off, but only after you’ve cleared any that are in the way! Progress through levels and watch the difficulty grow, but also make the most of fun boosters and new features to keep things exciting. Before you know it you’ll be sorting pieces like a pro – not only that, but you might start to see real world applications for you new-found sorting skills.

◾Great graphics: The only way you’ll be able to achieve both zen-like peace and brain training at the same time is if the game graphics are on point – and ours are. Simple yet bright colors and shapes make it easy to focus on the game, and mean that even young gamers can pick out which hexagons need to move where and sort them with ease.

◾Inclusive gaming: While the levels do become more difficult and challenging, this game is also good fun for beginner gamers of all ages. Everyone can have fun figuring out which piece to remove in which order, and if you don’t pass a level at first, you can just keep trying until you crack the code. Hexational!
 
► PUT A HEX-AGON ON BOREDOM

Life’s too short to be bored – download Hexa Shift today to fight back! A fun sorting puzzle game that is easy in theory but will still get those cogs turning, you can sit back and enjoy the colorful hexagons, great UI, and so much more as you fly through levels on your way to relaxation. So what are you waiting for, try it today for the ultimate hexagon puzzle.

Contacts

It can also be used not only for music practice, but for exercise, workouts, and studying.
Additionally, an option to remove ads is now available.

Wooden

Supports up to 300 BPM

Built-in timer

bluejetty:00062681:ios.description:
Skat is a trick taking card game. It is the most popular German card game played by over 20 million people. The Skat app was #1 card game for over six weeks in the German App Store. 
Play the original on iPad and enjoy many hours of intensive gameplay! 
Highlights: 
- Strong computer opponents 
- German and French deck of cards 
- Replay and in-game help for beginners 
- Customize the rules with Kontra, Re, Bock and Ramsch 
- Choose from three great background scenes 
- Select your own photos for the computer opponents 
Warning: The spoken game sound and some advanced training material is in German language only. Please contact the authors if you are interested in a localized version. Thank you! 
SKAT for iPad is based on the desktop version of Skat for Mac and PC. For 20 years this is one of the most favored computer skat games. 
Learn more at www.skat-game.com

bluejetty:00086603:ios.description:
1999 yılında temelleri atılan ve zamanla internetteki en büyük türkçe referans kaynağı olan ekşi'nin yepyeni mobil uygulaması.
‘’ekşi’’ uygulaması ile sözlük gündemini ve başlıklarını takip edebilir, entry girebilir, ilgi duyduğunuz konularla ilgili arama yapabilir ve diğer kullanıcılarla mesajlaşabilirsiniz.
‘’ekşi’’ uygulamasında öne çıkan özellikler:
- sözlük entry'lerinin akışını yansıtan yeni bir ana sayfa arayüzü,
- anlık mesajlaşma özelliği,
- profil fotoğrafı ekleyebilme seçeneği,
- facebook entegrasyonu.
ekşi’yi tüm platformlarda (uygulama, masaüstü, mobil, tablet) reklamsız görüntülemek için aylık veya yıllık abonelik seçeneklerimizden yararlanabilirsiniz. abonelik süreniz boyunca banner reklamlar ve videolar ile karşılaşmazsınız. aboneliğiniz sadece bir Sözlük hesabı için geçerlidir.
Abonelik İşlemleri:
Abonelik satın alma işlemini onayladığınızda ilgili ödeme iTunes hesabınıza yansıtılır. Abonelik dönemi sona ermeden en geç 24 saat önce aboneliğinizi iptal etmezseniz otomatik olarak yenilenir. Yenileme bedeli ise mevcut abonelik dönemi sona ermeden önceki 24 saat içinde iTunes hesabınıza yansıtılır. Aboneliğiniz başladıktan sonra hesap ayarlarına giderek otomatik yenilemeyi kapatabilirsiniz. Aboneliğinizi dilediğiniz zaman mevcut aboneliğinizin bitiş tarihinden itibaren geçerli olacak şekilde iptal edebilirsiniz.   
Gizlilik Politikası: https://eksisozluk.com/entry/66470645
Kullanım Koşulları: https://eksisozluk.com/entry/19784395

bluejetty:00043329:ios.description:
Vďaka O2 Aplikácii máte svoju spotrebu vždy pod kontrolou, vybavíte si nový paušál či SIM kartu, založíte si skupinu O2 Spolu plnú výhod, uhradíte faktúry alebo získate milé prekvapenia. 
Byť v skupine O2 Spolu sa oplatí. Čím viac programov v skupine si spojíte, tým viac benefitov si spoločne môžete užívať. Môžete získať finančnú odmenu až 10 € mesačne, dáta navyše pre všetkých členov po prečerpaní predplatených dát alebo aj dáta navyše aj mimo EÚ. A O2 Prekvapenia majú všetci členovia výhodnejšie. 
S novou službou O2 Connect môžete zdieľať dáta, volania a SMS/MMS z vášho paušálu aj s ďalšími smart zariadeniami, napríklad tabletom či smart hodinkami.
A ak potrebujete vyriešiť niečo zložitejšie, jednoducho sa spojíte s našou podporou cez chat priamo v aplikácií. 
Čo vybavíte v aplikácií?
- kontrolujete svoju aktuálnu spotrebu
- vyberiete si, ako chcete dostávať oznamy – SMS alebo push notifikácie
- vytvoríte a spravujete skupinu O2 Spolu
- aktivujete, deaktivujete alebo upravíte balíky a služby
- aktivujete službu O2 Connect a spravujete svoje zariadenia
- uhradíte faktúry alebo dobijete kredit (kartou alebo cez Google Pay)
- bezplatne kontaktujete našu podporu cez chat
- vybavíte svojim deťom SIM kartu O2 Junior a máte ich používanie pod kontrolou
- aktivujete O2 Cestovné poistenie
- tešíte sa z Prekvapení každý týždeň
O2 Paušál so SIM odteraz kúpite digitálne cez aplikáciu bez toho, aby ste museli niekam chodiť. Vybavte si ho odteraz pár klikmi, hoci aj v autobuse.
S detskou SIM kartou O2 Junior máte bezpečnosť svojich detí na internete pod kontrolou. Pridajte ju do O2 Spolu a využívajte spoločné benefity naplno.
Ste s aplikáciou spokojní?
Veľmi nás poteší, ak pridáte vaše hodnotenie 5 hviezdičiek. Ak niečo nefunguje alebo sa vám niečo nepáči, napíšte nám na kontakt@o2.sk.

bluejetty:00015220:ios.name: Fairies Coloring Book
bluejetty:00015220:ios.summary: Beautiful fairies will show you their amazing world. It's full of fragrant flowers, berries and fresh summer air. The land of fairies is populated by charming inhabitants. They look like elegant butterflies fluttering around. But look close
bluejetty:00015220:ios.description:
Beautiful fairies will show you their amazing world. It's full of fragrant flowers, berries and fresh summer air. The land of fairies is populated by charming inhabitants. They look like elegant butterflies fluttering around. But look closer! You will see cute little creatures with weightless wings. Fairies like to dream, play and take care of the world around them. They are curious and romantic. Besides, these little creatures are really into fashion. Colorful dresses, trendy hair styles and bright wings with one-of-a-kind patterns make each fairy unique.
Benefits: 
◦ Teaching children simple arithmetic. Addition and subtraction
◦ Coloring by geometrical figures and pictograms
◦ Coloring by letters
◦ Very simple program interface that any child can master 
◦ Easy-to-use palette that allows you to put together your own unique set of colors
◦ High-quality drawings of all pictures 
◦ Visual effects and sound effects 
◦ Pleasing background music 
◦ Colored pictures automatically saved on closing the program
◦ And many other useful features that make coloring entertaining
Paint by numbers - an interactive coloring book for children. This mathematical game teaches children to recognize numbers and solve simple mathematical examples. In addition, this program develops memory, attention, imagination, and logical abilities.
Boys and girls of all ages love to color. The simple coloring mode is suitable for the smallest of children, including those of kindergarten and preschool age. These include simple and recognizable images that are easy to color. If the child selects the wrong shape, then they will be prompted with the correct number. Therefore, the picture will always be colored correctly, and the child will quickly memorize the numbers. Children can choose to color by geometrical figures and pictograms in addition to numbers. A child can easily distinguish a square from a circle, diamond, and triangle.
School-age children will enjoy the complex coloring mode. Here the picture is divided into a large number of elements, thus making it difficult at first to determine what it depicts. Older children can complicate the task by adding addition and subtraction tasks. Now children will need to solve the examples and choose the correct answers in order to color the picture. This will teach the child how to quickly do arithmetic in their mind.
Those who are learning the alphabet can choose to color by letter. Coloring by letters will be useful for children preparing to enter primary school.
To make the coloring process more interesting and fun, you can change any of the preset colors. To do this, press and hold the jar of paint and a palette will open. Then you can choose your favorite color. Thus, all the shaded areas of the image can be changed in the coloring by number mode. You can have fun by changing the color scheme to suit your taste. Try the program right now!

bluejetty:00061157:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00061157:ios.description:
What if your Bible app actually helped you understand what you're reading? 
Downloaded over 8M times around the world with over 400,000 5 star reviews, Olive Tree is the free Bible study app that puts trusted commentaries, original language tools, and expert resources right alongside your Bible text — giving you the clarity to study Scripture with real confidence. Everything downloads to your device so you can study offline, anytime. 
Most Bible apps just give you the text and leave you on your own. Olive Tree is different. Our unique Study Center tracks with what you're reading and automatically syncs to show you relevant information from the resources in your personal library — no searching required. Whether you're studying for yourself, leading a group, or preparing to teach, you need tools that go as deep as you want to. 
UNDERSTAND WHAT YOU'RE READING 
- Use the Resource Guide to reference relevant commentary and study notes. 
- Compare translations side by side with the parallel feature. 
- View cross-references and see thematic connections throughout the Bible. 
- Use Greek and Hebrew tools to study the Scripture’s original languages.  
BUILD A CONSISTENT BIBLE STUDY HABIT 
- Choose from dozens of reading plans — short devotionals to year-long Bible journeys. 
- Set daily reminders and track your progress. 
- Pick up where you left off on any device. 
- 5 free major Bible translations including ESV, NIV, KJV, NKJV, CSB and more. 
TAKE YOUR STUDY ANYWHERE 
- Offline Bibles: Download Bibles and study resources for full offline access 
- Highlight, bookmark, and take notes as you study. 
- Syncs seamlessly across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and more. 
LISTEN AND LEARN ON THE GO 
- Listen to Audio Bibles in popular translations — narrated or dramatized 
- Follow along in the text while you listen. 
- Free BibleProject videos for every book of the Bible. 
GET STARTED WITH GUIDANCE 
- Not sure where to start? Get one of our Bible Study Pack subscriptions with hand-picked tools and step-by-step training. 
- Thousands of commentaries, study Bibles, devotionals, and more in the Olive Tree store. 
- Buy individual resources or subscribe — affordable options to fit your style. 
Whether you're a first-time reader, a small group leader, or a pastor preparing a message, Olive Tree meets you where you are and helps you go further. 
SUBSCRIPTION PAYMENT INFORMATION 
Olive Tree subscriptions will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase and/or completion of a free trial. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial or current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.

Terms of use: https://www.olivetree.com/press/privacy.php#terms 
Privacy policy: https://www.olivetree.com/press/privacy.php

bluejetty:00099976:ios.description:
Bulk Up! Rush
 Run, train, grow, and smash your way to the top!
Step into the wild world of Bulk Up! Rush, the action-packed fitness runner where every move makes your stickman stronger. Your goal is simple yet thrilling: eat up every fitness item in your path, avoid dangerous traps, and transform your skinny runner into a muscular powerhouse. At the finish line, unleash all that strength in a mighty punch against the power meter and prove just how strong you’ve become!
This is not just another endless runner. It’s a high-energy blend of fitness, growth, and explosive action that keeps you coming back for more. Whether you’re aiming for the biggest muscles, the highest score, or the coolest look, every run is a chance to push past your limits and show off your gains.
Game Features:
 Dynamic Muscle Growth: Watch your stickman evolve in real time, from a skinny beginner to a muscle-bound champion. Every item you collect brings visible gains and new levels of strength.
 Thrilling Obstacle Runs: Dodge dangerous objects that threaten to weaken you. Timing and precision are the keys to keeping your power intact.
 Powerful Finish: All your progress leads to the ultimate showdown—hit the power meter with everything you’ve got and see how far your strength can take you.
 Customizable Skins: Unlock a variety of unique skins and styles to make your stickman stand out while you bulk up. Personalize your runner and show off your own fitness journey.
 Easy to Play, Hard to Master: Intuitive swipe controls make it simple to pick up, but chasing the perfect run and maximum score will keep you hooked.
Why You’ll Love Bulk Up! Rush:
 Every run is a new challenge and a new opportunity to grow. Feel the satisfaction as your character visibly bulks up, avoid setbacks with quick reflexes, and enjoy the rush of smashing through the finish with all the power you’ve built. With endless replay value, stylish customization, and that addictive “just one more run” feeling, Bulk Up! Rush delivers nonstop fun for players of all ages.
Are you ready to flex your way to victory? Download Bulk Up! Rush now and start your ultimate muscle-building adventure today!

bluejetty:00028118:ios.name: The Oregon Trail: Boom Town
bluejetty:00028118:ios.summary: Get ready to experience life as a pioneer in this reimagining of the classic game, The Oregon Trail! A game that combines adventure, simulation, and settlement survival. Build, grow, craft and harvest as you turn the small frontier village,
bluejetty:00028118:ios.description:
Get ready to experience life as a pioneer in this reimagining of the classic game, The Oregon Trail! A game that combines adventure, simulation, and settlement survival. Build, grow, craft and harvest as you turn the small frontier village, of Independence Missouri, into a thriving boom town!
Dysentery, Cholera, Typhoid and snakes - oh my! Help Settlers survive the dangerous journey west in this re-imagining of the classic game, The Oregon Trail!
Send Your Wagons West!
Help pioneers survive the trail, and prepare for their dangerous journey across the Oregon Trail and outfit settlers with all the supplies they need to survive! Follow the progress of the Pioneers as their wagons forge the way west across America’s frontier on their way to a new life. The wagons may call for supplies along the way, so be ready to collect resources and send them food, tomatoes, corn, eggs, medicine, clothes or whatever else they need to survive. Challenge your survival skills as you fix your wagons and face the harsh desert conditions.
Make Independence Your Own Town!
Create the town of your dreams in this town-building simulator game! Start with building marketplaces, shops, and saloons on your own land. Upgrade with a port, rail station, museum, or even a university for your villagers. Arrange and rearrange your layout. Add decorations, design, upgrade and monuments to make your town beautiful. As you level up, new buildings are unlocked, opening exciting new possibilities. With hard work and creativity, you can truly build the Independence of your dreams!
Farm, Build, Craft!
Design, Manage and grow your very own frontier boom town in this farming and city building simulator inspired by the classic game The Oregon Trail! Plant, collect, and harvest crops, raise and care for a variety of farm animals on the land, build stores, factories and more as you help prepare pioneers for their journey west along The Oregon Trail. The town of their dreams is in your hands!
Join Events and Clans!
Go beyond your own town to participate in a wide variety of weekly and seasonal events. You can connect with your friends or family, join a clan, and compete or collaborate in special challenges.
Are you ready? Do you have the skill, foresight, and creativity to turn Independence into a Boom Town? Hopeful settlers are gathering in Independence, counting on you to make their dreams come

bluejetty:00174483:ios.description:
Are you a coin collector looking to identify your latest find? Or maybe you stumbled upon a coin and want to know its value? Well, look no further! Introducing the new Coin Identifier - your one-stop-shop for all things coin-related. With just a snap of a picture, our app can identify your coin, provide detailed information about its history, estimate coin value, and even connect you with coin sellers and buyers. No more sifting through endless coin catalogs or scouring the internet for hours. Our app makes coin collecting easy, fun, and profitable. 
Key CoinIn features: 
Identify coins at lightning speed 
You won't have to spend hours searching through reference books or browsing the internet for visual confirmation.
Accurately identify over 270,000 coins 
Our large database contains more than 270 000 coins and allows you to identify any kind of coin. CoinIn scanner takes into account the type of material, time of creation, and coin condition, to provide you with the most precise and reliable information. 
Recognize rare, foreign, and error coins
Whether you're one of the seasoned coin collectors looking for a rare gem, or a newbie who’s just starting out, CoinIn has got you covered. 
Follow coin collection trends 
Stay up to date with the coin collection series and be the first to add new gold and metal coins to your collection. 
Create a personalized online collection
Record, store, and access your collections right in the app anytime, anywhere. 
With CoinIn, you can turn your coin collection into a treasure trove - get started today!
About CoinIn Subscription:
- When you purchase CoinIn app subscription, the payment will be charged to your iTunes Account after confirmation. 
- The subscription will automatically renew, unless you turn off the auto-renew option at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. 
- The cost of renewal will be identified and charged to your account within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. 
- If there is any unused portion of a free trial period offered, it will be forfeited upon purchasing a subscription to the publication. 
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by accessing your Account Settings after purchase. 
Ready to identify coins with ease? Get CoinIn today!
Please note that terms and conditions, as well as our privacy policy, apply.
Privacy Policy: https://legal.coininapp.com/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://legal.coininapp.com/terms-of-service.html

- ตรวจเลขสลากได้ครั้งละหลายๆใบ ใช้งานง่าย สะดวก
- บันทึกเลขสลาก เก็บประวัติ เรียงตามงวด หรือ เรียงตามเลขที่กรอก

bluejetty:00083222:ios.name: Livekick - Live Virtual Yoga
bluejetty:00083222:ios.summary: Livekick is a live virtual studio for yoga, meditation, and mindful movement. You practice in real time with teachers you would otherwise have to travel to a retreat to find, in a virtual room of people doing the same thing at the same mome
bluejetty:00083222:ios.description:
Livekick is a live virtual studio for yoga, meditation, and mindful movement. You practice in real time with teachers you would otherwise have to travel to a retreat to find, in a virtual room of people doing the same thing at the same moment.
What you can practice
Yoga. Vinyasa, slow flow, yin, and power, taught for every level. New to it or twenty years in, there is a class and a teacher for where you actually are today.
Kundalini. Breath, movement, mantra, and kriya. Structured sequences that work on the nervous system as much as the body.
Meditation. Short sits and longer guided practices, with no experience assumed. Our teachers build the habit first and let the depth follow.
Somatic movement. Slow, internally led practice where you follow sensation instead of a shape. A good place to start if a traditional class feels like too much.
TRE. Tension and trauma releasing exercises, guided by trained facilitators. A gentle sequence that invites the body's own tremor response and lets held tension move.
Ecstatic dance. Free-form movement to a live DJ set. No choreography, no mirrors, no one watching.
Live virtual classes
Save your spot, get a reminder, and join from the app. Classes run in real time with the teacher present, powered by Zoom. Your spot includes a replay.
On-demand library
Thousands of on-demand classes, searchable by teacher, style, and length. Take one at 6am or 11pm, in ten minutes or ninety.
Workshops and special events
Longer workshops and virtual festivals throughout the year, with the teachers and community leaders people usually have to book months ahead to sit with.
Membership
One membership covers the on-demand library and member pricing on live virtual classes. Class packs are there if you would rather buy in blocks.
How it works
Browse the schedule, and save your spot in a live virtual class, or watch an on-demand replay. Everything you have booked or bought lives in your library.

bluejetty:00078025:ios.summary:
UTA On Demand makes it easier than ever to move around select zones in the greater Salt Lake City area — with a few taps, book a ride using the app and we’ll pair you with others headed your way. No detours, no delays.
What we’re about:
SH
bluejetty:00078025:ios.description:
UTA On Demand makes it easier than ever to move around select zones in the greater Salt Lake City area — with a few taps, book a ride using the app and we’ll pair you with others headed your way. No detours, no delays.
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our algorithm matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency of a shared one.
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your community a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride. 
AFFORDABLE
An adult one-way fare is only $2.50, so grab your friends and take a ride!
How does UTA On Demand work?
UTA On Demand is an on-demand travel concept that takes multiple passengers heading in the same direction and books them into a shared vehicle. Using the UTA On Demand app, input your address and we’ll match you with a vehicle going your way. We’ll pick you up on a nearby corner and drop you off within a short walk of your chosen destination. 
Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating. You’ll have our eternal gratitude.

bluejetty:00115861:ios.summary:
Key Features
Access to Exclusive Drops
Shop limited product releases only available in the Complex App. From rare brand collabs to limited-run artist merch and fashion exclusives, stay ahead of the curve and never miss a drop.
Stay Clos
bluejetty:00115861:ios.description:
Key Features
Access to Exclusive Drops
Shop limited product releases only available in the Complex App. From rare brand collabs to limited-run artist merch and fashion exclusives, stay ahead of the curve and never miss a drop.
Stay Close to the Culture
Browse fresh, content daily - from fashion editorials and music updates to sneaker news and viral moments. Tap into stories that break first on Complex and shape the cultural conversation.
Curated & Exclusive Content
From deep dives on emerging trends to behind-the-scenes features, Complex brings you stories that matter now. Everything is written by editors shaping the culture- not chasing it.
Complex Cover Stories
Go deep with the biggest names in music, fashion, and entertainment. Complex Cover delivers original longform features, in-depth interviews, and rich visuals you won’t find anywhere else - made for readers who want more than a headline.
Shoppable Articles and Videos
Shop while you scroll. Our editorial features and videos are integrated with products, so you can instantly tap into the looks, pieces, and drops you see.
Curated Marketplace
Discover over 100 of the world’s coolest streetwear and lifestyle brands. From iconic labels to emerging designers, explore sneakers, hoodies, bags, jewelry, home goods, and collectibles - expertly curated by the Complex Style team.
Seamless Purchase Experience
Checkout is fast, simple, and secure. Use Apple Pay or Shop Pay to purchase in seconds - no forms, no friction, just instant shopping so you never miss a product drop.
Artist Merch
Access official merch from your favorite artists. From capsule collections to exclusive tour pieces, Complex brings you music-inspired fashion that’s always authentic and on point.
Vinyl Collection Picks
For collectors and audiophiles alike, explore editor-curated vinyl releases across hip hop, R&B, and cult classics. Whether you’re building your shelf or spinning daily, find records that sound as good as they look.
Drop Alerts
Receive news about upcoming drops and get notified when drops go live. Because culture moves fast, and now you never miss a moment.
Past Collaborators & Cultural Icons
We’ve worked with and feature products from some of the most iconic names in music, fashion, and art, including:
Billie Eilish, Travis Scott, A$AP Rocky, Kid Cudi, BLACKPINK, Post Malone, Juice WRLD, Olivia Rodrigo, Pharrell, 21 Savage, Justin Bieber, Eminem, Lil Baby, Ice Spice, Karol G.
Why Complex?
Complex doesn’t just cover culture - it helps shape it. For over 20 years, Complex has been the go-to source for what’s next in music, streetwear, fashion, and internet culture. Now, the Complex App makes that influence interactive: original stories, curated shopping, and insider drops - all in one place. We don’t just tell you what’s trending - we connect you to the brands, artists, and products behind it. This is where discovery meets credibility.
Download Now To:
• Shop exclusive fashion and sneaker drops from 100+ brands
• Access to Complex News, Style, and Music content
• Browse shoppable articles and videos with integrated product links
• Watch original Complex video series like “Sneaker Shopping”
• Get notified for upcoming drops
• Discover the best in artist merch, vinyl records, and streetwear
• Get insider updates on ComplexCon artists, vendors, and brand collabs
Complex: Download the app. Stay close to the culture.

bluejetty:00074277:ios.description:
Parking convenience is at your fingertips with the ParkDetroit app. Pay for parking on your mobile device, get notified before your time runs out, and extend your time without visiting a parking meter (note that time extension rules vary location by location).
Key features of the app include:
 • Mobile Payments via smart phone or web
 • On-street occupancy (for select locations)
 • Find my car (for those of us who forget where they parked)
 • Face ID
 • Event parking
 • Garage/lot parking
Registration for ParkDetroit is free: just create your account via the app. Once you’ve created an account, you can park and pay for parking in any location parking is available in Detroit. 
How to Use the App:
 • Create an account 
 • Choose the vehicle license plate
 • Select your location on the map
 • Use the dial to choose how long you want to park 
 • Confirm your payment
Payment with ParkDetroit is ultra secure. Your data is protected and our process is certified via 3rd party audit against Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards.

bluejetty:00015339:ios.description:
Dive into a vibrant Dinosaur World where your child embarks on an epic adventure, combining the thrill of learning through play in a captivating environment. "Jurassic Rescue – Dinosaur Go!" is a perfect blend of fun and education, specially designed as one of the best games for kids aged 2-5.
Travel with T-rex across picturesque mountains, deserts, and forests, seeking out friends like the mighty Tyrannosaurus, nimble Pterodactyl, aquatic Spinosaurus, agile Dilophosaurus, melodic Parasaurolophus, sturdy Triceratops, long-necked Diplodocus, and armored Ankylosaurus. Your little one will be enchanted by the amazing dinosaurs and their adventures, all while learning and exploring!
Key Features:
• Dive into a Dinosaur Park adventure rescuing 9 unique dinosaur friends.
• Engage with over 50 lively animations that enhance learning games and exploration.
• Experience child-friendly sound effects that perfectly complement the colorful graphics and animations.
• Benefit from kid-friendly controls making gameplay intuitive and safe for preschool kids.
• Immerse in a clean gaming environment with no third-party advertising.
About Yateland:
Yateland designs educational games with a profound sense of purpose: fostering learning through play. We inspire preschoolers worldwide with apps that spark curiosity while being rooted in educational value. Upholding our motto: "Apps children love and parents trust," we remain dedicated to providing superior quality games for kids. For more insights, visit https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy:
Ensuring user privacy remains our utmost priority. Yateland is steadfastly committed to transparent and protective measures. To get an in-depth view of our privacy practices, please read our detailed policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

bluejetty:00030827:ios.description:
The best way to view Nevada 511 traffic alerts, road conditions and travel information.
MAIN FEATURES INCLUDE:
 + NDOT 511 Traffic Incidents
 + Road Closures & Planned Events
 + Customizable Push Notifications
 + CCTV Traffic Cameras
 + Home Screen Widgets
 + Winter Driving Weather
NDOT TRAFFIC INCIDENTS INCLUDE:
Traffic collisions, advisories, hazards, weather / wind advisories, heavy traffic, road closures, planned construction
CCTV CAMERAS
Create customized groups of CCTV cameras for viewing traffic on your route. This feature gives users a quick way of assessing road and traffic conditions.
HOME SCREEN CAMERA WIDGETS
Add up to (4) home screen widgets displaying your favorite CCTV cams.
PUSH NOTIFICATIONS
Track NDOT incidents and receive Push Notifications when new updates are available. The app also sends notifications when an incident is no longer being tracked by NDOT. This feature is critical for staying up-to-date on road closures due to accidents. 
WINTER DRIVING WEATHER:
 - NOAA Snowfall Reports
 - Current Radar
 - NWS Watches & Warnings
 - Winter Weather Severity Index
TERMS & CONDITIONS
https://lwbrandsllc.com/nevada-road-conditions-app-terms-conditions/

Get cash when you need it with Everdraft™. Access up to $1,000 of your verified incoming deposits in minutes. No interest, no credit checks, no due dates.

No payday loan fees or interest charges

* Reports to Experian, Equifax, TransUnion
* Automatic monthly reporting
* Build credit while you spend
AI AGENTS THAT WORK 24/7
Beem's AI agents maximize every dollar:
JobsGPT - Finds gigs and full-time jobs matching your skills
DealsGPT - Surfaces verified discounts before you shop anywhere
PriceGPT - Compares prices automatically on receipts and products

COMPLETE BANKING PLATFORM
* Direct deposit arrives up to 2 days early
* FDIC insurance up to $250,000 (via partner bank)
* Send money free to anyone (no Beem account required)
* Earn cashback on gas, groceries, dining, shopping
* Debit card with no monthly fees
* Mobile check deposit from anywhere
COMPREHENSIVE PROTECTION
* Job Loss Protection: Get up to $1,000 when employment changes
* Beem Health: 24/7 virtual doctor, pharmacy savings, dental, vision, counseling
* Wysh Life Benefit: Coverage for loved ones (Plus/Pro members)
* Beem TotalCare: Save on device protection (AKKO), mindfulness (Headspace), fitness (FitOn Pro), password security (Dashlane)
TRUSTED BY 3 MILLION+ USERS
Over $100 million in cash advances disbursed
$300 million in total payments processed
$500 million in debt traps prevented
Average user credit score improvement: 67 points
BETTER THAN THE COMPETITION
vs Dave: Higher cash advance limits ($1,000 vs $500) + automatic credit building
vs Chime: Cash advances + automatic credit building (no separate card)
vs Cleo: More cash ($1,000 vs $250) + 4 specialized AI agents

vs Brigit: 4x higher cash limits + AI optimization tools
vs MoneyLion: Lower fees + automatic credit building

ELIGIBILITY
U.S. resident, age 18 or older
Valid Social Security Number or ITIN
Active checking account
Regular income (for higher cash advance amounts)
FEES & TERMS
No monthly account fees
No overdraft fees
No minimum balance required
Free standard transfers (1-3 business days)
Optional instant transfer fee for immediate cash
Subscription plans available for premium features
DISCLOSURES
Cash Advances: Everdraft™ gives access to verified incoming deposits. Optional expedited delivery fees apply.

bluejetty:00122420:ios.summary:
쉽게 시작하고, 
나답게 완성하는 금융
당신의 생활과 가치를 담은
나의 첫 금융앱, i-ONE Bank 
(IBK고객센터 1588-2588, 상담시간 : 평일 09시~18시)
■ 계좌 없이도 시작할 수 있는 나의 첫 금융앱
ㅤ• 계좌개설 없이 회원가입 후 앱 서비스 이용
ㅤ• 로그인을 하지 않아도 i-ONE Bank 서비스 둘러보기 제공
ㅤ• 누구나 손쉽게 사용 가능한 조회・이체・상품가입 기능 제공을 통해 금융 초보자도 쉽게

나답게 완성하는 금융

나의 첫 금융앱, i-ONE Bank 
(IBK고객센터 1588-2588, 상담시간 : 평일 09시~18시)
■ 계좌 없이도 시작할 수 있는 나의 첫 금융앱
ㅤ• 계좌개설 없이 회원가입 후 앱 서비스 이용
ㅤ• 로그인을 하지 않아도 i-ONE Bank 서비스 둘러보기 제공
ㅤ• 누구나 손쉽게 사용 가능한 조회・이체・상품가입 기능 제공을 통해 금융 초보자도 쉽게 시작
■ 간편한 인증방식으로 손쉬운 사용
ㅤ• 복잡한 공동인증서 없이 패턴, 지문, 얼굴 등으로 간편하게 로그인
ㅤ• 인증비밀번호(숫자6자리), 바이오정보로 쉽게 이체, 상품가입, 뱅킹거래 등 모든 은행 업무 가능
■ 나에게 꼭 맞는 홈 화면
ㅤ• 자산, 상품, 뱅킹, 혜택, 주식 5개의 테마로 구성
ㅤ• 홈 화면에서 주거래계좌 잔액조회 및 이체를 한번에
ㅤ• 개인별 금융 생활 패턴에 맞춘 웰컴 메시지 제공
ㅤ• 나만의 홈, 자주 사용하는 나만의 맞춤메뉴 제공
ㅤ• 고객 맞춤형 상품 및 서비스 추천
■ 투자 정보부터 증권계좌 개설까지 주식 메뉴 신설
ㅤ• (주식 홈) 주제별 빠른 주가 현황 제공
ㅤ• (고수의 종목Pick) 고수들이 선택한 종목을 알려주는 
ㅤ• (IBK투자매거진) 금융팁은 물론 유익한 투자정보 제공
■ 고객의 사용성을 위한 UI 개선
ㅤ• 감각적인 다크모드 UI를 적용하여 눈의 피로를 낮추고 사용성 향상
ㅤ• 앱 이용에 취약한 고객도 쉽게 이용할 수 있도록 쉬운뱅킹 제공
ㅤ• i-ONE Bank만의 일관된 가이드를 바탕으로 금융 서비스에 적합한 UX 제공
■ 더욱 편리하고 빨라진 이체
ㅤ• (톡톡송금) 언제 어디서나 휴대폰을 흔들어 톡톡 누르면 지정계좌로 송금
ㅤ• (다건이체) 여러사람에게 동시에 쉽고 빠르게 송금 가능
ㅤ• (촬영송금) 계좌번호를 입력할 필요 없이 촬영으로 바로 송금
ㅤ• (즐겨찾기) 자주 이용하는 입금계좌는 그룹별로 저장하여 관리
■ 은행 최초 통합 보안 플랫폼 i-ONE 가드
i-ONE Bank의 모든 보안서비스를 한 눈에! 통합 관리
ㅤ• (i-ONE 백신) 단말위협, 원격제어, 앱OS 위변조, 행위위협 등 안전한 i-ONE Bank 이용을 위한 보안위협 실시간 자동 차단
ㅤ• (내 스마트폰 진단) 위협앱 진단, 피싱 문자(SNS) 진단, 전화 조작 진단, 악성 URL/QR 진단 등 스마트폰에 잠재된 위험 요소를 직접 점검
ㅤ• (i-ONE 가드) 전자금융 로그인 및 이용 관리, 신분증 도용 관리, 여신거래 및 비대면 계좌개설 안심차단 등 비대면 금융거래 방법과 형태를 사전에 관리
■ 마이데이터 기반 자산관리 서비스
ㅤ• (My자산) 각 금융기관에 흩어져 있는 금융정보를 한번에 통합 조회
ㅤ• (My지출) 지출내역 분석, 목표예산/고정비용 관리, 필요비용/현금흐름 관리, 소비패턴/카드실적 관리
ㅤ• (My리포트) 순자산, 자산분포, 투자수익, 부채현황 종합 분석 리포트
ㅤ• (신용관리) 신용점수 조회, 상세 변동내역, 맞춤 신용 가이드, 신용점수 올리기
ㅤ• (부동산) 부동산 시세/실거래가 정보, 청약컨설팅, 분양정보, 부동산 계산기
ㅤ• (자산모으기) 투자성향 분석, 포트폴리오 추천/가입, 안쓰기 챌린지 상품가입
■ 나를 아는 상품몰
ㅤ• 빅데이터 분석을 통한 고객별 맞춤상품 추천
ㅤ• 유사한 금융성향을 가진 고객들을 분석한 빅데이터 리포트 제공
■ 세대별/직업별 맞춤 서비스 클럽/라운지
ㅤ• 세대별 클럽을 통해 내게 맞는 상품 및 서비스 제공
ㅤ• (군인) 입대 전 준비부터, 휴가, 제대 후를 위한 대비까지 군생활 맞춤 서비스
ㅤ• (아이) 출산 준비를 위한 산모, 아이 양육을 위한 육아 서비스 제공
ㅤ• (직장인) 직장인 맞춤 상품 추천과 혜택 및 편 서비스 제공
■ 다양한 공공서비스 지원을 위한 공공+
ㅤ• 정부혜택, 서류발급, 여행, 자동차 등 분야별 공공서비스 통합 제공
■ 풍요로운 이색 서비스
ㅤ• 금융뿐 아니라 공동구매, 게임, 선물하기 등 생활밀착형 이색 서비스 제공 
■ 내곁에 AI비서 챗봇
ㅤ• 고객 친밀감과 편의성을 높일 수 있게 트렌드에 맞는 스타일 적용
ㅤ• (큐레이션) 고객별 필요정보를 키워드로 추천
ㅤ• (금융거래) 주요 뱅킹거래를 채팅창에서 즉시 해결
ㅤ• (메뉴찾기) 원하는 메뉴를 말하면 바로 이동 가능
■ 앱 권한 정보 안내
- 연락처(선택) : 연락처 송금, 이체 후 SMS 전송 시 연락처를 불러올 때 사용합니다.
- 카메라(선택) : 신분증 촬영 및 서류제출, 공동인증서 복사 시 QR코드 촬영, 제로페이 QR코드 촬영, 지로용지 촬영, 프로필 사진 촬영을 위해 사용합니다.
- 사진라이브러리(선택) : 프로필 사진 등록, 통장표지 등 이미지 저장을 위해 필요합니다.
- 알림(선택) : 금융정보, 이벤트 등 PUSH전송을 위해 사용합니다.
- 위치(선택) : 전자금융 이용위치 설정 서비스 등을 위해 위치정보를 활용합니다.
- 마이크(선택) : 챗봇, 통합검색에서 음성 검색 시, IBK디지털본인인증 요청 시 사용합니다.
- 셀룰러데이터(선택) : 셀룰러 통신환경(3G/LTE/5G)에서 원활한 앱 접속을 위해 사용합니다.
- FaceID(선택) : 얼굴 인증 등록, 로그인에 사용됩니다.
※ IBK기업은행 고객님의 원활한 앱 이용을 위해 최소한의 접근권한을 요청합니다.
※ 선택적 접근권한은 동의하지 않아도 서비스를 이용할 수 있으나, 일부 기능 사용에 제한이 있을 수 있습니다.
※ 접근권한 변경방법(제조사별 설정방식 다를 수 있습니다)
ㅤ• 휴대전화 설정 > 앱 > IBK기업은행

bluejetty:00071213:ios.description:
BOCHK Mobile Banking
Live Easy, Control Smartly
Bank Account Opening, Wealth Management, Investment and Spending All in One App
【One-stop to Take Care of All Your Financial Needs】
．Account opening: With just a HKID card and address, you can open an account without visiting a branch. Account opening can be completed in a few minutes.
．Money transfer: Funds can be transferred via FPS instantly.
．Bill payment: Pay bills for over 850 merchants, with the flexibility to choose between paying with your account or credit card. You can also set reminders, schedule regular payments, and authorize direct payments, making bill management more convenient.
．Time deposit: Flexibly choose from a variety of multi-currency time deposit plans to help you save and grow your money for the future.
．Investment: Trade Hong Kong stocks, China A shares, US stocks, funds, foreign exchange, bonds, and apply for IPOs in one app. A series of investment tools, such as Stock and FX widgets, PickAStock, PlanAhead and Smart Invest help you invest more strategically.
．Credit card: Check your credit card points and enjoy privileges on dining, shopping, and entertainment. You can also check your card balance and choose to pay in installments.
．Insurance: Easily purchase travel, savings, life protection, critical illness, and home insurance, and check your policy information at any time.
．Personal loan: "BOC Express Cash" allows for easy application and low-interest loans. You can choose the repayment period according to your preference.
．Cross-border: With "BOC Remittance Plus," cross-border remittances are free and fast. "BOC Cross-boundary Wealth Management Connect" meets your cross-border wealth management needs.
．Online customer service: 7x24 online customer service to answer your personal banking inquiries.
【Go Green with Green Financial Services】
．BeLeaf: Provide you with green financial tips monthly, adding more fun and green inspiration to your life.
．e-Statements: e-Statements/e-Advice will be retained between 12 months and up to 7 years, with no need to store or organize a large number of paper documents.
．Mobile Token: Use mobile token and biometric authentication instead of physical “securities device” for authentication, making it environmentally friendly and secure.
【Contact Us】
Website：www.bochk.com
Instagram Official Account：bankofchinahongkong
Address：Bank of China Tower, 1 Garden Road, Hong Kong
Reminder: To borrow or not to borrow? Borrow only if you can repay!
Investment/foreign exchange involves risk.
The above products and services are subject to the relevant terms. For details, please contact the staff of Bank of China (Hong Kong) Limited (“the Bank”).
BOCHK is the appointed insurance agency of BOC Life for distribution of life insurance products. The life insurance product is a product of BOC Life but not BOCHK.
In respect of an eligible dispute (as defined in the Terms of Reference for the Financial Dispute Resolution Centre in relation to the Financial Dispute Resolution Scheme) arising between BOCHK and the customer out of the selling process or processing of the related transaction, BOCHK is required to enter into a Financial Dispute Resolution Scheme process with the customer; however any dispute over the contractual terms of the insurance product should be resolved between directly the insurance company and the customer.
For interest, fees and charges, please refer to Key Facts Statement and Conditions for Services available at our website and our app for details of “BOC Express Cash”.
The App, any related materials and other products and services provided through the App are not intended for download, use or access by any person in any jurisdiction where such download or use would be contrary to any applicable law or regulation of that jurisdiction or where we're not licensed or authorized to provide the App or any related materials, or in any jurisdiction that is subject to any sanction regime.

Send secure messages to the bank
Set up alerts, so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount

Transfer money between your Community National Bank accounts

Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
Submit a change of address request
Add a travel notice for your debit card
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode or biometric on supported devices.
