. Notification summaries, powered by Apple Intelligence combine related accessory notifications into a single, easy-to-read update.
. Siri makes it easy to use your voice to control accessories. Say “Lock the front door,” or create a scene and say “Good night” to turn off all your lights.
. Control Center gives you quick access to control your favorite accessories and scenes, with a dedicated and customizable section for additional accessories and scenes.
. Home app on Apple Watch surfaces the accessories you’re most likely to need at the top for immediate access, followed by all accessories in favorites, cameras, and rooms.
Cameras
. Video descriptions enabled by Apple Intelligence let you quickly understand what happened in your HomeKit Secure Video camera recordings.
. Camera clip search uses Apple Intelligence so you can find specific moments across your HomeKit Secure Video recordings.
. 4K recording captures every detail from compatible HomeKit Secure Video cameras.
. HomeKit Secure Video also provides live video, recordings, and a 10-day history from your security cameras and video doorbells, with rich notifications when people, pets, vehicles, or package deliveries are detected.
. Multi-camera layout in the Home tab shows up to four cameras at once — scroll to see additional cameras, or tap into any camera for a detailed full-screen view.
Climate & Comfort
. Adaptive Temperature sets your thermostat to adjust when you’re on your way home, when you go to sleep, or when you’re away for an extended period of time.
. Adaptive Lighting lets you set compatible lightbulbs to automatically adjust their color temperature throughout the day — warm colors in the morning, cooler tones midday, and blue light removed at night.
Access & Security
. Guest access provides date- and time-based access to locks, garage doors, and alarm systems for visitors.
. Activity History displays recent history for climate automations, garage doors, door locks, security systems, and contact sensor events.
Speakers & Home Hubs
. AirPlay-enabled speakers can be added to play music throughout your home.
. HomePod and Apple TV act as a home hub — letting you control accessories remotely, run automations, receive accessory notifications, and share your home with others.
Energy
. Energy support lets you see how much energy compatible accessories are consuming, helping you make smarter decisions about your home.
. Grid Forecast uses data from your local electric grid to show when it will be running on cleaner sources, so you can plan when to charge devices or run appliances. (Contiguous US only)
. Electricity usage and rate plan information are displayed for eligible customers when connecting their utility account to the Home app. (US only)

Apple Intelligence features require an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad and a home hub such as HomePod or Apple TV 4K running the latest operating system software. Location services need to be enabled for Home app and Home Accessories.

bluejetty:00069572:ios.description:
Experience personalized coaching designed with your goals in mind at your fingertips. The AF App offers so much more than just workouts: 
• Monitor your progress as you work towards your goals 
• Connect with Anytime Fitness Coaches virtually and get the support you need when you need it 
• Connect with the Anytime Fitness community and get the answers to your questions from expert coaches and members 
• Find practical advice and tips on everything from fitness, recovery and nutrition—and everything in between. 
It all starts with a plan. Answer a few questions about your goals and what’s important to you and we’ll take it from there. You’ll receive a plan including workouts, tips for making progress in your journey and weekly challenges that will move you towards your goal. 
Access workouts around the clock—anytime, anywhere. Our digital workouts can be done anywhere you are, helping your goals stay within reach and keep you on track wherever life takes you. You can modify your workouts by duration, location, and intensity plus you’re able to connect with a coach via video chat or messaging making your fitness journey a group effort between you and our team. 
Stay connected on your health journey. With the AF App you can also connect with other Anytime Fitness members and join in on the conversations that matter most to you! Interested in learning about sleep health? Want more info on active recovery? Or maybe you are looking for advice on how to get over a performance plateau—it’s all happening on the AF App. Get answers from expert coaches and members alike and prepare to be inspired by the magic that our community brings. 
Share your fitness stats your coaches. Connect the AF App with the Apple Health App to share your fitness stats with your coach. Now you can automatically keep your coach up-to-date on your daily activity levels, sleep, resting heart rate and more.

bluejetty:00135011:ios.description:
evo is the world’s premier performance car magazine. 
Every issue is packed with entertaining, informative writing and stunning photography that puts you firmly behind the wheel of the fastest and most desirable cars around. With exclusive road tests, a focus on cult and iconic cars, track tests of the world's fastest cars and added buying features, no other magazine comes close to what evo delivers every month.
Inside you will find…
·The latest motoring news, to keep you ahead of the game.
·Reviews of every important new model, from hot hatches to supercars.
·Iconic drivers' cars revisited and re-appraised.
·In-depth group tests that reveal the best cars in each class.
·Drive stories so absorbing you’ll want to emulate them yourself.
·Action-packed videos showing amazing cars driven on the limit.
The evo application is edition based and published every month to bring you the newest updates on all your favourite automobiles.
Features
· Read reviews of the newest cars with a button directly on the homepage
· Search feature inside issues to find exactly what you want
· Easier to access your favourite saved articles with “my scrapbook”
· Streamline main page and table of contents for easy reading
· Share your favourite articles
· New settings page is more straightforward to change your preferences
· Archive button to remove a downloaded issue from the device
Digital and print + digital subscribers have full access to each month’s edition and all digital back issues. Print subscribers should contact the publisher to add digital access to their subscription.
You can purchase an auto-renewable subscription directly from iTunes. The subscription will include the current issue and all past content if you do not already own it as well as every new issue.
1 month subscription - £3.99
6 months subscription - £19.99
12 months subscription - £39.99
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. This subscription will
automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period, your 
account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. The cost of the 
renewal will match the initial subscription price. You can manage your subscriptions through your Account 
Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.

Privacy - https://www.carwowgroup.com/policies/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00116262:ios.description:
Who's the imposter among your friends?
Imposter is the ultimate party game of bluffing, guessing, and social deduction. Grab 3-5 friends, sit around one device, and find out who’s lying.
How to Play:
1- All players see the same secret word—except one.
2- The imposter only sees the word “Imposter.”
3- One by one, players say a word related to the secret word.
4- The imposter must fake it and try to blend in without knowing the word.
5- Keep giving words and talking until someone thinks they've figured it out.
Fun, fast, and full of suspicion—perfect for game nights, road trips, or hanging out with friends.
Features:
- Play locally with 3 to 15 friends
- 10+ categories like food, movies, jobs, and more
- 500+ unique words and growing
- No accounts, no setup—just start playing
- Great for all ages—kids, teens, and adults
Built for laughs, bluffing, and epic "aha!" moments
Download now and start your next Imposter showdown!

bluejetty:00018022:ios.description:
Your pay, on your schedule.
Instant gives employees at participating employers access to wages they've already earned before payday, plus fast access to tips. No loans, no interest, no waiting for your paycheck.
WHO CAN USE INSTANT
Instant is offered as a benefit through your employer. If your workplace has partnered with Instant, you'll be invited to enroll. Not sure? Ask your manager or HR team.
ACCESS YOUR EARNED WAGES
- Receive Instant Pay offers for wages you've already earned and accept the ones you want
- Get your tips on your Instant card within 24 hours of your shift
- Get a notification whenever money is added to your card
YOUR MONEY, YOUR WAY
- Shop in store and online anywhere Visa is accepted
- Withdraw cash at thousands of in-network ATMs with no Instant fee—find the nearest one in the app
- Transfer to your bank: standard transfers are free; real-time transfers are available for a small fee, shown before you confirm
- Set up one-time or recurring transfers
STAY IN CONTROL
- Check your balance and recent activity in real time
- Freeze and unfreeze your card instantly if it's lost or stolen
- Pair a replacement card and update your details in the app
- Available in English and Spanish
SUPPORT WHEN YOU NEED IT
- Chat with support in the app
- Email support@instant.co
- Call the number on the back of your card
GOOD TO KNOW
- Instant Pay offers are available for a limited window—accept them before they expire
- Some merchants (gas stations, hotels, restaurants, rental agencies) place temporary pre-authorization holds that can take several days to release
- Standard bank transfers typically arrive in 1–2 business days depending on when you submit them
- Your Instant card can only be loaded with wages, tips, and reimbursements from your employer
IMPORTANT INFORMATION
The Instant Financial App allows Instant Financial Prepaid Visa Cardholders and participants in the Instant Pay earned wage access service to manage their payroll card accounts and access earned wages ahead of pay day. There are fees for certain services, please see the Cardholder Agreement and fee schedule for additional information.
The Prepaid card (or the Instant Payroll Card) is issued by Sutton Bank, Member FDIC, pursuant to a license from Visa U.S.A Inc. Visa is a registered trademark of Visa, U.S.A. Inc. All other trademarks and services belong to their respective owners.
Cardholder Agreement and fee schedule: https://www.instant.co/us-cha/

Children and adults across the globe have been captivated by our games! You and your family can dive into this extraordinary adventure!

bluejetty:00163752:ios.name: Bruce Trail App
bluejetty:00163752:ios.summary:
Explore Canada's oldest and longest marked footpath with confidence using the official Bruce Trail App. 
=> Includes a free 7-day trial. Subscription required for continued access.
Navigate more than 1,300 km of trail along the Niagara Es
bluejetty:00163752:ios.description:
Explore Canada's oldest and longest marked footpath with confidence using the official Bruce Trail App. 
=> Includes a free 7-day trial. Subscription required for continued access.
Navigate more than 1,300 km of trail along the Niagara Escarpment with official maps, real-time GPS location, offline access, route planning tools, and automatic Trail updates direct from the Bruce Trail Conservancy (BTC).
Whether you're heading out for a short day hike, exploring a new section, or working toward an End-to-End journey, the Bruce Trail App helps you make the most of every adventure.
Always up to date: The route of the Bruce Trail changes regularly as land is protected, trail conditions change, or agreements with landowners evolve. With official Trail information delivered directly through the app, you'll always have access to the latest Trail changes and notices.
FEATURES
- OFFICIAL BRUCE TRAIL MAPS
Explore the entire Bruce Trail from Queenston to Tobermory, including the 900 km main Trail and more than 400 km of side trails. Access all 42 official Bruce Trail maps in one place.
- ALWAYS UP TO DATE
Get the latest Trail information directly from the Bruce Trail Conservancy. Route changes, temporary closures and Trail updates are automatically available in the app, helping you hike with confidence.
- OFFLINE MAPS & NAVIGATION
Download individual map sections or the entire Bruce Trail before you leave home. Access maps and Trail information even when cell service is unavailable.
- REAL-TIME GPS LOCATION
See your location on the Trail while you hike and follow your progress in real time.
- PLAN YOUR NEXT ADVENTURE
Measure distances, create custom routes, and explore options for loop hikes and longer journeys. Whether you're planning a quick outing or a multi-day trek, the app helps you prepare before you hit the Trail.
- RECORD YOUR HIKES
Follow your location in real time and save completed hikes for future reference.
- BUILD A PERSONAL HIKE LOG
Track your progress and maintain a record of your adventures on the Bruce Trail. Perfect for casual hikers and aspiring End-to-Enders alike.
- FIND PARKING & CAMPING
Quickly locate Trail access points, parking areas, and official camping locations. Get directions and access reservation information with a tap.
- CUSTOMIZE YOUR MAP EXPERIENCE
Choose from multiple map layers, including satellite imagery and Bruce Trail Conservancy topographic maps. Use filters to display only the information that matters most to you.
- DISCOVER PROTECTED NATURAL AREAS
Explore Bruce Trail Conservancy nature reserves along the Niagara Escarpment. Discover new protected natural areas as the Bruce Trail Conservancy's conservation corridor continues to grow.
- REPORT TRAIL ISSUES
Help Bruce Trail Conservancy volunteers keep the Trail safe and enjoyable by reporting maintenance issues directly through the app.
- SEARCH THE TRAIL
Find Bruce Trail sections, side trails, towns, campgrounds, and BTC nature reserves quickly and easily.
- TRAIL INFORMATION & SAFETY RESOURCES
Access Trail news, navigation guidance, safety information, and other helpful resources while planning your next outing.
More features are added regularly as we continue to improve the Bruce Trail App.
YOUR SUBSCRIPTION SUPPORTS THE TRAIL
Subscription revenue helps maintain and improve the Bruce Trail App, care for the Bruce Trail, and support land conservation through the Bruce Trail Conservancy.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Start with a FREE 7-day trial.
For continued access, choose from: 
• Monthly Subscription: $2.99/month 
• Annual Subscription: $29.99/year
To start your free trial, Apple requires subscription setup when you first open the app. No payment will be charged until the free trial ends, and you can cancel anytime before then.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled before the renewal date. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time through your App Store account settings.

A New Bag Of Tricks

Feel The Vibe

•How to play?
You start with one single piece. Acro
bluejetty:00129551:ios.description:
Wait, if this game is NOT chess, then what is it? It's a mind blowing puzzle game with some simple chess rules and a few special ingredients to make it fun and challenging for everyone! 
•How to play?
You start with one single piece. Across the board, there are a few chess pieces strategically placed. When you take a chess piece, you become that piece and inherit its abilities. The level is complete when you collect the coin.
•Who is this for?
It doesn’t matter if you have no idea how to play chess or if you are a chess grandmaster. This game is for everyone. The tutorial covers all the required information in a fun, interactive way.
•Challenging?
While this game is not chess, some levels will have a higher difficulty, requiring careful planning and strategy, making this a great way to put your brain muscle to work.
•Features:
- 3 Difficulty levels: easy, medium and hard; with limited moves and limited time to complete the levels.
- Zen color palettes and relaxing soundtrack
- Game Center.
- No ads, no in-app purchases; buy it once and enjoy it forever.
- Haptic Feedback.
- Optimized for all devices;
- Simple controls, suitable for any age.
- Play Offline, no internet connection required to play
- No violence, stress-free; play at your own pace.
•Developer notes:
Thank you for playing “not chess”. I put a lot of love and effort into making this game. Don’t forget to review the game and share it with your friends. Use #notchess on social media!

bluejetty:00083033:ios.description:
Measure the height of trees, buildings, and other tall objects quickly and easily with Height Measuring App!
Whether you're measuring a tree, checking a building's height, or estimating the size of an object, our app makes height measurement simple, fast, and convenient.
NEW! AR Height Measurement – Easier Than Ever!
Discover our new Augmented Reality (AR) measurement mode! Measure the height of objects in just 3 simple steps using your iPhone's camera.
With intuitive controls, smooth navigation, and an easy-to-use interface, measuring heights has never been more convenient.
Why You'll Love AR Measurement:
• 3 Simple Steps – Measure object heights quickly and effortlessly.
• Augmented Reality – Use your camera to measure objects in the real world.
• Intuitive Controls – Enjoy a simple interface designed for effortless measurements.
• Easy Navigation – Follow a straightforward measurement process from start to finish.
• Versatile Measurements – Perfect for trees, buildings, walls, and other objects.
Classic Height Measurement Mode
Our original measurement mode is still available! Measure large objects like buildings, trees, and more in just 3 steps:
1. Detect the ground.
2. Mark the lowest point of the object.
3. Mark the highest point of the object.
That's it! Get your measurement results instantly and use them wherever you need.
Save Your Measurements
Keep track of your measurements with the built-in history feature. Easily access your previous results whenever you need them.
Measure Smarter, Faster, and Easier!
From outdoor projects to everyday measurements, Height Measuring App puts powerful height measurement tools right in your pocket.
Download now and experience a simpler way to measure heights with Augmented Reality!

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/iriskinx/privacy-policy

Investigate crimes, solve tricky escape room puzzles & crack bewildering cases!
Join Fiona, a brilliant journalist, and a detective agent on a special mission! Assist her in solving all the puzzles in order to escape the room she is trapped in. Dive into an immersive life-like escape room experience on your mobile!

Find your way out of the locked rooms, look for hidden items and examine them, solve creative puzzles and break codes to find a way to escape. SIMPLE AND INTUITIVE GAMEPLAY
Begin with easy warm-up levels to prepare for more challenging puzzles.
DETAILED AND COLORFUL GRAPHICS
Amazing graphics and animations will enhance your gaming experience.
UNIQUE ESCAPE ROOM LEVELS
Each level has a unique and original design that you will absolutely love. 
CREATIVE PUZZLES AND BRAIN TEASERS
A perfect mix of engaging puzzles and unpredictable challenges.
REGULAR UPDATES
New escape room levels are added regularly.
MULTIPLE LANGUAGE SUPPORT
The game is available in English, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, French, German, Turkish, and Japanese.
Download Rooms & Exits: Escape Games and get ready to engage your whole brain in the most creative way. Have fun with this amazing mix of clever puzzles that will leave you thinking and gorgeous graphics that you will enjoy.

bluejetty:00039994:ios.name: SP: Utilities & EV Charging
bluejetty:00039994:ios.summary: SP App is Singapore’s all-in-one app for bills, EV charging and rewards. Instantly pay your electricity, water and gas bills, track usage, and manage your carbon footprint. Take on GreenUP challenges to build sustainable habits and earn exc
bluejetty:00039994:ios.description:
SP App is Singapore’s all-in-one app for bills, EV charging and rewards. Instantly pay your electricity, water and gas bills, track usage, and manage your carbon footprint. Take on GreenUP challenges to build sustainable habits and earn exclusive rewards. EV drivers can tap into Singapore’s largest EV charging network and offset costs with ChargeUP rewards.
Zap Your Utilities Bills
Say goodbye to boring paperwork. Pay electricity, water and gas bills in a tap, track your usage like a detective, and spot saving patterns with hourly, monthly and yearly views. Submit meter readings or check application status — zero hassle, maximum convenience.
Charge Up & Earn Rewards
Drive an EV? Plug into Singapore’s largest EV charging network. Retail, malls, offices, homes - islandwide. Smooth payments, fast charging, and here’s the kicker: earn ChargeUP points every time you charge. More charging = more points = lower future bills. FTW! Yes, it’s that simple.
GreenUP: Play the Sustainability Game
Flex your eco-ninja moves! Take on challenges, collect rewards and redeem them. Level up while learning money-saving planet-friendly habits and redeem more rewards! Curious about your carbon footprint? Our calculator reveals all, then shows you how to shrink it. Track your progress towards Singapore’s Green Plan 2030 with Green Goals, or be a solar hero by supporting local projects with My Green Credits.
Always Here for You
Open your SP account? Sorted. Need help? Chat with us in-app. Not even a SP utilities customer? No worries - anyone in Singapore can join the fun, go green, and start earning rewards.
Why Everyone’s Downloading
Because life’s easier when your utilities, EV charging and green rewards live in one app. From your first bill to your next EV adventure, SP App keeps it smooth, simple, and surprisingly fun.
Download SP App today — power up your bills, your EV, and your rewards.
Utilities, sustainable, green, electricity, EV, fast charging, rewards, carbon
The SP App does not provide financial products such as loans or credit facilities.
Payment features in the app are limited to paying for SP services.
Any financial product advertisements or links displayed in the app are provided by third‑party partners, and applications are processed on their official websites under their own terms.

COMPREHENSIVE FEATURES FOR UNMATCHED QUALITY:
Experience the full potential of your media with Radiant Photo, where technology meets creativity to transform your photos and videos. With its user-friendly interface and powerful features, Radiant Photo is ideal for professional photographers and hobbyists. Download now and start creating stunning, radiant visuals that capture the essence of your moments. Join the community of creators who trust Radiant Photo to bring their visions to life.
- Intelligent Exposure Control: Automatically adjust exposure to achieve perfect brightness and contrast in every scene.
Advanced Depth Enhancement: Enhance the depth of field to give your visuals a professional-grade dimensional feel and make them pop off the screen.
- Precision Detail Recovery: Uncover hidden details with AI that knows precisely how much to enhance texture and color without creating an overly processed look.
- Sophisticated Portrait Retouching: From skin smoothing to eye enhancing, our tools make it easy to retouch portraits like a pro with minimal effort.
- Efficient Batch Processing: Apply edits to hundreds of photos and videos simultaneously, saving valuable time without sacrificing quality.
- Dynamic Color Adjustment: Fine-tune colors with advanced color correction tools for vibrant visuals that stand out.
- Creative Filters and Effects: Experiment with various filters and effects to add artistic flair to your photos and videos.
- Real-time Color Grading for Video: Preview and apply built-in film and color grades to videos using our built-in LOOKs
- Advanced RAW Photo Editing: Unlock the full potential of your photos with Radiant Photo's advanced RAW editing capabilities. Effortlessly open and edit native RAW files directly from any professional DSLR, mirrorless camera, or device. Experience the AI-enhanced power of Radiant Photo, optimized for all devices, not just iPhones.
- Offline Editing—No Cloud Required: Edit anywhere without WiFi or cloud dependencies. Radiant Photo operates locally on your mobile device, conserving your data and ensuring your edits remain private and instantaneous.

- Seamless Integration: Sync your projects across all devices with cloud integration, allowing for a flexible editing process whether you're at home or on the go.

bluejetty:00040987:ios.name: Le VPN: Fast & Secure
bluejetty:00040987:ios.summary: Le VPN for iPhone and iPad protects you on any WiFi network and keeps what you do online private. Pick one of our VPN servers in 100+ locations, tap Connect, and you browse with that server's IP address over an encrypted connection. Enjoy t
bluejetty:00040987:ios.description:
Le VPN for iPhone and iPad protects you on any WiFi network and keeps what you do online private. Pick one of our VPN servers in 100+ locations, tap Connect, and you browse with that server's IP address over an encrypted connection. Enjoy the Internet by Your Own Rules!
Change your IP address to 100+ locations
Le VPN gives your device the IP address of any of our VPN servers, in 100+ locations. Websites and apps then see the server's location instead of yours. The servers are fast, and encryption protects the connection on every WiFi network.
One tap to connect
Choose a country and tap "Connect". From that moment the app encrypts everything your iPhone or iPad sends and receives. Your favorite servers stay at the top of the list, and you can switch to another server without disconnecting first.
Stealth mode for restricted networks
Some networks block or slow down VPN connections. Stealth mode disguises your VPN traffic so that it gets through. It has three levels, and you choose one in the VPN settings of the app.
Block ads while you browse
The Ad Blocker removes ads from websites and apps before they load: while the VPN is on, Le VPN's own DNS servers drop the requests that ads come from. Nothing to install, nothing to configure, one switch in the menu.
More than a VPN connection
• Threat Protection blocks malware and phishing websites.
• Automatic VPN reconnection brings the VPN back when your network changes.
• "Test your IP" shows your current IP address, its location and whether you are protected.
• A live traffic graph shows what you download and upload while connected.
• The globe on the main screen shows the location of your server.
• Data Breach Scanner checks known data leaks for your email address and tells you what to do if it turns up.
• Le VPN widgets connect and disconnect from your Home Screen, your Lock Screen and Control Center.
• Bypass VPN for local networks keeps printers and other home devices reachable.
• The app has light and dark themes, comes in 15 languages and fits both iPhone and iPad.
One subscription for all your devices
Le VPN is a paid service, and you need a subscription to use this app. New accounts start with a 7-day free trial. A plan you buy in this app also covers your other devices: desktops, laptops, other phones and tablets, routers, game consoles and smart TVs. On iOS the app connects through WireGuard, IKEv2 or IPSec. OpenVPN is available on other devices.
What every Le VPN plan includes
• Use on an unlimited number of devices.
• 10 VPN connections at the same time.
• Unlimited traffic and bandwidth at high speeds.
• No logs of your online activity.
• Support 24/7, in several languages.
Why choose Le VPN?
• Le VPN has been a VPN provider since 2010 and has protected millions of users around the world.
• We keep no traffic logs, and an email address is the only personal detail we ask for.
• WireGuard, IKEv2 and IPSec encrypt everything between your device and the VPN server.
• On public WiFi in a hotel or an airport, other people on the network cannot read your traffic.
• Websites see the IP address of the VPN server, so your own stays hidden.
Privacy Policy and Terms of use:
https://www.le-vpn.com/vpn-terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00041017:ios.name: Physiotutors
bluejetty:00041017:ios.summary:
Physiotutors is a learning app for physiotherapists who want clear, practical, evidence-based education in one place.
Whether you are a student or an experienced clinician, the app helps you stay up to date, improve clinical reasoning, and
bluejetty:00041017:ios.description:
Physiotutors is a learning app for physiotherapists who want clear, practical, evidence-based education in one place.
Whether you are a student or an experienced clinician, the app helps you stay up to date, improve clinical reasoning, and document your professional development.
WHAT YOU GET
Personal learning feed
Your personal feed shows content that fits your interests, including research reviews, blogs, expert-led masterclasses, podcasts, and more. New content is added every week.
Research made practical
Read short, clear research reviews written for clinical use. The focus is on what the evidence means for daily practice.
Expert-led masterclasses and podcasts
Learn from experienced clinicians through short masterclasses and podcasts that focus on real clinical questions.
Quizzes and knowledge checks
Research reviews, podcasts, and masterclasses include short quizzes to test your knowledge. Completed activities are logged automatically in your portfolio and can be used for CPD documentation.
Portfolio and certificates
Track your learning activities across the app in one clear portfolio. Use it to document CPD or CEU activities and generate certificates for completed content, depending on your country.
Clinical tools
Use the clinical assistant, assessment tests, manual therapy techniques, and clinical patterns to support clinical reasoning and treatment planning.
Personal library
Save content to your own library and organize it with custom bookmark folders. Highlight important text and return to key insights anytime.
Listen instead of read
Use the text-to-speech feature to listen to written content while commuting, training, or between patients.
Live learning and community
Join live sessions like the expert Q&A, and discussions with physiotherapists from around the world.
Online courses
Physiotutors also offers in-depth online courses as separate products on our learning platform. Purchased courses can be accessed easily from within the app.
Built for real clinical work:
Physiotutors is created by physiotherapists and educators with years of clinical and teaching experience. Everything in the app is focused on clarity, relevance, and direct use in practice.
The app is updated continuously based on user feedback and new evidence.
Terms:
https://app.physiotutors.com/terms-and-conditions-of-physiotutors

bluejetty:00019230:ios.description:
~~~ Monster Hunter World Companion App ~~~
Iceborne Ready * Latest Events * Build Searcher * Wikipedia * Stunning UI
- GET THE LATEST ONLINE REWARDS, EVENT QUESTS, AND BOUNTIES INFORMATION!
 Don't miss any login rewards and time-limited events! 
 All the info you need will deliver to you!
 You can check game-related news & articles, schedule for event quests, weekly or daily bounties and other useful information (Some features are premium members only)
- DATABASE FOR PS4 & XBOXONE & PC
 Databases are free to update! All databases can be used offline!
 You can switch the database to the platform you are playing with. 
 The database is organized manually to be synchronized with the game.
 The database will be updated soon after the game is updated. The data will deliver within the app, you won't need to update the client, just drag and refresh to get updated!
- COMPLETE GAME WIKIPEDIA, WITH A POWERFUL SEARCH ENGINE
 Setting filters to find anything from the game. The filters can be anything you want, elements, slots, weapon augments, skills.. or just use keywords!
 Star an item for your targets. Need a weapon? Complete a quest? Mark them as your favorites, so that you can visit later!
 New in-game map added! Can you imagine using it like google map? It is even more powerful than the one in the game! 
- MAKE A BUILD BY SEARCHING SKILLS!
 Use the powerful build searcher to find builds! ICEBORNE support!
 You can save the builds for later use.
 Saved builds can be sorted by defense, name or modified time.
 You can tag the builds for better grouping/filtering.
- ONLINE STORAGE
 My builds, My jewel sets, and My favorites...
 Newly introduced "Online Member" allows you to store your data on the cloud!
 You can visit your data anytime on any of your devices.
 No need to worry about your data - after you delete the app or even worse, lost your phone. We kept them safe!
 Choose different plans for your needs.
- MULTI LANGUAGES SUPPORT
 We provide online Google Sheets for different languages. If you don't find your language supported in the app, just help to make one! I'll make sure they will be added in the later versions.
- CUTTING-EDGE TECHNOLOGY!
 The app is completely made using the cutting-edge Flutter engine from Google. Try the FUTURE out! 
Everything you want from Monster Hunter World, all in this app!
Privacy policy:
Https://ooizumi.github.io/mhwotomo/privacy_policy.html
Terms and conditions:
Https://ooizumi.github.io/mhwotomo/terms_and_conditions.html
Follow me on twitter!
https://twitter.com/mhwo_official
Brave hunter! Take me along! 
I will be your best partner to help you explore the new world!

bluejetty:00182565:ios.description:
From the Creators of Stronghold
Grand Strategy MMO
Free to Play
5 Million Players
Become Lord of the Middle Ages in Firefly Studios’ Stronghold Kingdoms! Expand your medieval empire and construct mighty castles to protect it. Farm peacefully, engage in political mind games, seek vengeance on sworn enemies and lead your faction to glory across a medieval kingdom. Besiege other players, battle AI opponents, research new weaponry, forge alliances and fight for the eternal glory of your House.
..::: FEATURES :::..
*** BUILD an online stronghold and protect it with impenetrable castle defences.
*** RULE the Middle Ages and wage war across England, Europe and the entire world!
*** BESIEGE enemies, trade with factions and explore a medieval world filled with thousands of other players.
*** RESEARCH new technology and become a trader, farmer, crusader, diplomat or warlord.
*** LEAD your faction to victory and forge alliances, becoming the elected leader in a player-controlled political RTS.
*** PLAY FOR FREE on iPhone and iPad, with frequent updates and cross-platform multiplayer.
..::: PRESS :::..
“More challenging than Supercell’s megahit” – Touch Arcade
“A world map that’s constantly shifting and adapting” – Pocket Gamer
“Stronghold Kingdoms does boast some interesting features” – 148 Apps
..::: USER REVIEWS :::..
"Brilliant MMO, I love the castle building and faction warfare" - 5/5
"One of the best online games I've played" - 5/5
“It's like the child of Stronghold Crusader and Clash of Clans” - 5/5
Stronghold Kingdoms is the MMO successor to the Stronghold castle building series, most famous for the original Stronghold (2001) and Stronghold: Crusader (2002). Unlike the original and Crusader, Kingdoms allows players to relive the Middle Ages in the world’s first castle MMO. A cross-platform strategy game, Kingdoms invites mobile and desktop players to battle together online by thrusting the Middle Ages and famous Stronghold characters into a persistent MMO world. Besiege the castle that’s never been taken, overthrow ruthless tyrants, bankroll your faction’s war effort, pillage your neighbour’s resources, peacefully raise cattle or do it all!
Only by engaging enemy troops, taking back villages from The Wolf and winning votes in the political arena can players hope to succeed. Stronghold Kingdoms is set in a fast-paced, challenging game world designed for large numbers of players working together in pursuit of a common goal.
..::: COMMUNITY :::..
Facebook – http://www.facebook.com/StrongholdKingdoms 
Twitter – http://www.twitter.com/PlayStronghold 
YouTube – http://www.youtube.com/fireflyworlds 
Support – http://support.strongholdkingdoms.com 
..::: MESSAGE FROM FIREFLY :::..
We designed Stronghold Kingdoms to be the first fully fledged PvP (player versus player) strategy MMO RTS for mobile devices. As a developer we’re best known for the core Stronghold series, which sees you besiege friends and war against AI opponents like The Wolf. With Kingdoms we’re taking Stronghold online, giving players an immersive medieval game world populated by real players, war and political strife. Firefly is a small independent developer with a lot of respect for our players, so we’d love to hear your thoughts on Kingdoms! Please try the game out for yourself (it’s free to play) and send us a message using one of the community links above.
Thanks for playing from everyone at Firefly Studios!
..::: DEVICES :::..
- iPad Air 2, iPad Mini 2 and above
- iPhone 5S and above
- Runs on iOS 9 or later
Please Note: Stronghold Kingdoms is a free to play MMO RTS, however players are able to purchase game items using real money via in-app purchases. If you don’t wish to use this feature you can disable in-app purchases on your iOS device, making the game completely free to play. Stronghold Kingdoms also requires a network connection to play.
Like the game? Please support us with a 5-star rating!

bluejetty:00120064:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00120064:ios.description:
You found it! Drum Beats+ is the metronome app that improves your timing using great sounding drum beats, not a boring click. 
But that’s not all. It can also help you write songs, jam with friends, or even perform live. It's a learning, jamming and performing tool that keeps getting better, just like you. 
"No more annoying metronome ticks or digital click tempos!" ~ AnthonyVilla
"Awesome sounding and authentically grooving drum loops…but also a great practice tool for timing." ~ Ets5017
"Sorry drummers...but I use this on live gigs." ~ RBJ555
"A proper replacement for your deadbeat drummer." ~ Rolling Stone Magazine
- - -
FEATURES
Cheaper than a metronome, simpler than a drum machine.
• SUPER SIMPLE DESIGN - spend more time playing, less time learning the app
• NO WORK REQUIRED - Standard Library comes with 100+ PRE-MADE great sounding beats in a variety of genres (Add 250+ with the Pro Library) 
• VERSATILE 45 to 200 Tempo Range -- play all the songs you want
• ADJUSTABLE - Play any beat at any speed WITHOUT CHANGING THE PITCH
• FAVORITE beats have their own tab. Play and practice faster.
• LOCK THE TEMPO to save time during practice (tap the padlock button on tempo screen)
• PERSONALIZE - Tap edit to RENAME the beats (e.g. "My Hit Song") 
- - - 
As you advance as a player, you’ll grow into the app’s advanced features. 
• Improve your timing with Bar Break beats that rest for entire bars or more 
• Refine your ear with beats that alternate between swing and straight feels, loud and soft volumes and beats per bar 
• Connect to GarageBand and other music apps using Inter-app Audio 
• Jam loud by using BlueTooth or AirPlay to play beats through your stereo or Apple TV 
• Hit the randomizer button to challenge yourself with beats you might not choose 
- - - 
So many drummers, so little time. Drum Beats+ includes four style packs and four training packs—100+ beats in all—with tons more in our Pro Library.
• Break Beats. 16 bumping beats of classic funk and soul breaks 
• Hit Songs I. 16 beats based on popular songs every musician should know 
• Pop Rock I. 24 beats spanning funk, straight ahead rock, shuffles and more 
• R&B Essentials I: 16 excellent modern and vintage-sound electronic beats 
• Rhythm, Timing, & Dynamics Packs. 41 practice beats that alternate grooves, volumes, beats per bar and rests 
• Every beat features different sounds—booming rock bass drums, snappy soul snares and more. All digitally mastered to make practicing a pleasure 
 - - - 
Enjoy this powerful, yet easy-to-use tool to get the best music experience!
No need to replace the app with a complicated drum machine, or even a drummer. Just add more beats with our Pro Library. Preview everything inside the app. 
Drum Beats+ Pro
Drum Beats+ Pro Subscription allows you unlock all sounds and features. Choose from different subscription options. Our standard subscription options are:
- 1 year subscription with 7-day free trial
- 1 year subscription
- Lifetime subscription
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions may be managed by you and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to iTunes Account Settings. For more information please visit the link https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. Unused portion of a free-trial period will be forfeited when a user decides to subscribe.
Privacy Policy: https://ninebuzz.com/privacypolicy_en/
Terms of Service: https://ninebuzz.com/terms_en/

bluejetty:00186556:ios.description:
How often have you found yourself in the following situations?...
You did not know the correct Bracha to make in a particular situation...
You had a question that you didn't feel comfortable asking someone who knows you...
You consistently feel guilty "bothering" the Rabbi with your "simple questions" all the time...
Too often, many of us will convince ourselves that we think we know the correct thing to do and that we are probably right. 
InstaRabbi is taking your orthodox Jewish observance to the next level by making sure that you never again have to act as your own Rabbi when you don't know what to do, and that none of the questions that you have related to Judaism go unanswered. InstaRabbi allows Jews from across the world to ask Torah or halachic questions and get them answered quickly according to orthodox Jewish observance.
 Submit a question on the app and await the quick response from our qualified and dedicated staff of Rabbis who are committed to enhancing halachic observance throughout the world.

* Stream online courses in AI, cybersecurity, data science, and more.
* Download course materials and transcripts for uninterrupted access.
* Test your knowledge with quizzes, assignments, and exams.
* Discover and enroll in new courses and programs as your skills evolve.

bluejetty:00186279:ios.description:
It’s the grand opening of the Cartown Zoo, but all the baby animals are missing! Putt-Putt and Pep need to reunite the little ones with their parents before the zoo gates open. Along the way, they’ll swing across rivers, play hockey with a polar pear, build a bridge out of icebergs, dance with penguins and experience so much more on this adventure. 
Filled with captivating challenges and so many new friends to be made, this adventure is perfect for children of any age. 
—User Reviews—
"my daughter loves this game. teaches a lot of good things and also just fun to play. I would recommend this to any child.",
"My kids love this game. It is challenging and fun. It encourages creative problem solving and gives the child a wonderful sense of accomplishment when he or she achieves each goal of saving lost baby animals at the zoo. Don't miss this one!",
"This is a great easy game for young children I used to love playing this as a kid and am glad my children love playing it as well."
FEATURES: 
• Help Putt-Putt track down everything he needs so he can find the missing baby animals. 
• Simple touchscreen navigation makes it easy to guide Putt-Putt on his adventure.
• Fun music videos and mini-games keep things lively for you and your child.
• Touch everything! Nearly everything in the game can be interacted with through touch in the Putt-Putt world ranging from the dashboard to objects within the environment.

bluejetty:00015870:ios.description:
Word Clouds comes loaded with over 6,000 puzzles designed to teach you new words while you play. Our puzzles will put your vocabulary and problem-solving skills to the test. Are you up for the challenge?
New Features!
 • Bullseye! – A challenging variation to Word Clouds - the goal is to find words marked with a target. For each target you hit, you'll receive an extra 2 coins! Unlock bullseye at the beginning of Level 3!
 • Gold Rush! – Do you love collecting coins for a rainy day? Gold rush is designed to maximize your collection of coins! As you solve each puzzle, you will receive coins instantly by finding words with five (or more) letters. But search quickly! You will be racing the clock! Unlock Gold Rush by finishing two full Levels!
 • Offline Mode! – Do you play Word Clouds on multiple devices? Offline mode allows you to temporarily disable syncing your data between devices. This is great for times when your battery is low or when you're away from a device for a prolonged period. To resync your data, simply switch "Offline Mode" to off when connected to the internet!

bluejetty:00175098:ios.description:
Keto Diet App - your personal keto coach and powerful macro tracker. Hundreds of keto recipes, diet tips and guidance, all in the palm of your hand! Tracking food has never been so easy - simply type the name, or use the barcode scanner and voice recognition technology!
Get your custom weight loss plan today and reach your goals faster! 
KEY FEATURES:
• Automatic macro calculator: just add your parameters! Our fats, carbs and protein tracker will do the work for you!
• Carb manager + calorie counter: never exceed your daily limit again
• Personalised weight loss plan: lose weight at your own pace
• Food journal: track what you eat with our voice recognition technology & barcode scanner: no more manual search!
• Nutrition tracker: stay on top of all your vital nutrients to feel great and avoid keto flu
• Learn about all types of keto, carb cycling and much more. Our Insights section is filled with articles written by top health experts
• Keto recipes for everyone! Choose from our extensive library of recipes or create your own with our recipe keeper
• Grocery list: explore a full list of keto foods
• Live support from a team of professional keto coaches
• Apple Health integration: water tracker, step counter, sleep monitor and weight loss tracker
• Weight loss tracker: keep yourself accountable and make progress photos as you advance
• Easy to use interface, designed for both beginners and advanced keto dieters
VOICE YOUR DIET
Tracking food has never been so easy! Instead of searching for the required ingredient or meal manually - just use our voice recognition feature! The rest is on us.
CALCULATE YOUR MACROS
Keto is all about tracking your macros. Our app offers you a personalized macro calculator! We track your protein, fat, carbs and calories automatically. All you have to do is enter your data, goal, and tell us the foods you ate during the day. 
Additionally, you can:
• keep an eye on your macros + calorie intake,
• review your food log,
• check your nutrient levels.
HEALTH APP INTEGRATION
Keto Diet App integrates the following data from the Health app (HealthKit) to provide personalized content, including step counter, water tracker, sleep and weight loss tracker.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Keto Diet App is free to download. The upgrade to Premium gives you access to voice input, free typing input, barcode scanning feature, live support, full recipe and insights library. Should you choose to upgrade to a Premium Membership, payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable. Cancellation of the current active subscription period is not allowed. Auto-renewal may be turned off in your Account Settings in iTunes after purchase. You can also manage your subscriptions in Account Settings after purchase.
Note: This app is developed for informational purposes only. You must always consult your physician or doctor before starting any diet program.
For more information please visit the link https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
Privacy Policy: http://myketo.care/pp
Terms of Use: http://myketo.care/tc
CONTACTS
Please, contact us should you have any questions, concerns or proposals - we are open to a discussion. We would highly appreciate if you share your app experience with friends and diet buddies! Thank you very much in advance.
support@myketo.care

bluejetty:00187721:ios.summary:

This entertaining and educational app was designed by teachers with over 15 years childcare experience, using their phi
bluejetty:00187721:ios.description:
*Full Version- no additional purchases required*
Come to the construction site and dig in to construction trucks fun! 
This entertaining and educational app was designed by teachers with over 15 years childcare experience, using their philosophy of learning through play. Every activity on this big trucks app will engage your little one and educate them about construction trucks, the sound the construction vehicles make, and facts about the big trucks. Along with learning about trucks they’ll also be playing with numbers, practicing counting, and counting in integers. And you can’t forget what else is important on a construction site… tools! With over 25 tool flashcards your little one will not only learn about tools, but hear the sound the tool makes as well. More super fun construction activities included in this app are the games. Your little one can play a spot the difference game and build houses, police stations, and even a dog house! And another delight-filled game includes helping the construction vehicles catch, but not just any construction trucks… what the trucks dream about being! So they will be helping a dinosaur Bulldozer collect dino eggs, and a Super Hero Crane collect lightening bolts. And then all these fun trucks are in the bedtime story that contains a heartfelt message about making your dreams come true! This app is fun and entertaining and will help your child explore creativity and their imagination. 
There’s so much to learn, explore, and play with in the Construction Big Trucks app!
Explore Big Truck Flashcards 
10 flashcards that start as an animated truck and then change into the real truck when they tap on it. This is designed to help your little ones recognize the difference between a book character and a real life big truck. They will hear the name of the truck in English and the sound the construction vehicle makes when it’s working and your little one will also get to reveal a fact about the big trucks. 
Over 25 Tool Names and Sounds
The big trucks on the construction site do the heavy jobs but there are also tools that help get the job done. Construction Trucks App delves into over 25 tools, saying the name of the tool in English and also playing the sound the tool makes. It’s interactive tool fun!
Spot the Difference and BUILD
This is a new kind of spot the difference… a building game! They will be spotting the differences and building a police station, a house, an apartment, a gingerbread house, and even a birdhouse and dog house! It’s a fun way to build their cognitive and sorting skills!
Help the Trucks CATCH
Your little ones will be helping the trucks catch the items falling down, but watch out for the wrong item or you’ll have to start over. And it’s not the regular trucks they will be helping… it’s what the trucks dream about being, as told in the storybook Construction Dreams. They will be playing with a Dinosaur Bulldozer, a Super Hero Crane, a Monster Truck Dump Truck, a Race Car Road Roller, a Digger that loves to bake, an Astronaut Tow Truck, and a Jackhammer Rapper! Imagination and creativity abound in this fun filled exciting game.
Count What You Collect
 Another exciting feature to the Catching Game is the reward! The game will keep count of what you catch and if you can avoid the obstacles and collect the right amount of tires, dinosaur eggs, cupcakes, or lightening bolts they win! And then a measuring tape will appear and they can count what they collected. Not just regular counting either, they will be counting in integers such as counting by 2’s, 5’s, and 10’s. It’s an interactive way to get them interested in counting and numbers!
Come to the construction site and have a blast playing the Construction Trucks app where education and fun go hand in hand to encourage your little ones to expand their knowledge while having a great time. If your little one digs big trucks this is the app for them!

A funny, easy and relaxing game for you, your baby or even your pet.

- The Cockroach: Have multiple live and they i'll try to trick you by fake death
- The Beetle: Have 2 life, pressing on it will make it crazy and go faster
- The Beetle King: Have 3 life, each time you pressing on it will make it crazy and go faster
All bugs:
- Ant
- Ladybug
- Fly
- Bee
- Cockroach
- Beetle
- Beetle King
- Bomb Bug (Don't touch it)
Items:
- Frozen: Using it will reduce the speed of insects for you to easily smash em
- Spray Bottle: Using this will spray a layer of liquid on the surface of the floor, any insects go though that will die. Using it when you think you can handle the large wave of insects
Features:

- Baby mode: This is design for baby, the bug will moving slowly and they also bigger than Infinity Mode. They'll also doesn't have skill, they'll died instantly with one press
- Pet mode: This is design for pet, the bug will moving slowly than Infinity Mode. They'll also doesn't have skill, they'll died instantly with one press

bluejetty:00174594:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00174594:ios.description:
Eliminate 99% of spam text messages with Textkiller, and live spam-text free®!
Textkiller is the new spam text blocking app that's creating a world without spam texts. With Textkiller, you're instantly protected from more than 100,000,000 known phone scams, and counting! Textkiller's intuitive and easy-to-use features ensure you get all the texts you want, and none that you don't.
Textkiller's innovative text blocking technology has already been featured by The New York Times, NBC, Wired, Engadget, Vice, and many other publications. Here are some of Textkiller's highly-reviewed features:
Eliminate 99% of spam texts automatically
With Textkiller, you're instantly protected from more than 100,000,000 known phone scams - and our global block list is updated every minute. Textkiller's predictive SMS blocking algorithm is also able to determine if an incoming text is spam in less than 0.01 second, keeping you safe from emerging spam texts too!
Control who can text you
Get good texts only. Textkiller's Block and Allow lists ensure the text messages you want are never blocked, removing all distractions from unwanted and dangerous spam text messages.
Customize your text blocking
Only Textkiller gives you fully customizable text blocking to ensure you block spam texts on your terms. Other apps only let you block individual phone numbers or text messages, but with Textkiller's keyword-based filtering, email address blocking, and phone number range blocking options, you can fully control how we block your spam texts.
Train Textkiller To Get Smarter
Report spam texts to Textkiller to help our algorithm get more precise at blocking your spam texts, and ensuring you always get the texts you want. Reporting spam texts also helps to protect other Textkiller users from receiving the same scam! Turn on the Extreme Blocking function, and Textkiller will filter all messages coming from senders outside of your contact list.
Keep your money safe from losses to fraud
Textkiller prevented 800 USD per year in losses to text scams, according to data reported by the Federal Trade Commission. 
Privacy-first text blocking
Textkiller's patented text blocking algorithm immediately removes any identifying information before making a decision on blocking a text. Your privacy, and personal text messages are always safe with us.
Relax and live life spam-text-free®
In our busy lives, spam texts are an unnecessary and annoying distraction. Textkiller cleans up your iMessage inbox from annoying spam or telemarketing texts so you can have a bit of peace back in your day. That's what it means to live life spam-text-free.
Here's what your spam-text-free life looks like:
- No distractions: You can trust when a text notification goes off, it's a message that's meant for you.
- Total control: Has your number fallen into the hands of annoying telemarketers or marketing lists? With Textkiller, you decide who can or can't text you - without having to deal with the hassle of trying to unsubscribe.
- Zen: While Textkiller can't eliminate all of your daily distractions, we do our best to give you one slice of distraction-free paradise by ridding your phone of annoying spam.
Built by people who hate robocalls, spam texts, and respect your privacy, Textkiller will help you take control of who can and can’t text you. We're empowering everyone with a smartphone to create a spam-text-free world. But, we can't do it without you. Try Textkiller free today!
Textkiller is free to download. A subscription is required to use the product. Once your trial ends, your subscription will automatically renew. You can cancel at any time.
Live life spam-text-free®!
Terms of Service: https://www.teltech.co/terms.html 
Privacy Policy: https://www.teltech.co/privacy.html
California Privacy Notice: https://teltech.co/privacy.html#section-8
*** According to the FTC.

Get the app designed specifically for classical music. Available to Apple Music subscribers at no additional cost. Instantly find any recording in the world’s largest classical music catalog with search built for the genre. Enjoy the highest audio quality available (up to 24-bit/192 kHz Hi-Res Lossless) and hear classical favorites like never before in Spatial Audio—all with zero ads.
Apple Music Classical also makes it easy for beginners to get to know the classical genre thanks to time-synced listening guides for many popular works, hundreds of Essentials playlists, insightful composer biographies, and personalized recommendations based on recently-played composers, instruments, and periods.
The Ultimate Classical Experience
• Get unlimited access to the world’s largest classical music catalog (over 5 million tracks) with everything from new releases to celebrated masterpieces, plus thousands of exclusive albums.
• Search by composer, work, conductor, or even catalog number, and find specific recordings instantly.
• Listen in the highest audio quality (up to 24 bit/192 kHz Hi-Res Lossless) and enjoy thousands of recordings in immersive Spatial Audio with Dolby Atmos.
• Appreciate famous works more deeply with listening guides—moment-by-moment expert notes from the Apple Music Classical editors.
• Know exactly who and what you’re listening to thanks to complete, accurate metadata.
• Enjoy nonstop music with brand new stations curated by our editors and themed by instrument, composer, period, or genre.
• Learn about each classical period with The Story of Classical audio guides.
• Discover new favorites on the Home tab with personalized recommendations based on your listening.
• Dig deeper as you listen, with insightful album notes, descriptions of key works, and thousands of composer biographies.
• Browse booklets for thousands of albums including in-depth liner notes, translations, and more.
• Listen with CarPlay for music on the move.
• Ask Siri to play a composer, work or instrument.
• Listen using AirPlay on compatible wireless devices.
Requirements
• Requires an Apple Music subscription (Individual, Student, Family, or Apple One).
• Availability and features vary by country and region, plan, or device. The list of countries where Apple Music Classical is available can be found at https://support.apple.com/HT204411.
• Apple Music Classical is available for all iPhones and iPads running iOS or iPadOS 18.0 or later.
• To listen to music on Apple Music Classical, you must have an internet connection.

With its intuitive interface and robust set of features, Word Editor allows you to seamlessly create, edit, and collaborate on Word documents anytime, anywhere. Whether you're a student, professional, or simply need to work on the go, Word Editor is your go-to solution for editing Word documents on iOS.

7. Offline Editing: Enjoy the flexibility to work on your documents even without an internet connection. Edit offline, and once you're back online, the app will automatically sync your changes.

fdroid:app.tankste.fdroid.name: tankste! - Your fuel price app
fdroid:app.tankste.fdroid.summary: Find the cheapest gas station near you!
fdroid:app.tankste.fdroid.description:
With the tankste! app, you can find the cheapest fuel prices in your area. With the proven traffic light system, you can see at a glance where you can save money on fuel and which gas station you should avoid.
 🚦 Traffic Light System 🚦 
With the well-known traffic light system, you can see at a glance which gas stations offer cheap gasoline.
We compare all gas stations in your area and show you the best possible offer that you can use.
🟢 green = cheap
🟠 orange = slightly more expensive
🔴 red = expensive
 🔍 Filters 🔍 
With the simple filtering options, you can select the type of fuel you prefer. You can choose between gasoline E5, gasoline E10, and diesel.
 🔐 No Tracking 🔐 
No registration is necessary to use tankste! The use of location is also optional. This is about fuel prices, nothing more and nothing less.
 🤑 Free & Ad-Free 🤑 
To make refueling even more enjoyable, this app is free. There are no hidden costs, and I don't display ads! The project is funded entirely by voluntary donations. Just like you know it from Wikipedia, for example.
 👾 Open Source 👾 
Since I don't want the idea behind Bertha to be lost again, the project is completely open source. You can find the code on Github and contribute to the project. Missing a feature? No problem! Just create a pull request or an issue.
 🌍 Cross-Border 🌍 
We want you to be able to use the app for your refueling even on vacation and at borders. Currently, tankste! offers you prices in Germany 🇩🇪, Denmark 🇩🇰 & Iceland 🇮🇸.
 🧑💻 More Features 🧑💻 
The app is still young, and the bureaucratic steps to obtain more data from gas stations and countries are large. The roadmap still has a lot to offer, and I look forward to growing the project with you. So if something is still missing, please contact me and have some patience.
 ℹ️ Data Sources ℹ️ 
You can find the sources of the data on our website at https://tankste.app/datenquellen/.
